description:
**THE ROLE** 




 You will build the systems behind our internal AI intelligence layer and our client AI work. This is applied engineering on production systems with real users inside the company and real clients outside it. It is not a research post, and it is not a prompt writing post.
 



 The work is varied by design. In a given quarter you might tune a retrieval pipeline that is returning the wrong chunks, design an authorisation model so an agent cannot read what its caller cannot read, benchmark two open weight models on a client's data to justify an on premises deployment, and then write the evaluation harness that proves the change was actually an improvement.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Build and maintain retrieval pipelines, covering chunking strategy, embedding selection, vector store performance and hybrid search behaviour. We run pgvector on PostgreSQL today.
* Design and ship agent workflows and tool calling systems, with attention to failure handling, cost and latency rather than demo quality output.
* Own model evaluation. Build the harnesses, define the metrics and produce the evidence that a change helped. We would rather have an unglamorous eval suite than a confident opinion.
* Deploy and operate inference workloads on GCP and Vertex AI, and contribute to sizing and configuration for on premises open weight model hosting.
* Integrate AI capability into the wider product surface through APIs, webhooks and event driven pipelines.
* Work with the AI Product Owner to turn requirements into technical designs, and push back when the requirement and the technology disagree.



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* Strong Python, and comfort in a production codebase rather than only in notebooks.
* Practical experience with LLM applications: RAG systems, agent frameworks, structured output, function calling. You have debugged a retrieval system that was quietly returning rubbish, and you know how you found it.
* Solid SQL and PostgreSQL. Vector database experience is a clear advantage.
* Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP, including containerised services and managed inference.
* An empirical instinct. When something improves, you want to know by how much.



**USEFUL BUT NOT ESSENTIAL** 



* Fine tuning or adapter work, including LoRA.
* Experience with self hosted open weight models and GPU infrastructure.
* Familiarity with AI security concerns such as prompt injection, authorisation in retrieval, and data leakage across contexts.
* Frontend competence in React or Next.js, enough to build a working interface for your own systems.



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 In your first ninety days you will ship one meaningful improvement to retrieval quality on the internal AI platform with measurement to back it, and take independent ownership of at least one client facing AI component.

* Full\-time — hybrid, three days a week on site
* 3\-6 years shipping models other people depend on, rather than models that lived in a notebook
* Bengaluru, India


 Apply for this role
   

  

 The work
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Build and maintain evaluation sets before any modelling work starts, including the adversarial and long\-tail cases the client keeps quiet about.
* Take the extraction pipeline from 91 to 97 per cent field\-level accuracy across 14 field types, with a confidence threshold that routes the rest to human review.
* Serve models inside a 400 ms p95 budget, including retrieval, with a documented rollback to the previous version.
* Instrument drift and volume monitoring, and define the trigger conditions for retraining rather than retraining on a calendar.
* Explain to non\-technical stakeholders exactly where the model will be wrong, before they find out in production.


 You
   

  

 What we look for
   

  

* Python and PyTorch, plus practical work with transformer models — fine\-tuning, quantisation, or serving them behind an API you kept up.
* A real grasp of calibration, class imbalance and the difference between offline metrics and the decision the model actually drives.
* At least one model deployed behind live traffic, with the monitoring and rollback path you built for it.
* Healthy scepticism about published benchmark numbers, and a habit of reproducing them before quoting them.
* The judgement to say a rules engine will beat a model on a particular problem, and to say it early.


 More roles
   

  

 Other openings
   

  

* Bengaluru, India
* Full\-time — hybrid, three days a week on site


 Senior Backend Engineer (Java)
   

  

 You will work on the settlement and ledger services behind Meridian Exchange's B2B marketplace: roughly 40 million ledger rows a month, Java 21 on Spring Boot, Postgres 16, Kafka for event fan\-out. The interesting part is not new endpoints, it is correctness under load — idempotent writes, exactly\-once effects on top of at\-least\-once delivery, and holding p99 write latency under 250 ms as the ledger grows.
   

  

* Jodhpur, India
* Full\-time — on site


 Platform Engineer, Kubernetes
   

  

 Atmora runs more than 40 client workloads across EKS and AKS, from a nine\-node cluster carrying Kestrel Industrial's shop\-floor telemetry to a two\-region active/passive setup for Corvus Logistics. You will own the internal platform those delivery teams deploy onto: the Terraform module library, the Argo CD app\-of\-apps layout, and the paved path that takes a service from merge to production in under 12 minutes.
   

  

* London, UK
* Full\-time — London office, with four to six client\-site days a month across the UK and EU


 Principal Solutions Architect
   

  

 Most of our UK work is legacy modernisation for regulated businesses: Cordage Bank moving a 22\-year\-old core banking periphery off a shared Oracle schema, Aldridge Risk replacing an overnight batch that had grown to 9 hours and 40 minutes against a 6\-hour window. You will run discovery, decide the migration shape, and stay accountable for it once delivery starts — not hand over a slide deck and leave.

About the Role

GaonGram Tech Private Limited is looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented **Software Tester Intern** to join our development and QA team. The ideal candidate should be familiar with software testing methodologies, API testing, bug tracking, and quality assurance processes.

As a Software Tester Intern, you will be responsible for testing web and mobile applications, identifying defects, validating fixes, and ensuring that our products meet functional, performance, security, and usability requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **Smoke Testing** to verify the stability of new builds.

* Perform **Integration Testing** to validate communication between different modules and services.

* Perform **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** and validate features against business requirements.
* Conduct **Load and Performance Testing** to evaluate application behavior under different levels of traffic and workload.

* Validate API requests, responses, status codes, authentication, error handling, and data integrity.
* Design, document, and execute detailed **test cases and test scenarios**.
* Identify, reproduce, document, and track bugs with clear steps and supporting evidence.
* Perform **Bug Verification and Retesting** after fixes.
* Test applications across different browsers, operating systems, screen sizes, and devices.
* Perform **UI/UX and Usability Testing** to ensure a smooth user experience.
* Conduct **End\-to\-End Testing** of complete application workflows.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and other team members to resolve defects.
* Maintain testing documentation, test reports, and QA records.
* Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and release testing activities.

Required Skills

Candidates should be familiar with the following:

* **Manual Software Testing**
* **Smoke Testing**
* **Regression Testing**

* **System Testing**

* **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**

* **Security Testing**

* **UI/UX \& Usability Testing**
* Test Case Design and Execution
* Bug Reporting and Defect Lifecycle
* Basic understanding of **SDLC and STLC**
* Basic understanding of software QA processes

Tools \& Technical Knowledge

Familiarity with the following tools and technologies will be an advantage:

* **Postman** or similar API testing tools

* Git/GitHub
* Performance testing tools such as **JMeter** or similar
* Basic understanding of HTTP/REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and status codes

Qualifications

* Pursuing or recently completed **B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or a related degree**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good understanding of software testing concepts.
* Ability to understand requirements and convert them into test scenarios.
* Ability to identify, reproduce, and communicate software defects clearly.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Passion for finding bugs and improving software quality.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.

What You Will Learn

During the internship, you will gain practical experience in:

* Real\-world **Software Quality Assurance (QA)** processes.
* Manual and API testing.
* Smoke, regression, integration, acceptance, load, performance, and security testing.
* Test case and test scenario creation.
* Bug reporting, tracking, and verification.
* Testing web and mobile applications.
* Working with APIs and backend services.
* QA processes within an Agile development environment.
* Collaboration with developers and product teams.
* Understanding the complete software development lifecycle.

What We Offer

* Hands\-on experience with real\-world software projects.
* Professional QA and software testing experience.
* Mentorship and guidance from experienced team members.
* Exposure to modern web, mobile, API, and backend technologies.
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Internship Certificate upon successful completion.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is **curious, detail\-oriented, technically interested, and passionate about finding problems before users do**. description:
**Job Description**
 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III \- Performance Engineer (Playwright, JMeter) at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial \& Investment Bank, you'll serve as a Performance Test Engineer to design, build, and execute performance and reliability testing for critical applications and services. This role blends hands\-on performance engineering (load, stress, endurance, scalability) with test automation, including Playwright\-based automation experience, to improve quality, resilience, and customer experience across our platforms.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak/endurance, and scalability tests for web applications and APIs.
* Develop and maintain performance test scripts using Apache JMeter, including parameterization, correlation, assertions, timers, and test data management.
* Execute and manage tests at scale using BlazeMeter (or comparable platform), including distributed runs, scheduling, and reporting.
* Leverage Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) for UI workflow automation where appropriate (e.g., validating critical user journeys, smoke checks during performance runs, test setup/teardown).
* Integrate performance and automation testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* Maintain reusable test frameworks, utilities, and shared libraries for performance testing.
* Instrument and monitor system behavior during tests using observability stacks such as Grafana (e.g., dashboards for latency percentiles, throughput, CPU/memory, saturation, error rates).
* Correlate performance test results with application and infrastructure metrics to diagnose bottlenecks (app, database, network, third\-party dependencies).
* Produce performance test reports, trend analysis, capacity insights, and actionable remediation guidance.
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Practical experience with Apache JMeter for scripting and executing performance tests.
* Experience using BlazeMeter for running/managing JMeter tests (distributed execution, results analysis, reporting).
* Experience with Grafana for visualization and monitoring of performance test runs
* Experience in Playwright and UI automation concepts
* Strong understanding of performance engineering concepts: response time, throughput, concurrency, latency percentiles, SLAs/SLOs, and performance test design.
* Proficiency in one or more languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python, or C\#.
* Experience with metrics/logging/tracing ecosystems (e.g., Prometheus, Splunk, ELK, Dynatrace, AppDynamics).
* Experience with containerized/cloud environments (Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms) and database performance fundamentals (query analysis, indexing concepts).


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies
* Exposure to UI automation concepts \- TypeScript/JavaScript preferred
* Exposure to cloud technologies

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
At **Semsons Tech**, our **Service Engineers** are the people customers rely on when a machine needs to move from a crate to a production floor — and when a production line needs to get running again.

We work with jewellery manufacturers across India and international markets, providing advanced machinery and technology used throughout the jewellery manufacturing process.

As a **Service Engineer,** you will work hands\-on with a wide range of industrial and jewellery manufacturing equipment, including:

* Diamond wax setting machines
* Laser marking and laser welding systems
* XRF gold and precious\-metal analysers
* Jewellery 3D printers
* Casting and melting equipment
* Moulding and wax injection equipment
* Other electro\-mechanical and automated production systems

This is a field\-oriented engineering role. You will install machines, commission equipment, diagnose problems, train operators, perform preventive maintenance and work directly with customers at their manufacturing facilities.

You will learn the mechanical, electrical, electronics, controls and software aspects of different machine systems while developing strong real\-world troubleshooting and customer\-facing skills.

**What You Will Do**

**1\. Machine Installation \& Commissioning**

Visit customer factories for machine installation and commissioning.

Receive, inspect and prepare equipment for installation.

Assemble and install mechanical and electrical components.

Perform machine alignment, calibration and configuration.

Conduct machine trials and first\-run production testing.

Train operators and customer teams on machine operation, safety and basic troubleshooting.

Ensure machines are handed over to customers in a production\-ready condition.

**2\. Troubleshooting \& Breakdown Support**

Diagnose mechanical, electrical, electronic and control\-system faults.

Identify the root cause of machine failures rather than only addressing symptoms.

Troubleshoot sensors, motors, drives, controllers, wiring, power systems and other machine components.

Support customers remotely through phone and WhatsApp before deciding whether an on\-site visit is required.

Attend breakdown calls at customer locations and restore machines to working condition as efficiently as possible.

Carry out repairs and component replacements when required.

Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate technical or engineering team.

**3\. Preventive Maintenance**

Conduct scheduled preventive maintenance visits.

Inspect machines for wear, alignment, electrical issues and other potential failures.

Perform routine servicing and calibration.

Maintain service reports and machine history.

Recommend replacement of components before they result in production downtime.

Help customers maintain machine performance and reliability over the long term.

**4\. Customer Training \& Technical Support**

Train machine operators and customer technical teams.

Explain machine operation and troubleshooting in a clear and practical manner.

Provide first\-line technical support remotely.

Communicate professionally with factory owners, production managers, operators and maintenance teams.

Understand the customer's production problem and translate it into a technical solution.

**5\. Technical Reporting \& Feedback**

Maintain accurate service and installation records.

Document machine faults, repairs, parts replaced and actions taken.

Identify recurring technical problems.

Share field feedback with the technical and engineering teams.

Report potential design, reliability or usability improvements.

Contribute to improving machine serviceability and customer experience.

**What We're Looking For**

**Educational Qualification**

**You should have a:**

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

Diploma in Electrical Engineering

Diploma in Electronics Engineering

Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering

OR

B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering

B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering

B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics Engineering

B.E. / B.Tech in Mechatronics Engineering

Experience

0–2 years of relevant experience.

Candidates with 1–2 years of hands\-on experience with industrial machinery, automation or electro\-mechanical equipment are preferred.

Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and hands\-on aptitude are welcome to apply.

Experience in industrial equipment servicing, machine installation, automation, CNC, robotics, electrical systems or similar equipment will be an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

You should be comfortable working with or willing to learn:

Mechanical assemblies and machine components

Electrical wiring and electrical panels

Sensors and switches

Motors and drives

Servo systems

Control systems

Basic PLC concepts

Industrial automation

Pneumatic systems

Machine calibration

Electrical circuit diagrams

Mechanical assembly drawings

Technical manuals and machine documentation

Basic computer and software troubleshooting

You don't need to know every system when you join.

What matters most is your ability to understand how things work, diagnose problems logically and learn quickly.

The Kind of Engineer We're Looking For

This role is not limited to sitting in an office and solving problems from a screen.

You may find yourself:

Monday:

Installing a machine at a jewellery factory.

Tuesday:

Troubleshooting a servo or sensor issue.

Wednesday:

Training operators on a new machine.

Thursday:

Travelling to another city for a service call.

Friday:

Working with the technical team to understand why a recurring fault occurred.

If you enjoy machines, electronics, engineering, troubleshooting and being on the ground, this role could be a great fit.

Travel Is Part of the Job

This is a field service engineering position.

You should be comfortable travelling to customer manufacturing facilities across Mumbai and other cities across India for:

Machine installations

Commissioning

Preventive maintenance

Breakdown service

Customer training

Technical inspections

Machine demonstrations

Troubleshooting and support

Willingness to travel extensively across India is an essential requirement for this role.

Depending on customer requirements, travel may involve short\-term and multi\-day visits.

Communication Skills Matter

As a Service Engineer, you won't always be speaking with another engineer.

You may need to explain a technical problem and its solution to:

A factory owner

Production manager

Machine operator

Maintenance technician

Jewellery manufacturer

Customer management team

You should therefore be able to:

Communicate clearly

Listen carefully to customer problems

Ask the right technical questions

Explain solutions in simple language

Remain calm during machine breakdowns

Maintain a professional attitude at customer sites

Good engineering \+ good communication \= great field service.

Pay: ₹9,082\.88 \- ₹28,387\.55 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Mumbai, Maharashtra (Mumbai, Mumbai District): Reliably commute or willing to relocate with an employer\-provided relocation package (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

title: Junior Mechanical Design Engineer / GET
description:
**Sportainement** **Engineering \& Design (SED)** is an Indian provider of creative and technological solutions for customers around the world. The company designs custom software to support both small businesses and large groups, with expertise in trampoline centers and indoor leisure parks.


SED offers a comprehensive suite of tools covering all operations: online and on\-site booking, check\-in/check\-out, birthday management, point of sale, reporting, and digital waivers. The company also provides hosting and secure (SSL) solutions to ensure performance and reliability.


SED is part of the French **ABEO Group**, one of the global leaders in sports and leisure equipment, which unites its employees around shared values: trust, perseverance, and team spirit.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a **passionate and detail\-oriented Junior Mechanical Design Engineer / GET** to join our **Design team in Noida**.


Our company specializes in the design and manufacturing of **trampoline parks, gymnastics equipment, indoor recreational structures, and related mechanical systems**, with our manufacturing operations based in the Asia Europe \& USA.


The selected candidate will work closely with experienced design engineers and contribute to the **design, development, detailing, and documentation of innovative mechanical products and systems**. This is an excellent opportunity for a fresher or a young engineer with 1–2 years of experience who wants to build a strong career in mechanical design and product development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop **2D drawings and 3D models** of mechanical components, assemblies, and structures using **SolidWorks and AutoCAD**.
* Prepare detailed **manufacturing drawings, fabrication drawings, assembly drawings, and engineering documentation**.
* Assist in the design and development of new products and mechanical systems from concept to production.
* Understand design requirements, engineering specifications, dimensions, tolerances, and material requirements.
* Collaborate with the **Design, Engineering, Production, and other cross\-functional teams** to ensure designs are practical and production\-ready.
* Review drawings and models for **accuracy, manufacturability, functionality, and design intent**.
* Support design modifications, engineering changes, and continuous improvement activities.
* Assist in identifying opportunities for **design optimization, material utilization, cost reduction, and improved manufacturability**.
* Provide technical support and clarification to manufacturing teams whenever required.
* Maintain proper revision control and engineering documentation.
* Follow applicable **engineering standards, safety requirements, and company design procedures**.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. in **Mechanical Engineering** or a related field.
* **Freshers / GETs** with strong fundamentals are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with **1–2 years of experience in mechanical design/drafting** will be preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of **SolidWorks** is highly desirable.
* Good knowledge of **AutoCAD**.
* Understanding of **3D modeling, assemblies, and 2D manufacturing drawings**.
* Basic understanding of **engineering drawing, GD\&T, tolerances, materials, and manufacturing processes**.
* Good understanding of fundamental mechanical engineering principles.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand design requirements and convert concepts into practical engineering solutions.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, deadline\-driven environment.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of **PDM / document management systems**.
* Exposure to fabrication, sheet metal, structural components, or mechanical assemblies.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes such as **cutting, bending, welding, machining, and fabrication**.
* Experience working with international engineering/manufacturing teams.
* Basic knowledge of **design for manufacturing (DFM)** and design optimization.

**What We’re Looking For**


We are looking for someone who is **curious, willing to learn, technically sound, and passionate about mechanical design**.


For freshers, practical knowledge and a strong understanding of **SolidWorks, AutoCAD, engineering drawings, and mechanical fundamentals** will be valued more than extensive industry experience.


If you enjoy turning ideas into **3D models, engineering drawings, and real\-world products**, this could be a great opportunity to start or grow your career in mechanical design.

**Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated CV along with relevant SolidWorks/AutoCAD project details or portfolio, if available.**

**ABOUT ABEO**


ABEO is one of the global leaders in sports and leisure equipment. A French publicly traded company, it brings together and develops more than 30 companies across 13 countries. ABEO employs 1,700 people, including 460 in France.


The Group’s activities include the design, manufacturing, and distribution of equipment for all types of infrastructures, including schools, sports halls, leisure parks, swimming pools… ABEO’s companies are divided into three divisions: Sport; Sportainment \& Climbing; Changing Rooms.


Are you ready to join the adventure, work in a dynamic environment, take on daily challenges, and grow within an international group? It’s up to you!


️To find more about Sportainement Engineering \& Design, visit the company's website.


Discover ABEO and its companies on the Group's website.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**Who We Are** 




 Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric — the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint.
 



 Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix.ai
 



  





**About the Role \- Member of Technical Staff – Backend Engineering \- SaaS Platform** 




 Aviatrix Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) delivers the intelligence, advanced networking, and security services of Aviatrix’s multi\-cloud platform as a managed offering. Our SaaS platform serves enterprise customers with a reliable, secure, and scalable product built on modern microservices and cloud\-native backend architectures.
 



 We are looking for a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) – Backend Engineering to join our SaaS Platform team. This role is ideal for an early\-career backend engineer with a strong foundation in software development and curiosity to grow in distributed systems and cloud technologies. You will work closely with senior engineers, contribute to microservices development, and grow in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Feature Development \& Delivery** 




 · Design, implement, test, and ship reliable and maintainable backend features and services.
 



 · Build and extend Golang\-based microservices using REST and gRPC patterns.
 



 · Participate across the development lifecycle, including design, code review, deployment, and monitoring.
 



 · Write clean, well\-tested code and help maintain high code quality standards.
 



**Collaboration \& Growth** 




 · Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and peers to deliver platform features.
 



 · Participate in design discussions, bringing curiosity and a willingness to learn.
 



 · Incorporate feedback from code reviews and document APIs, service behavior, and runbooks clearly.
 



 · Continuously build knowledge of backend, cloud\-native, and distributed system concepts.
 



**Platform \& Operations** 




 · Contribute to service reliability by adding logs, metrics, and alerts as part of feature delivery.
 



 · Assist with deploying and operating services on AWS following team standards.
 



 · Help identify and address performance issues, reliability gaps, and technical debt.
 



 · Participate in on\-call rotations as you grow into the role.
 



**Requirements** 




**Experience \& Education** 




 · 1–3 years of backend software engineering experience.
 



 · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 · Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals and experience shipping backend features in production.
 



**Backend \& Cloud** 




 · Proficiency in a strongly typed backend language; Golang experience is a strong plus.
 



 · Understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, distributed systems, and basic data modeling.
 



 · Hands\-on experience with AWS or another public cloud platform.
 



 · Familiarity with containers (Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and Git\-based workflows.
 



**Nice to Have** 




 · Experience with Golang and gRPC\-based services.
 



 · Exposure to event\-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS).
 



 · Familiarity with Kubernetes or infrastructure\-as\-code tools.
 



 · Interest in cloud networking, security, or SaaS platforms.
 



**Interpersonal \& Communication** 




 · Clear written and verbal communication skills.
 



 · Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback.
 



 · Strong eagerness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced engineering team.

title: AI infrastructure System Engineer Bangalore
description:
**AI Infrastructure Systems Engineer**
**Build the infrastructure powering the next generation of AI.**
 At Together AI, you’ll build and operate one of the world’s largest GPU fleets used for frontier model training and inference. This isn’t a traditional infrastructure role—we’re looking for engineers who love building systems, automating everything, and solving problems at massive scale.
   

  

 If you enjoy writing software more than clicking dashboards, obsess over eliminating manual work, and want to build infrastructure that manages tens of thousands of GPUs autonomously, we’d love to talk.
   

  

**What You’ll Build**
* Design and build fleet automation systems that provision, validate, deploy, upgrade, repair, and retire GPU clusters with minimal human intervention.
* Build AI Infrastructure Agents that automate deployment, root\-cause failures, incident triage, and autonomous remediation.
* Develop Fleet Intelligence platforms that continuously monitor hardware health, firmware, networking, storage, thermals, and workload performance to predict failures before they impact customers.
* Build software that maximizes GPU availability, utilization, performance, and reliability across thousands of accelerators.
* Create automated validation systems for GPUs, InfiniBand/RoCE fabrics, NVLink/NVSwitch, storage, and distributed AI workloads.
* Build internal platforms and developer tools that allow infrastructure to be managed through software—not manual operations.
* Continuously improve deployment velocity, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation.
* Partner closely with hardware, networking, platform, and AI teams to push the limits of AI infrastructure.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3\+ years building distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or large\-scale backend software.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go, or Rust.
* Experience building platforms, automation systems, or developer infrastructure.
* Experience with Linux, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar infrastructure technologies.
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to understand problems across hardware and software.
* A passion for solving complex infrastructure challenges through software.
* An automation\-first mindset—if a task is repeated, your instinct is to build a system to eliminate it.


**Bonus Experience**
* GPU infrastructure, CUDA, NCCL, NVLink/NVSwitch
* InfiniBand or RoCE networking
* Bare\-metal provisioning and lifecycle management
* Large\-scale AI training or inference clusters
* Hardware health monitoring and predictive failure detection
* Distributed storage systems
* AI agents and autonomous infrastructure operations


**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
* Love building systems that replace repetitive operational work.
* Think of infrastructure as a software engineering problem.
* Enjoy solving hard problems with no existing playbook.
* Care deeply about performance, reliability, and scale.
* Want to build technology that powers frontier AI models.


**Our mission is simple:** 
 build AI infrastructure that largely runs itself—where intelligent systems deploy, monitor, diagnose, optimize, and heal GPU fleets at massive scale. Every system you build will directly improve the speed, efficiency, and reliability of one of the world’s most advanced AI compute platforms.
   

  

**About Together AI**
 Together AI is a research\-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co\-designing software, hardware, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open\-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancement such as FlashAttention, Hyena, FlexGen, and RedPajama. We invite you to join a passionate group of researchers and engineers in our journey in building the next generation AI infrastructure.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.
   

  

 Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

title: Cyber Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
 Outsourced is a leading ISO certified global offshore outsourcing company that provides dedicated remote staff to some of the world's leading international companies. Outsourced is recognized as one of the Best Places to Work and has achieved Great Place to Work Certification. We are committed to providing a positive and supportive work environment where all staff can thrive. As an Outsourced staff member, you will enjoy a fun and friendly working environment, competitive salaries, opportunities for growth and development, work\-life balance, and the chance to share your passion with a team of over 1000 talented professionals.
   

  

 Position Title: Cyber Analyst
   

  

 Work Arrangement: Remote \- India
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Cyber Analyst (CA), you sit at the human\-in\-the\-loop (HITL) checkpoint of our SitRep generation pipeline. You will review AI\-generated SitReps — both those flagged by our automated confidence gate and those in routine QA sampling — determine whether the underlying detection is a true or false positive, diagnose why the pipeline got it right or wrong, and drive permanent fixes into the system's knowledge base and agent prompts.
   

  

 You are the mechanism by which a mistake happens once instead of a thousand times.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**SitRep Triage \& Investigation**
* Review AI\-generated SitReps in our case management queue (TheHive), including escalations from low\-confidence scoring, judge\-model failures, and recurring\-case matches
* Classify SitReps as False Positive, True Positive / Benign, or True Positive / Approved, using client context, detection logic, raw telemetry, and asset data
* Investigate underlying security events across network, endpoint, cloud, and identity telemetry to validate or refute the AI's findings
* Approve high\-quality SitReps for client delivery; correct, annotate, or escalate the rest


**Root\-Cause Analysis of AI Output For every false positive or benign finding, determine the failure category and drive the fix:**
* Client condition issues — the detection is technically correct but expected/authorized in this client's environment → contribute changes to Client Notes documentation and the client\-context agent prompt
* Detection logic issues — the rule itself is flawed or over\-broad → contribute changes to Detection documentation and the detection agent prompt
* Payload / OCSF issues — event normalization, schema mapping, or pipeline parsing errors → contribute changes to OCSF/payload/pipeline documentation
* Asset alignment issues — asset inventory, vulnerability, or hardening context is wrong or stale → contribute changes to asset/vulnerability documentation


**Knowledge Base \& Prompt Engineering Contributions**
* Author and edit the versioned Markdown knowledge corpus (detections, OCSF mappings, asset context, client notes) that grounds every SitRep the platform generates
* Propose, test, and sign off on changes to agent prompts before they go to production — your edits are permanent improvements, subject to testing and signoff, not one\-off overrides
* Provide structured feedback (analyst edits, verdict rationale) that feeds our evaluation datasets and judge\-model calibration


**Reporting \& Continuous Improvement**
* Contribute to weekly triage\-outcome reports used by CA Managers to identify systemic detection and content issues
* Support monthly client\-outcome reporting alongside Customer Success
* Identify recurring failure patterns and propose upstream fixes rather than repeatedly triaging the same class of error.


**Preferred Qualification\-**
* Experience with OCSF (Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework) or other normalization schemas (ECS, CIM)
* Exposure to LLM\-based tooling in security workflows — prompt writing, output evaluation, RAG systems, or AI\-assisted triage — or strong curiosity and aptitude to learn it fast
* Detection engineering experience: writing or tuning rules in Sigma, KQL, Jupyter notebooks, or vendor\-native languages
* Experience writing runbooks, knowledge\-base articles, or detection documentation (Markdown fluency a plus)
* Familiarity with GCP or other cloud environments from an investigation standpoint
* Scripting ability (Python) for log analysis and triage automation
* Certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, BTL1/BTL2, or CySA\+ (valued, not required)


****The Ideal Candidate Will Possess:****
* Skeptical by default, curious by nature. You don't rubber\-stamp AI output, and you don't dismiss it either — you verify, then diagnose
* Root\-cause oriented. Closing a ticket isn't the goal; making the same ticket never appear again is
* A strong writer. Your notes, corrections, and documentation become the ground truth an AI system reasons from — precision matters
* Comfortable with feedback loops. You'll see your own triage decisions scored, sampled, and used to improve the system, and you'll help improve the process itself
* Client\-empathetic. Every SitRep lands in front of a customer; you understand that clarity and accuracy are the product


**What we Offer** 
  

  

* Health Insurance: We provide medical coverage up to 20 lakh per annum, which covers you, your spouse, and a set of parents. This is available after one month of successful engagement.
* Professional Development: You'll have access to a monthly upskill allowance of ₹5000 for continued education and certifications to support your career growth.
* Leave Policy: Vacation Leave (VL): 10 days per year, available after probation. You can carry over or encash up to 5 unused days.
+ Casual Leave (CL): 8 days per year for personal needs or emergencies, available from day one.
+ Sick Leave: 12 days per year, available after probation.

* Flexible Work Hours or Remote Work Opportunities \- Depending on the role and project.
* Outsourced Benefits such as Paternity Leave, Maternity Leave, etc.

title: IT Security Analyst
description:
Lakeside Software gives organizations with large, complex IT environments complete visibility across their entire digital estate — so they can do more with less. For too long, IT teams have operated in the dark. Costly inefficiencies, poor employee experiences, and unresolved problems hide where no one can see them. Lakeside changes that. We give everyone a better view: of the hidden issues, the smartest fixes, and the biggest savings. 
 



 It's why the world's leading global brands trust Lakeside — and how our customers achieve an average ROI of more than 250% 
 



 The Role  
 



 Lakeside Software is looking for a skilled Cybersecurity Analyst to strengthen our defenses and safeguard the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of our Azure cloud services and information systems. This role calls for a proactive, detail\-oriented professional with a solid understanding of current cybersecurity threats and the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels. You'll join a collaborative, forward\-thinking team committed to protecting what matters most. 
 



 What You'll Do  
 



 The core functions of this role include:  
 


* Conduct comprehensive security assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities in our Azure systems, networks, and applications.


* Use Endpoint Device Management (EDM) solutions to remediate identified vulnerabilities through automated patch deployment.


* Collaborate with engineering teams to address vulnerabilities that fall outside the scope of automated patching.


* Utilize industry standard tools and methodologies to perform assessments and identify security gaps.


* Execute regular vulnerability scans to uncover security weaknesses and ensure compliance with security policies, and regulations.


* Analyze scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, and recommend corrective actions.


* Monitor and review Indicators of Compromise (IOC) to detect and respond to potential security incidents.


* Analyze threat intelligence and perform investigations to prevent or mitigate security breaches.


* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to contain and resolve security threats promptly.


* Perform routine review of alerts and security logs to identify anomalous activity, escalate confirmed incidents, and maintain documentation of findings.


* Conduct and document periodic user access reviews across systems and applications to support least\-privilege controls and satisfy audit requirements.


* Assist in responding to customer and prospect security questionnaires, including DDQs and vendor risk assessments, by accurately documenting Lakeside's controls, certifications, and security practices in alignment with our security program and approved disclosure posture.


* Performing special projects as required


**Requirements**

 What You'll Bring to Lakeside  
 



 The key requirements for this role include:  
 


* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.


* 3\+ years of experience in information security.


* Strong technical documentation skills.


* Hands\-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Tenable Nessus, Snyk Burpsuite, or equivalent.


* Solid knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and CIS.


* Familiarity with information security features across Microsoft Windows, Linux, and macOS.


* Experience managing Entra ID, EDM \- Intune and Jamf, and EDR solutions.


* Working knowledge of ITIL and NIST best practices.


* Experience with threat detection and incident response, including analyzing and responding to IOCs.


* Experience configuring and operating security tools including SIEM, WAF, EDR, and SASE platforms.



 Preferred qualifications include:

**About HiltLock** 




 HiltLock (previously Trampolyne AI) does AI red teaming for production GenAI: human\-led adversarial testing against live AI systems. We find the failures that read as ordinary traffic and never look like a bad request, the classes of attack that scanners, VAPT, and compliance frameworks don't reach. Recent work included pulling 3\.49 MB of one company's customer data across tenants on a billion\-dollar platform that had passed its pentest and its audit.
 



  





 We're building a vetted associate pool: experienced security people we bring onto specific engagements, paid per project, on terms set for that project. This is not a full\-time role and not a salaried position. It's for people who want interesting, high\-signal offensive work on real production AI systems, alongside whatever else they do.
 



  





**What the work is** 




 You'd be brought in on client engagements to do manual, architecture\-aware adversarial testing: reasoning about a specific system's tenancy, tool wiring, and retrieval scope, then hunting attack chains nobody has written a signature for yet. Concretely, across engagements this looks like:
 



  





 Designing and running adversarial inputs against live LLM and agent systems to surface prompt injection that survives guardrails, cross\-tenant data exposure, tool and function\-call abuse, and retrieval and RAG manipulation. Reasoning about authorization boundaries: whether a system can be talked into acting outside its authority. Writing findings that hold up: exploit chains, reproduction steps, severity, and a fix path per finding, not a report the client can't reproduce.
 



  





**Who we're looking for** 




 Almost nobody in the market has years of
 *AI* 
 red teaming behind them, because the discipline is that new. We care about demonstrated ability to break systems and reason about authorization, not a specific title. You're likely a fit if you have 2–3\+ years in one or more of:
 



  





 Offensive security or penetration testing. Security research or vulnerability research. Application security with a real feel for authorization and access\-control flaws. ML or model evaluation, if paired with a security instinct. Serious bug\-bounty or CTF track record.
 



  





 What matters across all of these: you can find the flaw nobody scripted a check for, you can write it up so someone else can reproduce it, and you can pick up AI\-specific attack surface quickly. Direct LLM or GenAI security experience is a strong plus, not a requirement. Familiarity with the OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, or tools like garak or PyRIT helps, and comfort scripting your own probes in Python is useful.
 



  





**How the pool works** 




 You join the vetted pool after a short screening (a conversation plus a practical exercise on a representative system). This is project\-based work, so a few things upfront, plainly:
 



  





 There is no retainer, no fixed monthly pay, and no upfront payment for being in the pool. You're paid only for engagements you actually work on. When an engagement fits your background and availability, we reach out with the scope, timeline, and rate before you commit to anything. Rates are set per engagement and are competitive for specialist offensive work. There's no exclusivity and no obligation to take work that doesn't suit you.
 



  





**On the HiltLock affiliation** 




 When you're active on a HiltLock engagement, we'll ask you to reflect the affiliation on your public profile, and you're welcome to keep it afterward as a credential. In a field this new, a public association with a named AI\-security practice is worth carrying. We only ask people who've actually done engagements to display it, because it should be true, for them and for us.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 Send us the sharpest thing you've broken and how you proved it: a bug\-bounty writeup, a CTF chain, a disclosure, a research note, or a redacted assessment. We read the evidence before anything else. A CV is fine, but the writeup is what gets our attention.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst based in India.**
 This remote opportunity is designed for professionals and aspiring analysts looking to build practical experience in cyber threat intelligence through realistic, simulation\-based environments. You will work with incomplete threat information, indicators, contextual data, and organizational requirements to determine what matters and why. The role emphasizes analytical judgment, source evaluation, threat prioritization, and decision\-focused intelligence. You will translate technical findings into clear assessments and recommendations for different stakeholders. The work spans threat actors, TTPs, indicators, intelligence gaps, and evolving assessments. All activities are conducted in controlled environments for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional\-development purposes.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Triage and evaluate threat information: Review multiple sources of simulated threat intelligence, determine relevance, assess reliability and credibility, and identify information requiring further investigation.
* Analyze threats and adversary behavior: Assess simulated threat actors, including their motivations, capabilities, targeting patterns, tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and determine their potential relevance to an organization.
* Assess indicators in context: Evaluate indicators of compromise alongside supporting evidence rather than treating individual indicators as definitive proof of malicious activity.
* Identify intelligence gaps: Determine what critical information is missing and define the additional intelligence required to improve security decision\-making.
* Develop intelligence requirements: Create or refine priority intelligence questions based on organizational assets, threat exposure, business priorities, and stakeholder needs.
* Prioritize threats: Compare competing threats according to relevance, likelihood, potential impact, available evidence, and organizational priorities.
* Apply structured analytical reasoning: Evaluate competing hypotheses, weigh evidence, document assumptions, and communicate why one assessment may be better supported than another.
* Produce actionable intelligence: Synthesize multiple information sources into assessments explaining what is happening, why it matters, and what defensive priorities should be considered.
* Communicate analytical confidence: Clearly articulate confidence levels, evidence quality, assumptions, and factors that limit certainty.
* Brief decision\-makers: Translate technical threat intelligence into concise, business\-relevant insights and recommendations for senior or non\-technical stakeholders.
* Update assessments: Reassess previous conclusions when new intelligence becomes available and clearly explain how additional evidence changes—or does not change—the original assessment.
* Create professional intelligence outputs: Develop threat assessments, threat actor profiles, executive intelligence briefs, intelligence requirements documents, TTP assessments, indicator assessments, confidence statements, threat prioritization reports, and intelligence updates.


**Requirements**
* Cybersecurity and threat intelligence interest: Suitable for aspiring CTI analysts, cybersecurity students or graduates, SOC professionals seeking CTI exposure, career changers, intelligence or security professionals transitioning into cyber, self\-taught practitioners, and professionals with relevant cybersecurity certifications.
* Analytical reasoning: Ability to examine incomplete or conflicting information, identify patterns, weigh evidence, develop hypotheses, and reach reasoned conclusions.
* Threat intelligence fundamentals: Understanding of threat intelligence concepts, threat actors, indicators of compromise, TTPs, threat assessments, intelligence requirements, and risk prioritization.
* Source evaluation: Ability to assess the reliability, credibility, relevance, and limitations of information sources and explain how these factors affect analytical confidence.
* Critical thinking: Strong attention to context and the ability to distinguish meaningful evidence from isolated or inconclusive information.
* Decision support: Ability to turn technical or complex security information into practical, decision\-useful intelligence and proportionate defensive recommendations.
* Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present technical findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Professional documentation: Ability to produce structured intelligence products such as assessments, executive briefs, intelligence requirements, threat profiles, and analytical updates.
* Adaptability: Comfortable revisiting assumptions and updating conclusions when new information becomes available.
* Ethical judgment: Commitment to using cybersecurity knowledge exclusively for legitimate defensive, educational, and professional\-development purposes.
* Remote working: Ability to work independently, manage analytical tasks effectively, and communicate findings in a remote environment.


**Benefits**
* Fully remote work environment.
* Simulation\-based experience designed to develop practical cyber threat intelligence capabilities.
* Exposure to realistic CTI scenarios involving incomplete information and evolving intelligence.
* Opportunity to build tangible professional artefacts demonstrating analytical and intelligence skills.
* Development of decision\-making, structured reasoning, source evaluation, and threat assessment capabilities.
* Experience producing industry\-relevant intelligence deliverables such as executive briefs and threat assessments.
* Suitable for students, graduates, career changers, SOC professionals, self\-taught practitioners, and experienced security professionals expanding into CTI.
* Work focused exclusively on legitimate defensive, educational, and professional\-development scenarios.
* Opportunity to strengthen a portfolio with evidence of applied cyber threat intelligence work.


**How Jobgether Works**
 We use an
 **AI\-powered matching process** 
 to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top\-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
   

  

 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
   

  

**Data Privacy Notice:** 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre\-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As a Cyber Security Engineer at GE Vernova Grid Solutions, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and optimizing the cybersecurity requirement for EHV/HV substations (AIS/GIS/HVDC/FACTS/STATCOM/Onshore/Offshore/Renewable/etc.,) considering the safety/quality/Cost/time delivery criteria.
   

  

 In this role, you will be reporting directly to project and designated line manager, while as well indirectly reporting technically to the OT Engineering Cybersecurity Leader. The successful candidate will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the development of renewables project worldwide. The development of such projects is technically challenging and involves a variety of engineering disciplines, contribution through teamwork and an innovative approach.
   

  

 This position will provide the candidate an ideal opportunity to develop the problem solving and communication skills in a global environment and build up a network within the OT cybersecurity / engineering community. The position will be guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role as per requirement.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability assessments for operational technology systems to identify security weaknesses and potential threats.
* Design and implement security controls and measures to protect OT systems from cyber threats, including intrusion detection systems, firewalls, access controls, and network segmentation.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including OT engineers, IT professionals, and management, to ensure cybersecurity considerations are integrated into the design, deployment, and maintenance of OT systems.
* Stay updated on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices related to OT cybersecurity and make recommendations for security enhancements.
* Conduct penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on OT systems to identify and remediate security weaknesses.
* Provide technical expertise and guidance to internal teams regarding OT security standards, policies, and procedures.
* Collaborate with third\-party vendors and suppliers to ensure the security of OT systems and evaluate their cybersecurity capabilities.
* Conduct security training and awareness programs for OT operators and other personnel involved in OT operations.


**The Candidate Must Be**
* Self\-motivating, proactive and results driven approach.
* Curious, resilient, and willing to learn.
* Able to work to deadlines with high quality, sense of urgency and delivery.
* Focused on delivering value to customers.
* Strong problem\-solving and root cause identification skills.
* Flexibility in working hours.
* Ability to work on high pressure environment.


**Required Qualifications**
* University Degree qualified in an engineering discipline ideally with Cyber Security Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Computer and Electronics engineering.
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in project security, preferably in an Operational Technology (OT) environment.
* 2 to 6 years' experience within the Electrical Industry or in a similar role.
* Solid understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT technologies.
* Knowledge of OT\-specific protocols and standards such as Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, and OPC.
* Experience in designing and implementing security controls for OT systems, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls.
* Familiarity with network segmentation techniques and security architectures for OT systems.
* Experience in Industrial communication network and system security IEC 62443 standards.
* Knowledge of NIST Cyber security framework.
* Good knowledge of Cyber security principles, theories, and techniques.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Pro\-activeness, sense of urgency, resistance to pressure, autonomy ability to interact with multiple functions and teams worldwide.
* Acceptable level of English speaking and writing preferred.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Cyber security certification is an advantage.


**About Grid Solutions**
 GE Vernova's Grid Solutions business electrifies the world by delivering advanced grid technologies that enable efficient power transmission and distribution from generation to consumption. With a global footprint of 14,000 employees in around 80 countries, Grid Solutions serves 90% of the world’s power utilities, supporting a reliable, efficient, and decarbonized energy transition.
   

  

 Grid Solutions offers a wide range of products and services, including power electronics, high voltage equipment, automation \& protection systems, software solutions, and turnkey projects, Grid Solutions also provides consulting, electrical balance of plant, E/HHV substations, and comprehensive maintenance and asset management services.
   

  

 GSI GEC (GSI Global Engineering Center) in India, is expanding to support all over the world / regions. We specialize in delivering high\-quality engineering solutions across the various sectors, Power Transmission AC or DC station, FACTS, Oil and Gas, Renewable and Industrial market.
   

  

 This role involves enhancing the collaboration and efficiency between our global Regions—such as North America, South America, Europe, Africa, and others—and the GSI GEC.
   

  

**Why We Come To Work**
 Our engineers are always up for the challenge \- and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution\-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game\-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 A key role in a dynamic, international working environment with a large degree of flexibility of work agreements, Competitive benefits, and great development opportunities \- including private health insurance.
   

  

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

 A globally focused shipping and transportation organization continues to drive an ambitious and complex change and transformational programme to deliver a service of excellence for its customers and clients worldwide. The
   

  

 Global CTIO has a mandate from the Maersk board to lead the Technology transformation of Maersk, enabling the
   

  

 Maersk business strategy to become the global integrator of container logistics through digitizing the Maersk business processes and customer engagement.
   

  

 The Technology Function is fundamental to enabling the company’s transformation. We are recruiting world\-class talent to ensure that the technology services are modernized, enabling Maersk to become a logistics integrator leveraging a competitive advantage through technology.
   

  

 Role Purpose:
   

  

 The Cyber Automation and Integration team is the integrator for our Cyber Operations, leveraging code and integration capability to ensure we optimize capability and ensure technology does not work in isolation. This role is highly technical and will involve you understanding a large amount of cyber capability from the endpoint, network, identity and code / development space. Whilst we do not expect a candidate to be an expert in all areas, a good grasp on the core concepts is fundamental.
   

  

 The Ideal candidate will have a good grasps on core areas within Cyber Security and a growth mindset with the desire to learn more. This area will be heavily influenced by AI and how best we can apply this technology in the cyber landscape.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Perform automation activities across multiple standardised web based API Standards (REST, SOAP,etc…)
* Support AI platforms and enable teams in the leveraging of AI platforms.
* Build out context layers for AI and its enabling services
* Build and maintain code bases across multiple projects
* Leverage security automation tooling to develop and support development of playbooks and workflows based on operational use cases.
* Build and develop integration capability across multiple tooling sources
* Build, maintain and support cloud\-based infrastructure associated to team projects.
* Construct technical documentation associated to projects and developments
* Understand how to optimise cyber tooling and capability to enhance cyber protection across the business
* Understanding of secure development and best practice when it comes to development.
* Be passionate about cyber security and push for continuous improvement across all areas related to cyber.
* Develop automations using scripting languages such as Python and PowerShell.

 A successful candidate may not have all the skills listed below; however many are desired for an experienced candidate to be successful. We firmly believe in growing, enhancing and augmenting existing talent and understand some skills can be grown into and developed with the right development.
   

  

**Core Skills:**
* A proficiency to build in one or more scripting languages, i.e. Python and PowerShell.
* Ability to work within a wider team on complex projects.
* Ability to generate high quality solution documentation and designs.
* Knowledge and experience with dealing with APIs
* Be able to communicate technical concepts to a non\-technical or less technical audience effectively.


**Desirable Skills**
* Some experience in building development pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud based infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* A foundational knowledge on standard cyber security tooling such as EDR, VM, Firewalls, XDR, SIEM, etc…

title: Security Engineer
description:
LevelBlue reduces risk and builds lasting resilience so organizations can innovate and advance their mission with confidence. As the world’s most analyst\-recognized and largest pure\-play managed security services provider, LevelBlue elevates client outcomes that matter: stronger defense, faster response, and sustained business continuity. LevelBlue combines AI\-powered security operations, advanced threat intelligence, and elite human expertise to provide the most comprehensive portfolio of strategic advisory, managed security, offensive security, and incident response services.
   

  

 Working Model: Hybrid / On\-call flexibility required (including occasional out\-of\-hours support)
   

  

 Working Time: 9\.00 am – 5\.30 pm US EST
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Managed Security Services (MSS) System Engineer to join our global cybersecurity operations team. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting advanced network and security solutions for enterprise customers across multiple regions. This role places strong emphasis on modern security architectures including SASE, SD\-WAN, and cloud\-delivered security platforms, with a primary focus on Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Zscaler technologies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and maintain managed security solutions across customer environments
* Engineer and deploy firewall and network security configurations across multi\-vendor platforms
* Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to review and validate security architectures
* Develop and implement security policies aligned to business and compliance requirements
* Perform solution integration across network, cloud, and security domains
* Support service onboarding, testing, and production turn\-up activities
* Troubleshoot complex network and security incidents across global environments
* Contribute to continuous improvement of MSS processes, automation, and service quality
* Provide technical guidance in customer engagements and escalations
* Participate in on\-call rotations and provide support across multiple time zones


**Core Technical Expertise**
 Network \& Security Fundamentals
   

  

* Routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP)
* MPLS, VPN technologies (IPsec / SSL VPN)
* NAT, segmentation, and network design principles
* Security Platforms (Multi\-Vendor)
* Palo Alto Networks (NGFW, Panorama, Prisma Access, Prisma SD\-WAN)
* Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSASE, FortiSD\-WAN)
* Cisco (ASA, Firepower, Secure Firewall, SD\-WAN/Viptela)
* Secure Access \& Cloud\-Delivered Security
* Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA)


**Professional Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent communication skills with customer\-facing experience
* Ability to manage multiple priorities


**Qualifications**
* 3–5\+ years of experience in network security engineering or MSS environments


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* CCNA / CCNP Security
* PCNSE
* Fortinet NSE


**Education**
* BCA / B.Tech graduates or candidates with relevant qualifications in cybersecurity, information technology or related fields.


 This role is open to candidates legally authorized to work in India. At LevelBlue, including teams that previously operated as Trustwave, we support flexible work and bring people together in person for key moments based on role, team, and business needs.
   

  

 LevelBlue is committed to a culture of respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other status protected under applicable law.
   

  

 To all agencies: Please do not contact LevelBlue employees outside of the Talent Acquisition team. title: Project Assistant – Technology
description:
**About IT for Change** 





 IT for Change (ITfC) is a not\-for\-profit organization whose mission is to end digital inequality and advance just, equitable, and people\-led digital futures for the Global South. ITfC works through three strategic program areas: Gender and Digital Empowerment, Public EdTech, and Just Digital Governance. Across these program areas, ITfC builds community\-owned digital models, shapes public discourse on digital rights, and strengthens the capacity of public institutions and civil society to design more accountable, inclusive digital ecosystems. 
 





 In the Public EdTech program area, we focus on designing and implementing inclusive digital pedagogies, promoting public software, and partnering with government institutions to strengthen the digital capacity of public education systems. Our work is rooted in the values of equity, openness, and critical engagement with technology. 
 





 We offer a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages continuous learning and growth, particularly for young professionals with a background in engineering, computer science, or education, looking to contribute to meaningful social change through technology.
 




  





**Position** 





 Project Assistant \- Technology
 




  





**Location** 





 Bengaluru, Karnataka
 





 (With regular travel to different locations across Karnataka and other states in India)
 




  





**Role** 





 We are looking for a committed and enthusiastic technology professional to join our team. This role involves providing organization\-wide technical support, supporting the implementation of education technology (EdTech) programmes, conducting technology training, managing digital resources, and promoting the use of Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) across organizational and field projects.
 





 The ideal candidate should enjoy working with technology and be interested in supporting teachers, schools, educational institutions, and project teams in effectively integrating technology into teaching, learning, and collaboration. Candidates with an interest in STEM education and hands\-on learning will have opportunities to support STEM\-related workshops and educational initiatives. This role combines technical support, field implementation, capacity building, and continuous learning in a collaborative NGO environment.
 





 As a member of the Technology Team, you will work closely with internal staff, educators, government institutions, and partner organizations to strengthen the meaningful use of technology in education.
 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Provide organization\-wide technical support to staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, networking, and system\-related issues.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot office IT infrastructure including internet connectivity, LAN/WAN networks, printers, projectors, smart TVs, conferencing systems, and workshop equipment.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux (Ubuntu) and other operating systems, along with Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) applications used across organizational and field projects.
* Provide technical support during teacher training programmes, workshops, conferences, webinars, and other educational events.
* Visit schools, colleges, and partner institutions to support the implementation of EdTech programmes, including STEM education initiatives, through hardware/software setup, troubleshooting, classroom support, and user assistance.
* Conduct and support technology orientation and training programmes for teachers, teacher educators, staff members, and partner organizations on the effective use of FOSS and other digital tools.
* Support project teams in creating, testing, and maintaining technology\-enabled educational resources using appropriate digital tools.
* Support digital collaboration platforms, organizational websites, and learning management systems such as Moodle, WordPress, Drupal, and MediaWiki.
* Work closely with programme teams during field visits and educational initiatives, providing technical and logistical support wherever required.



  





**Desired Qualifications** 





 Preferably B.Sc., BCA, BE/B.Tech, Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related disciplines.
 




  






 Note: Candidates with a B.Ed. (Mathematics/Science) along with good technical aptitude, or graduates from other disciplines with relevant hands\-on technical skills and a genuine interest in educational technology and STEM education, are also encouraged to apply.
 




  





**Desired Experience and Skills** 



* Candidates with 0–1 year of experience in technical support, ICT support, system administration, Linux administration, or related roles will be preferred.
* Strong ability to independently diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network\-related issues.
* Interest in using technology to support education, teacher professional development, STEM learning, and social sector initiatives.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, educational tools, and digital pedagogies.
* Willingness to travel across Karnataka and other parts of India for workshops, school visits, and programme implementation.
* Working knowledge of Linux operating systems (Ubuntu/Debian\-based) and familiarity with Free and Open Source Software (FOSS).
* Good understanding of computer hardware, networking concepts, internet configuration, peripheral device management, and system maintenance.
* Interest in installing, configuring, and troubleshooting operating systems and software applications.
* Fluency in English and Kannada (reading, writing, and speaking) is required. Basic spoken Hindi is desirable.



  





**Remuneration** 





 Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications and experience and will not be a constraint for the right candidate.
 




  





**How to Apply** 





 Interested candidates are requested to complete the application form using the link below:
 





 Application Form:
 
 https://forms.gle/VMK54dm3Ez4UoJSm6
 
  
 




  






 Last date to apply: 2nd September, 2026 \- Wednesday
