description:
Job Description – Optical Fiber Network Engineer

**Job Title:** Optical Fiber Network Engineer  
**Location:** Andaman  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**CTC Range:** ₹20,000 to ₹45,000 per month (depending on experience and technical expertise)  
**Certification Required:** CCNA Certification

Job Summary

We are looking for skilled and motivated **Optical Fiber Network Engineers** to join our team for locations in **Andaman**. The selected candidates will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, operation, and maintenance of optical fiber networks and associated networking infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

* Installation, commissioning, and maintenance of Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) networks.
* Perform fiber splicing, jointing, termination, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Conduct OTDR, Power Meter, and other optical fiber testing activities.
* Monitor and maintain network uptime and resolve fiber/network faults within defined timelines.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 network issues.
* Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, and other networking equipment.
* Perform network monitoring and preventive maintenance activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, test reports, and daily work reports.
* Coordinate with field teams, project teams, vendors, and customers for project execution.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.
* Support network expansion, upgrades, and migration activities as required.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* **Valid CCNA Certification is mandatory.**
* Good knowledge of networking concepts including:
* TCP/IP
* Routing and Switching
* VLAN
* IP Addressing and Subnetting
* LAN/WAN
* OSPF and other basic routing protocols
* Knowledge of Optical Fiber Network architecture and FTTH/Enterprise networks.
* Hands\-on experience with OTDR, Optical Power Meter, Splicing Machine, and related tools.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Willingness to travel and work at project locations, especially for the Andaman assignment.

Experience

**Preferred Experience:** 0 to 5 years in Optical Fiber Network, ISP, Telecom, or Networking Projects.

Freshers with a **valid CCNA Certification** and relevant technical knowledge may also be considered.

Compensation

**Monthly CTC:** ₹20,000 to ₹45,000

The final salary will be based on the candidate's **qualification, experience, technical skills, certification, and location of deployment**.

Preferred Candidate

* CCNA Certified.
* Experience in Optical Fiber Networks and active networking.
* Experience with ISP, Telecom, FTTH, Enterprise Network, or NOC operations will be preferred.
* Candidates willing to work at **Andaman locations**.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: GDS Cyber - CAOE - Staff - AI IT OT Network and Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Python / ML Developer
description:
About Sharedpro \-
 



 Sharedpro is an AI platform company building AI\-native products on a shared foundation of computer vision, audio\-ML, real\-time inference, vector search, and GPU model serving. Our products include AutoPilot Interview, Emotions API, TrueFace, Emotion Quest, and Pediatric Developmental Screening. We're a small, fast\-moving team where engineers take end\-to\-end ownership and ship real products every week.
 



  





 The Role \-
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Python / ML Developer with 4–6 years of experience to build the ML core of our AI products: a live AI voice interviewer, a facial expression / emotion measurement API, communication\-delivery scoring for interviews, and integrity / proctoring signals. You will own real\-time ML pipelines end\-to\-end — from data preparation and model training to low\-latency inference services running in production on our own GPU infrastructure. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role; you will work closely with the Technical Lead, product, and the frontend and backend teams. Prior experience in a startup or fast\-moving product environment is strongly preferred
 



  





 What You'll Do \-
 



 • Build and maintain production ML services in Python using FastAPI — REST APIs, WebSockets, and async pipelines designed around real\-time latency budgets. • Develop real\-time audio/speech pipelines: ASR with Whisper / faster\-whisper, voice\-activity detection (Silero VAD), prosody and speech features (praat\-parselmouth, librosa), and TTS integration. • Train, fine\-tune, and evaluate computer\-vision models with PyTorch — facial expression / emotion recognition, face detection with YOLOv8 / OpenCV / MediaPipe. • Integrate LLMs into products: prompt engineering, structured outputs, and resilient provider handling across Groq, Mistral, and OpenAI\-compatible endpoints (fallbacks, rate limits, cost and latency optimization). • Build retrieval and memory layers: embeddings, vector search with Qdrant, semantic matching across sessions. • Serve and optimize models on in\-house GPU infrastructure — Triton Inference Server / vLLM, fp16, batching, and throughput/latency tuning. • Design honest, evidence\-based scoring: calibration, bias checks, and explainable signals; treat privacy and PII handling as first\-class requirements. • Write well\-tested production code (pytest), add logging and monitoring, and take part in code reviews. • Own features end\-to\-end: prototype → production → measurement → iteration.
 



  





 Must\-Have • 6 \+ years of strong hands\-on Python development for production systems (not just notebooks or scripts). • Solid FastAPI experience (or Flask / Django) — REST APIs, WebSockets, async programming, and concurrency. • Hands\-on ML with PyTorch (training and inference) and computer vision with OpenCV. • Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI\-compatible endpoints) and practical prompt engineering. • Audio/speech ML exposure — ASR (Whisper), VAD, audio feature extraction — or demonstrated ability to go deep quickly. • SQL databases (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and comfort working on Linux servers. • Docker, Git, and CI/CD experience. • Testing discipline with pytest. • Strong problem\-solving, debugging, and communication skills. • Startup or fast\-moving product experience preferred.
 



  





 Good to Have • Model serving: Triton Inference Server, vLLM, ONNX, or TensorRT; GPU inference optimization, CUDA. • Vector databases (Qdrant), embeddings, and RAG pipelines. • MediaPipe, YOLO (ultralytics), and face\-analysis models. • praat\-parselmouth prosody analysis and speech\-feature engineering. • Responsible\-AI practices: calibration, bias mitigation, explainability; awareness of EU AI Act / NYC LL144\. • Basic React / TypeScript for demo frontends; Streamlit or Gradio for internal tools. • Kafka / RabbitMQ / Celery / Redis / Kubernetes. • AWS / Azure / GCP.
 



  





 Why Sharedpro • In\-house GPU infrastructure — train, serve, and optimize your own models. • Real\-world AI problems: voice agents, emotion recognition, speech scoring, and proctoring — not toy projects. • Small team with high ownership; ship real products every week. • End\-to\-end responsibility from data to model to production service. • Modern stack: PyTorch, Whisper, LLMs, Qdrant, Triton, FastAPI. • Freedom to make meaningful technical decisions in a fast\-moving startup environment.

description:
Own the AI agents that let teams run SuprSend in plain English — in the dashboard, in Slack, and in their editor.
 



  





**About SuprSend** 




 SuprSend is notification infrastructure for product and engineering teams. We give companies one platform to design, route, and deliver notifications across email, SMS, push, Slack, WhatsApp, and in\-app inbox — with workflows, templates, user preferences, and delivery analytics built in. Developers integrate once and stop maintaining notification plumbing forever.
 



  





**Why this role** 




 Over the past year we've shipped an AI layer on top of that infrastructure:
 


* **Agent** 
 : a chat surface inside the SuprSend dashboard that queries a workspace, builds workflows, templates, and schemas, pulls analytics, and debugs delivery.
* **Slack Agent:** 
 the same capabilities inside Slack, with a Privacy Filter that keeps PII out of shared channels.
* **MCP Server, Agent Plugin \& SDK:** 
 an MCP server plus agent skills that drop SuprSend into Claude Code and GitHub / VS Code Copilot, so developers manage notifications without leaving their editor.



  





 Next, we're building even more deeper capabilities \- so any AI client can work with SuprSend securely. Also, teaching the agents to work from
 **documents, images, and voice** 
 , so a customer can drop in a PRD and get the workflows, segments, templates, and translations to match.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated AI engineer — owning these products day to day and shaping where they go. You'll work directly with the founders and the core engineering team, ship to real customers in production, and have unusually high ownership for the level. This is a builder role: you write the code, run the evals, watch the dashboards, and decide what ships.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Develop, maintain, and improve our agent products — Agent, Slack Agent, and the Agent Plugin — and the MCP servers and apps behind them.
* Build multimodal capabilities into the agents: turn uploaded documents, images, and (over time) voice into SuprSend assets — a dropped\-in PRD becomes the workflows, segments, templates, and translations to match.
* Design tool\-calling agents that act reliably against live customer workspaces — clean tool design, grounding, error handling, least\-privilege tool access, server\-side permission enforcement, and human approval on state\-mutating actions.
* Own context engineering for the agents — retrieval, memory, and context compaction — so they stay accurate and affordable as conversations and workspaces grow.
* Build and own the evaluation harness across three tiers — fast tool\-call checks in CI, nightly LLM\-as\-judge regression suites, and production drift monitoring — measuring trajectory as well as final output, so changes to prompts, models, and tools ship on evidence instead of vibes.
* Run agents in production: tracing and observability, failure handling, prompt and model version management, and keeping quality, latency, and cost in a healthy place.
* Build and operate MCP servers and apps, including the auth and tooling that let external AI clients use SuprSend safely.
* Partner with product and engineering to turn customer problems into agent capabilities, then close the loop using real usage and eval data.



  





**What you'll bring** 



* \~2–4 years building software, with meaningful recent time spent shipping LLM\-powered features or agents to
 **production** 
 — not just prototypes or demos.
* Strong
 **Python** 
 . You're comfortable owning a production Python service end to end.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (across providers like OpenAI and Anthropic) and at least one agent framework (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable): tool / function calling, structured outputs, and multi\-step flows.
* **Context engineering** 
 — you treat the context window as a budget, not an afterthought: retrieval, memory, compaction, and curating which tools and data are in scope per request.
* Real experience
 **running agents or LLM features in production** 
 — you understand non\-determinism, latency and token cost, version management, and what breaks at scale.
* Practical experience with
 **evals** 
 : you've built or maintained eval pipelines (offline and online), used LLM\-as\-judge or rule\-based scoring, evaluated the agent's trajectory and not just its final answer, and relied on them to catch regressions and gate releases.
* **Security\-aware by default** 
 — you understand prompt injection and tool poisoning, apply least privilege to tool access, and reach for human approval on anything that mutates customer data.
* Solid engineering fundamentals — APIs, data modeling, testing, observability, and code other people can maintain.
* Product sense and customer empathy. You can decide what's worth building and what "good enough" looks like for a real user.



  





**Bonus points** 



* **Multimodal models** 
 — document and image understanding; voice / speech\-to\-text a plus.
* **Model\-agnostic design** 
 — model routing, handling model upgrades and deprecations, prompt caching, and using small / cheap models for routing and classification.
* **Hosted / remote MCP** 
 — Streamable HTTP transport, OAuth 2\.1 and scoped, short\-lived tokens; experience building or consuming MCP servers and clients.
* **Memory systems** 
 — short\- and long\-term memory and persistence across threads.
* **Agent\-interop awareness** 
 — A2A and the broader protocol landscape (the Agentic AI Foundation standards).
* **Domain and surfaces** 
 — the developer\-tools or notification / messaging space; Slack apps, IDE / editor extensions, or CLI tooling.



  





**How we work** 



* In\-office in Bengaluru, collaborating closely with a small, senior team that ships fast.
* High autonomy and direct access to founders — your work reaches customers in days, not quarters.
* Pragmatic and developer\-first: we care about reliability, good DX, and honest engineering over hype.
* The space moves fast. We value people who evaluate new tools and models on their merits and adopt the right ones — without chasing every launch.

 We're building a cross\-platform
 **Electron** 
 desktop application for real\-time instrument control and signal visualization
 **TypeScript**

 n the renderer, and a Node main process owning device I/O, session state, and persistence. * Integrate the application with instrument hardware and a separate signal\-processing engine across process and network boundaries.
* Work through native interfaces where a JavaScript path isn't suitable.
* Define and version wire contracts, handle binary payloads, and diagnose faults that cross process/network boundaries.
* Own build, packaging, and release: signed and notarized installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* Manage artifact publication and an OTA update channel for installed clients.
* Maintain and troubleshoot automated cross\-platform CI/CD pipelines, including their failure modes.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years building production web or desktop applications.
* Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a solid grasp of renders, effects, and state boundaries.
* Real Node.js experience, either server\-side or in a desktop main process.
* Demonstrated ability to own a feature end\-to\-end — data layer, UI, and the release that ships it.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD — able to read a pipeline, diagnose a failed job, and fix it.
* Git fluency and clear written communication, since project context lives largely in commits and tickets.


**Strongly Desirable**
* Experience with Electron, including its process model and IPC security.
* Desktop packaging and release experience — installers, versioning, code signing, notarization.
* Auto\-update / OTA implementation for desktop applications.
* Cloud delivery experience — publishing and hosting build artifacts, along with related access control.
* CI pipeline authoring, ideally with cross\-platform builds.

* Real\-time data visualization experience — canvas/WebGL charting or a signal\-processing background.
* Monorepo tooling at scale.
* Storybook and design\-system work.
* Exposure to scientific instruments, medical devices, or hardware\-adjacent software.

title: Software Engineer
description:
What We Do
 
 FlytBase is an AI\-native company building the Physical AI layer for the sky. Its platform powers fully autonomous drone\-in\-a\-box operations across energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure sites worldwide—integrating drones, docks, edge AI, and enterprise workflows into one intelligent system. Headquartered in California with a fast\-moving engineering base in Pune, FlytBase is redefining how the physical world is monitored and managed. The company operates at AI speed, with autonomy and intelligence at its core. At FlytBase, teams work in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI isn’t a side project—it’s the operating system for how they think, build, and grow.
 



  





 With 300\+ global deployments and 50\+ partners in our ecosystem, FlytBase is powering the shift from human\-operated to self\-driven skies. Our platform transforms off\-the\-shelf drones into intelligent systems that sync effortlessly with enterprise infrastructure.
 



  




 The Role
 
 We’re not looking for “junior devs” who wait for tasks.
 



  





 We want AI\-native engineers who can ship meaningfully, move fast, and solve real problems across the stack.
 



  





 This role is about building production\-grade systems—backend services, cloud architecture, frontend dashboards, automation pipelines—using AI copilots and modern dev stacks to unlock 10× velocity.
 



  





 You won’t be training ML models.
 



  





 You will be coding with AI, debugging with AI, architecting with AI, and shipping software that powers live autonomous missions globally.
 



  





 If you crave ownership, speed, and building tech that actually runs in the real world, this is your playground.
 



  




 What You'll Own
 
 • Backend \& API Development (1–3 YOE) → Build, scale, and maintain microservices and APIs powering real\-time drone ops.
 



 • AI\-Native Development → Use Cursor/Windsurf/Copilot to write cleaner code, debug faster, and accelerate delivery.
 



 • Systems Thinking → Work across backend, cloud, integrations, and distributed systems—no rigid silos.
 



 • High\-Velocity Execution → Prototype fast, iterate with feedback, and ship production\-ready features.
 



 • Cloud \& Infra → Own services deployed on AWS/GCP/Kubernetes that support global autonomous deployments.
 



 • Cross\-Team Engineering → Collaborate with robotics, AI, and product teams to build features end\-to\-end.
 



  




 Best Suited For
 
 • AI\-First Engineer → Someone who codes with AI tools by default, not occasionally.
 



 • Strong Backend Fundamentals → DS/Algo basics, concurrency, API design, scalable services.
 



 • Full\-Stack Mindset → Backend\-heavy but not allergic to touching UI, dashboards, or integrations.
 



 • Outcome\-Driven Builder → You care about shipping value, not writing 500 lines of “perfect” code.
 



 • Rapid Learner → You pick up tools, stacks, and workflows fast without hand\-holding.
 



  





 Our Stack (Flexible)
 



  





 We don’t hire based on a specific stack—we hire for velocity and fundamentals.
 



  





 • Backend → Python, Node.js, Go, Rust
 



 • Frontend → React, Vue, Angular
 



 • Cloud \& Infra → AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD
 



 • Workflows → Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, GPT, automation pipelines, testing frameworks
 



  





 If you’ve used AI tools to build faster, you’ll feel at home.
 



  




 What Makes You a Flyter
 
 • You use AI tools as your co\-engineer
 



 • You move fast without breaking reliability
 



 • You jump stacks instead of staying in your lane
 



 • You thrive in messy, ambiguous, high\-impact problem spaces
 



 • You want your code running on fleets of autonomous robots
 



 • You bias toward action and clarity, not waiting for perfection
 



  




 What We Don't Want
 
 • Engineers who ship slowly and blame “dependencies”
 



 • People who need micro\-managed clarity handed to them
 



 • Devs who avoid understanding product or user context
 



 • Anyone who says “that’s not my stack” or “not my job”
 



 • Hours\-loggers \> impact\-makers
 



 • Passive coders who rely only on tutorials, not thinking
 



  




 Why FlytBase?
 
 • You won’t just write code—you’ll build frontier tech in AI × robotics
 



 • Your work will run in mission\-critical, global deployments
 



 • You’ll work with high\-agency engineers shipping at startup velocity
 



 • Unlimited access to AI tooling and automation workflows
 



 • Freedom to experiment, prototype, and build bold ideas
 



  




 The Perks
 
 • Competitive compensation
 



 • AI\-native dev environment with top\-tier tools
 



 • High\-agency culture with real ownership
 



 • Flexible hours with core on\-site Pune collaboration
 



 • Direct impact on a globally deployed, high\-stakes product
 



 • Unlimited PTO

**Job Description – 3D Designer \& Visualization Artist** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 The 3D Designer \& Visualization Artist will create high\-quality
 **3D models, photorealistic renders, design presentations, and visual walkthroughs** 
 for mobile and modular projects.
 



 The role requires a balance of creativity and technical understanding. The selected candidate should be able to produce attractive visuals while ensuring designs are structurally practical, dimensionally accurate, and aligned with actual fabrication processes.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop detailed 3D models of food trucks, food trailers, kiosks, mobile kitchens, retail outlets, speciality vehicles, and modular structures.
* Convert CAD drawings, floor plans, elevations, sketches, reference images, and client briefs into accurate 3D models.
* Create exterior and interior visualizations, including:
* Front, rear, and side views
* Three\-quarter perspective views
* Top and roof views
* Interior kitchen and service\-area views
* Day and night renders
* Open and closed operational configurations
* Site\-placement and environmental visualizations
* Branding and colour\-scheme alternatives
* Develop photorealistic renders with appropriate materials, textures, lighting, reflections, shadows, and environmental context.
* Visualize structural elements such as chassis, wheels, tow bars, serving hatches, entry doors, windows, counters, equipment, and signage.
* Create realistic material finishes for MS, stainless steel, ACP, glass, wood, laminates, corrugated sheets, paint, vinyl graphics, and illuminated signage.
* Apply client branding, logos, menu graphics, colour palettes, and signage accurately to 3D designs.
* Prepare multiple design options for client presentations and internal reviews.
* Design interior layouts considering equipment dimensions, staff movement, service workflow, storage, and available space.
* Create presentation boards, material palettes, mood boards, and concept sheets.
* Produce short walkthroughs, turntable animations, and product\-explainer videos when required.
* Place designs realistically within petrol pumps, parks, highways, commercial complexes, event spaces, and other intended environments.
* Coordinate with CAD technicians, graphic designers, project managers, production supervisors, and fabricators.
* Review the technical feasibility of visual concepts before presenting them to clients.
* Incorporate client feedback and maintain proper version and revision control.
* Organize and maintain a structured library of 3D models, materials, textures, equipment, vehicle components, and environmental assets.
* Support the sales team with visual content for proposals, presentations, tenders, social media, and marketing campaigns.
* Visit the production facility to understand construction methods and compare completed units with approved visualizations.



**Expected Deliverables** 




 Depending on the project, the designer may be required to produce:
 


* Exterior 3D models
* Interior 3D models
* Photorealistic day and night renders
* All\-side rendered elevations
* Exploded or cutaway views
* Equipment\-placement visualizations
* Branding mock\-ups
* Colour and material alternatives
* Site\-integration views
* 360\-degree views
* Turntable animations
* Walkthrough videos
* Client\-presentation boards
* Social media and marketing visuals



**Essential Software Skills** 




**3D Modelling – Strong proficiency in at least one:** 



* SketchUp

**Rendering – Proficiency in one or more:**

description:
**The Role** 




  MI\-RA (Multimodal Intelligence for Real\-World Applications) Lab at iHub is one of India's most complete synchronized multimodal capture and compute labs: a 16\-camera volumetric rig, OptiTrack motion capture, LiDAR, mmWave radar, an anechoic audio array, and a full physiological suite, all bound to a single master clock. We turn that captured reality into digital twins, sim\-to\-real training data, and validated Physical AI for partners across healthcare, robotics, manufacturing, and mobility.
 



  
 



 We are hiring a
 **Simulation Engineer** 
 to build the virtual side of this pipeline. We seek candidates with experience in
 **mechanical and physical simulation** 
 (Finite Element Analysis, Computational Fluid Dynamics , and multiphysics simulation
 **), systems and process simulation** 
 (Discrete\-Event Simulation, robotics simulation, and process control simulation), or
 **electronics and software simulation** 
 (Circuit/Very Large\-Scale Integration (VLSI) simulation, digital twin development, and physics\-based simulation).
 



  
 



 The role will involve building digital twins, working on physics simulation, 3D reconstruction, robotics simulation, and the engagement in NVIDIA Physical AI stack.
 



  
 



**Responsibilities:** 




 ·
 **Digital twins.** 
 Building digital twins of factory cells, clinical spaces, and outdoor scenes from MI\-RA capture data, and keeping them in sync with the physical world.
 



 · 
 **Simulation and Sim\-to\-Real** 
 . Setting up robotics and human\-in\-the\-loop simulations, running sim\-to\-real experiments, and measuring the gap between simulated and measured behaviour.
 



 · 
 **3D reconstruction.** 
 Reconstructing scenes from multi\-view video and sensor data (Gaussian Splatting, NeRF\-family methods, neural reconstruction) and preparing them for downstream training.
 



 ·
 **Data plumbing.** 
 Wiring real\-time and batch data pipelines from lab sensors, ROS 2, and industrial protocols into the simulator, with proper schema and provenance discipline.
 



 ·
 **Validation.** 
 Running validation on synthetic and generated data: temporal alignment, calibration, and anomaly checks so bad data does not poison downstream models.
 



 · 
 **Productization.** 
 Packaging your work as reusable services (containers, inference microservices) and documenting it so faculty, industry partners, and future team members can build on it.
 



  





**Core Experience and Skills Required:** 




 · Experience in one or more areas of simulation, including in
 **mechanical and physical simulation** 
 (Finite Element Analysis, Computational Fluid Dynamics , and multiphysics simulation
 **), systems and process simulation** 
 (Discrete\-Event Simulation, robotics simulation, and process control simulation), or
 **electronics and software simulation** 
 (Circuit/Very Large\-Scale Integration (VLSI) simulation, digital twin development, and physics\-based simulation).
 



 · Strong Python; comfortable in C\+\+ or CUDA when performance matters.
 



 · Practical experience with at least one modern simulation environment: NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, Ansys, COMSOL, Unity, or Unreal.
 



 · Working knowledge of the NVIDIA ecosystem (any subset of Isaac, Omniverse, OpenUSD, Cosmos, NuRec, PhysicsNeMo, NIM, Triton, or Holoscan), and a demonstrated habit of keeping up with new releases.
 



 · Foundations in rigid\-body dynamics, coordinate frames, and 3D geometry; comfort with PyTorch or JAX for anything model\-shaped.
 



 · The usual professional toolkit: Linux, Docker, Git, and a habit of writing tests and documentation without being asked.
 



**Qualification** 




 M.Tech / M.E. preferred; B.Tech with a strong portfolio equally welcome. 2 to 4 years of post\-degree experience.
 



**Desirable Experience \& Skills:** 




 ·   Prior work on a shipped digital twin in industry, healthcare, mobility, or infrastructure.
 



 ·   Hands\-on with 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF variants, or differentiable rendering.
 



 ·  Experience with vision\-language\-action models, GR00T\-style pipelines, MimicGen, or synthetic data generation at scale.
 



 ·   Familiarity with multi\-view capture, camera calibration, or motion capture workflows.
 



 ·  Open\-source contributions, publications at CVPR / ICRA / RSS / CoRL / SIGGRAPH, or NVIDIA\-DLI certifications.
 



 ·  Exposure to regulated environments (medical devices, automotive, aerospace) where simulation supports evidence.
 



 · If you are working in this field and this description sounds like the kind of work you want to do next, please apply.
 



**Renumeration:** 




  Up to INR 60,000/\- per month based on experience.

 Preferred Qualifications

Experience with partner ecosystems is a strong plus, but not required. Experience with sales, marketing, analytics, or business platforms is highly desirable.

**Company Description** 




 Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai \& Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in\-house proprietary algorithms and crowd\-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com
 



  





**Job Description** 




**About the Role:** 




 As a Product Manager \- Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end\-to\-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.
 



 You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high\-volume, high\-stakes product area.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
* Post\-Booking Experience: Own key post\-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
* Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search\-to\-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add\-ons — to reduce drop\-offs and improve conversion at every step
* Partner Onboarding \& Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
* Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user\-centric designs
* Data\-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 4–6 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high\-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel\-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
* Funnel \& Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high\-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
* User\-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end\-to\-end travel booking experience, including post\-booking needs
* Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
* Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross\-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high\-quality features in an agile environment



  





**Additional (Preferred):** 



* OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
* Partnership \& Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
* AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
* Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion



  





**Additional Information** 




 Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

**Company Overview** 




  





**Nykaa Fashion** 
 is one of India's leading fashion and lifestyle destinations, offering a curated selection of apparel, footwear, accessories, jewellery, and home products from both global and homegrown brands. Operating on an omnichannel model with a robust digital presence, Nykaa Fashion delivers a seamless and personalized shopping experience to millions of customers across the country. Driven by technology, data, and a strong focus on customer experience, Nykaa Fashion is redefining the way India discovers and shops for fashion.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 As a Product Manager II – Product Discovery, you will own the customer experience across Search and Product Listing Pages (PLPs), helping millions of users effortlessly discover products that best meet their needs.
 



 Your mission is to simplify product discovery by designing intuitive browsing and shopping experiences that reduce friction, minimize cognitive overload, and enable customers to make confident purchase decisions. You will shape how customers navigate large product catalogs, refine choices, explore relevant products, and discover inspiration—all while balancing customer experience with business outcomes.
 



 This role is ideal for someone with exceptional product intuition, strong analytical thinking, and a deep appreciation for user experience design. You should enjoy solving ambiguous consumer problems, using customer insights and experimentation to guide decisions, and partnering closely with Design to build elegant, scalable experiences.
 



 You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Merchandising, and Business teams to define the future of product discovery at Nykaa.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Own the Product Discovery Experience
 


* Define and drive the long\-term vision and roadmap for discovery experiences across Search and Product Listing Pages.
* Continuously improve how customers browse, evaluate, compare, and discover products across large and diverse catalogs.
* Design intuitive customer journeys that reduce effort and help users quickly find products that best match their intent.
* Balance inspiration and efficiency by creating experiences that support both exploratory browsing and goal\-oriented shopping



 2\. Build Best\-in\-Class Browsing Experiences
 


* Design intuitive filtering, sorting, navigation, and product refinement experiences that simplify customer decision\-making.
* Continuously improve discovery flows by reducing friction, eliminating unnecessary complexity, and making interfaces easier to navigate.
* Partner closely with Design to create clean, elegant, and scalable shopping experiences that prioritize usability and clarity.
* Leverage customer insights to improve how information is presented, helping users make confident purchasing decisions with less effort.



 3\. Leverage AI to Improve Customer Discovery
 


* Identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully enhance product discovery and customer decision\-making.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to build intelligent discovery experiences using customer behavior, personalization signals, and modern AI capabilities.
* Explore emerging interaction models, including conversational and intent\-aware experiences, where they create measurable customer value.
* Ensure AI\-powered experiences remain intuitive, trustworthy, and easy to understand.



 4\. Drive Product Decisions Through Data
 


* Build a strong experimentation culture through rigorous A/B testing and hypothesis\-driven product development.
* Analyze customer behavior, browsing journeys, funnel metrics, and product discovery patterns to uncover improvement opportunities.
* Define and own key product metrics related to discovery efficiency, engagement, customer satisfaction, and business impact.
* Combine quantitative analysis with qualitative customer research to deeply understand user needs and validate product decisions.



 5\. Lead Cross\-functional Execution
 


* Lead large, cross\-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Data Science, Merchandising, and Business teams.
* Translate customer problems into clear product strategies, PRDs, and measurable success metrics.
* Influence senior stakeholders through structured thinking, customer insights, and data\-backed decision\-making.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to strengthening product management practices across the organization.



  





**Required Skillset** 



* Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree from a Tier 1 institution, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* Experience \- 3\+ years of Product Management experience building customer\-facing products in consumer internet or B2C e\-commerce companies. Experience in beauty, fashion, marketplace, or retail e\-commerce is preferred
* Demonstrated ownership of complex product areas with measurable customer and business impact.
* Product Thinking \& UX \- Exceptional product sense with a strong understanding of customer behavior and shopping journeys.
* Proven experience designing intuitive consumer experiences in partnership with Product Design teams.
* Ability to simplify complex workflows into elegant, easy\-to\-use customer experiences.
* Strong appreciation for interaction design, information architecture, and usability principles.
* Analytical Excellence\- Strong analytical skills with expertise in product metrics, funnel analysis, experimentation, and behavioral analytics
* Technical Fluency \- Comfortable working with Engineering and Data Science teams to build scalable consumer products. Ability to understand technical trade\-offs and collaborate effectively on AI\-enabled product capabilities without needing deep machine learning expertise.
* Leadership \- Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to influence across teams and senior leadership



  





**Good to Have** 




 • Prior experience with search platforms, recommendation systems, or catalog quality tooling.
 



 • Exposure to LLM\-based product development, prompt engineering, or AI product prototyping.
 



 • Familiarity with beauty, fashion, or lifestyle e\-commerce and the nuances of catalog\-driven search.

**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
 This position provides Project Management leadership \& is responsible for regional end\-to\-end Product Development projects leading cross\-functional teams across multiple product lines, with KPIs such as Launch on Time, Budget, Cost \& Quality
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Leverage structured new product development process and stage gate frameworks to lead project activities from initial RFQ through the entire project development and release lifecycle
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources to ensure smooth project delivery (including timeline, schedule, budget, quality, and deliverables)
* Conduct regular cadence of project meetings, document meeting minutes, and assign and maintain action rails; Follow up with appropriate action owners when necessary
* Manage project stakeholders, including core team members and leadership functions
* Prepare and present projects to the leadership team to effectively communicate project updates and gain project governance approvals
* Monitor and maintain risk and issues logs, and escalate when appropriate
* Proactively identify and communicate escalations around challenges, gaps, support required and resource needs to quickly address issues before they impede successful delivery of the program
* Encourage strategic thinking from the team throughout a project lifecycle
* Continuous improvement mindset


**What Your Background Should Look Like**
* 3\+ years of relevant experience supporting projects, product development, or project coordination
* Experience working with global team environments
* Understanding of stage\-gate processing
* Experience in effect project planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and risk analysis
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence
* Excellent at developing and maintaining good working relationships
* Fluent in English with good verbal and written communication skills across all levels (both internally and externally)


**Competencies**
 SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)
   

  

**About Te Connectivity**
 TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

title: Project Analyst (India)
description:
As a
 **Project Analyst** 
 , you will support Agile project delivery, project governance, compliance tracking, stakeholder management, and business analysis activities for technology transformation initiatives. You will act as both a facilitator of Agile ceremonies and a coordinator of governance and reporting, ensuring projects are delivered successfully and aligned with organisational standards.
 



  





**What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed** 




  





**Agile Delivery \& Facilitation** 



* Serve as Scrum Master and facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand‑ups, Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Drive continuous improvement and Agile best practices across teams.
* Support project planning, milestone tracking, RAID management, and project coordination.



  





**Governance \& Reporting** 



* Prepare governance reports, dashboards, executive updates, and PMO artefacts.
* Track compliance deliverables, audit findings, regulatory obligations, and remediation actions.
* Monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and action items.



  





**Business Analysis \& Requirements Management** 



* Gather and document business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Support technology transformation initiatives by aligning requirements with delivery models.



  





**Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination** 



* Coordinate stakeholders, vendors, and project teams to ensure successful delivery.
* Provide clear communication and manage expectations across departments.



  





**We’d Love to Hear From You If…** 




  





**Experience** 



* You have 5–8 years of experience in Project Analyst, PMO, Scrum Master, Business Analyst, or Project Coordination roles.
* You have experience in Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
* You have supported technology transformation or enterprise application projects.



  





**Technical Expertise** 



* You are skilled in Agile Scrum and Kanban practices.
* You are proficient in project governance and PMO reporting.
* You are experienced in business analysis and requirements management.
* You are knowledgeable in compliance, risk, and audit tracking.
* You are proficient with Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office.
* You hold certifications such as CSM or PSM, PMP or PMI‑ACP, or ITIL Foundation (preferred).



  





**Ways of Working** 



* You demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* You collaborate effectively across teams and vendors.
* You are proactive in driving continuous improvement.
* You balance governance discipline with Agile flexibility.
* You remain organised and detail‑oriented in managing deliverables.



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**Who We Are** 




  





 Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan\-Asian presence. We focus primarily around technology\-driven consulting, adoption of value\-added bespoke solutions, enabling enhanced decision support through data analytics, and embracing possibilities in the cloud. We are heavily inclined towards building capabilities collaboratively with clients and believe strongly in improving grounded and practical outcomes.
 



  





 This approach is possible through our partnership with leading global technology providers and internal R\&D teams. Our clients come from Financial Services, Banking, Telco, Government, Healthcare, and Consumer\-oriented organisations.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Broadband Plasma Division (BBP) provides market\-leading patterned wafer optical inspection systems for leading\-edge IC manufacturing. Logic, foundry, and memory customers depend on BBP products to detect yield\-critical defects for process debug and excursion monitoring at advanced process nodes. BBP flagship products include the 29xx and 39xx series which leverage Broadband Plasma technology to capture a wide range of defects with ultimate sensitivity at the optical inspection speeds needed for inline defect monitoring.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 As a Software Engineer, you will join our Dynamic Team on the journey to Modernize our product and deliver Innovative Software solutions to our customers. You will develop the User Interface and Business Logic for real time, high speed optical systems that use cutting edge Computer Vision and Deep Learning Technology to deliver best of breed products. You will collaborate with various teams to contribute to the success of the entire organization. As a member of the team a successful candidate will be expected to develop a deep understanding of the system and software architecture. Successful candidates will have very strong software engineering skills as well as a passion for working with strong STEM based projects.
   

  

* Responsible for the design, development, testing and roll out of software solutions that enhance the capabilities of the KLA inspection products.
* Possess good communication skills to work with several hardware and software interdisciplinary teams to understand the system/marketing requirements and to map them to software requirements and design.
* Candidate should (over time) develop deep understanding of how the system works and be able to provide software solutions for critical customer gaps or issues. Develop and evaluate concepts and designs for the next generation systems by conducting trade\-off studies, identifying risk items and suggest mitigation plans.
* Work in a geographically distributed team to develop and deliver software solutions.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where communication and collaboration with a large multi\-disciplinary team is a significant part of the job. That is, coding is not the only skill needed for this job. While documentation and other offline support will be available, interacting with stakeholders will remain an indispensable part of understanding what needs to be done, and validating the work that is done.
* Good debugging skills in a complex software setup involving multi\-process/multiple systems in Windows / Linux environment with good OS concepts


**Qualifications**
* Holds a degree MS/MCA/MTech
* Strong in programming fundamentals, C\+\+ / C\# / .NET Core / .NET Framework and Angular with good software design exposure
* Excellent software engineering skills, including deep conceptual and applied knowledge of OOP, design patterns, data structures, distributed systems, multi\-threaded and multi\-process programming.
* Ability to take abstract problem statements and detail them out into concrete requirements and design through collaborative discussions.
* Possess good communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Comprehensive understanding of SDLC and software engineering principles
* Adept in advanced debugging and troubleshooting methods.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree or work experience of 0 years , Bachelor's Level Degree with work experience of 2\+ years
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Consultant - Product Designer (AI Products)
description:
We build enterprise software for accounting, audit and compliance teams. Our products are used by large global organisations, where getting things wrong has real consequences. Most of our current work is AI — both new AI\-native products and AI features inside our compliance and risk products that read documents, track regulatory changes and help people make decisions faster. We are looking for a designer to work on these. You will be part of a small design team, working closely with product managers, engineers and the AI team.
 



  





**What you do** 



* Design AI\-driven product experiences, from early problem framing through to shipped screens
* Work out how AI output should reach a person, what they see, what they decide, and what stays automatic
* Design complex workflows for compliance, audit and risk users, including edge cases and error states
* Build prototypes to test ideas before engineering commits time
* Contribute to our design system and keep it consistent as the products grow • Work directly with engineers through build and QA, not just handover



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 3\+ years designing web products, ideally B2B or enterprise
* Comfortable with complexity. Our users are experts and they need detail, not fewer options
* Strong interaction and UI skills, and fluent in Figma
* Interest in AI as part of your own workflow, prototyping, exploration, whatever makes you faster
* Able to work through ambiguous problems without waiting for a finished brief
* Clear communicator who can explain why a design decision was made
* Experience with data\-heavy interfaces, dashboards or tables
* Familiarity with HTML and CSS, or AI coding tools
* Any exposure to finance, audit, compliance or other regulated domains.

title: Product Designer I
description:
**Role Description**
 Role Overview
   

  

 As a
 **Product Designer I / Associate III – Product Design** 
 , you will be responsible for designing and developing
 **human\-centred digital products and experiences** 
 that are intuitive, accessible, visually engaging, and aligned with business objectives. You will work collaboratively with product, technology, business, and design teams to translate product vision and customer needs into meaningful, scalable design solutions.
   

  

 The role requires a strong understanding of
 **Human\-Centred Design (HCD), Service Design, UX/UI, Interaction Design, Visual Design, and Prototyping** 
 , along with the ability to solve complex design problems across multiple digital platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Contribute to Human\-Centred Design and Service Design deliverables, including customer journeys, empathy maps, service blueprints, personas, experience maps, and other design artefacts.
* Define and establish interaction and visual design for a variety of digital interfaces, including websites, mobile applications, kiosks, wearables, games, and other emerging platforms.
* Translate brand guidelines into compelling digital brand expressions, visual systems, screen layouts, and user experiences that consistently reflect the brand's voice and identity.
* Design user flows, interaction models, wireframes, low\- and high\-fidelity mock\-ups, prototypes, MVPs, beta experiences, and production\-ready interfaces.
* Create intuitive user interface elements and detailed UX specifications while adhering to established Design Language Systems (DLS), Design Systems, accessibility standards, and brand guidelines.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Engineers, Business Stakeholders, Researchers, and fellow Designers throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Work on multiple complex product and platform challenges simultaneously, balancing user needs, business objectives, technical constraints, and brand considerations.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing products and experiences through research, usability insights, design exploration, and iterative prototyping.
* Incorporate Generative AI and emerging design technologies into ideation, exploration, content creation, prototyping, and design workflows where appropriate.
* Communicate design rationale and recommendations effectively through presentations, storytelling, workshops, and design reviews.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 
  

  

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in a relevant discipline such as:
+ Product Design
+ Interaction Design
+ Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI)
+ Service Design
+ Visual Communication
+ New Media Design
+ Universal Design
+ Digital Design or a related field

* 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in digital/product design.
* Strong practical knowledge and project experience in Human\-Centred Design and Service Design.
* Demonstrated experience designing digital products, platforms, and end\-to\-end user experiences.
* Strong foundation in visual design principles, including colour, typography, composition, hierarchy, grids, screen layouts, and visual storytelling.
* Experience with motion design, micro\-interactions, transitions, dynamic interactions, and interactive UI elements.
* Advanced hands\-on proficiency in Figma, including component\-based design, prototyping, design systems, and collaborative workflows.

* Strong understanding of responsive web design, usability, accessibility, cross\-browser compatibility, cross\-platform experiences, and front\-end development constraints.
* Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and navigate complex design problems from concept through implementation.
* Strong visual communication, presentation, storytelling, documentation, and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* A strong design portfolio demonstrating high\-quality digital/product design work is mandatory.

* Experience using Generative AI tools for ideation, design exploration, content generation, prototyping, and workflow acceleration.

title: Solutions Engineer (0–3 Years)
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 This role is purpose\-built for technically strong early\-career professionals who are ready to take their technical skills into a customer\-facing seat. Whether you have 0–3 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, or a related technical field — or you are a recent graduate with strong internship experience — this is worth a serious look.
 



  





 As a Solution Engineer at Hevo, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the
 ***US Market***
 . You will help them understand their data challenges, design the right data architecture, walk them through trade\-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a long\-term partnership.
 



 You will do this independently — often as the technical voice on the call. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e\-commerce company, understand their requirements, explain technical concepts clearly, and build confidence throughout the engagement.
 



 Your technical foundation does not go away. It gets applied to a wider set of problems, a larger audience, and a genuinely global stage.
 



 Hevo runs real\-time data pipelines from 150\+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies worldwide — including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH YOUR CONSIDERATION** 




**A. You move from building solutions to shaping data strategy** 




 In most engineering roles, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them understand what to build — across the full modern data stack. Your technical foundation in SQL, databases, data pipelines, cloud technologies, and engineering becomes the foundation for higher\-leverage, higher\-visibility work.
 



**B. You get global exposure early in your career** 




 You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast\-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, learn to defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where real decisions get made. This kind of exposure early in your career is uncommon anywhere — and almost unheard of from Bengaluru.
 



**C. Your technical depth stays central** 




 This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, SQL, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and data pipelines gets used every day. The difference is that your technical knowledge helps shape the customer's architecture — instead of living inside a Jira ticket.
 



**D. The career path is real** 




 Strong performers in this role can grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the SE function, or move into product, customer success leadership, solutions architecture, or other technical customer\-facing positions. The optionality this role builds is significant.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




 Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations — primarily with customers in North America and Europe — and you will learn to own them end to end.
 



 Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo integrates into the customer's existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).
 



 Deliver live product demos tailored to each customer's environment. These are not scripted walkthroughs — you will read the room, adapt in real time, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
 



 Support the technical evaluation from first conversation through to closed deal — addressing technical questions and building trust with engineering teams.
 



 Build proof\-of\-concept pipelines by configuring real connections from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
 



 Develop deep expertise across the data integration landscape — including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (Glue, Data Factory, Dataflow) — and articulate Hevo's technical advantages in a way that resonates with both technical and non\-technical buyers.
 



 Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and work closely with Customer Success to ensure smooth, high\-quality handoffs post\-deal.
 



 Feed customer insights and recurring patterns back to Product and Engineering to meaningfully influence the roadmap.
 



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Must\-Haves** 




**0–3 years of experience** 
 in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, or a related technical field.
 *Recent graduates with strong technical projects, internships, or relevant hands\-on experience are also encouraged to apply.* 




 Strong SQL fundamentals and working knowledge of databases and data engineering concepts.
 



 Working knowledge of at least one cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift — through professional, internship, academic, or project experience.
 



 Exposure to at least one orchestration or transformation tool such as Airflow, dbt, or similar is preferred.
 



  





**Exceptional communication and presentation skills — this is non\-negotiable.** 
 You will be the face of Hevo's technical capability to a global customer base. Specifically:
 



 Your spoken English is clear, confident, and accessible to an international audience.
 



 You are comfortable presenting technical concepts to groups and communicating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders over video calls.
 



 You can structure a technical narrative — not just answer questions, but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion.
 



 You have presented or demo'd something technical to an audience before — whether in academic projects, internships, internal reviews, client calls, meetups, hackathons, or conferences.
 



 Genuine interest in working directly with customers and solving their problems — even if you have not done so formally before.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 Experience building data pipelines or ETL/ELT workflows through professional, internship, academic, or personal projects.
 



 Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms — cloud\-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third\-party pipeline tools.
 



 Exposure to multiple source system types — CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
 



 Public technical writing, conference talks, hackathons, or open\-source contributions.
 



 Prior exposure to customer conversations — even informally, such as presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or collaborating with international teams across time zones.
 



  





**ABOUT HEVO** 




 Hevo is the data integration platform powering 1,000\+ data\-driven companies — including DoorDash, Shopify, Gartner, and IcelandAir. Headquartered in San Francisco with a strong engineering base in Bengaluru, Hevo is Series B with $42M raised from Sequoia, Chiratae, and Qualgro.
 



 We have built one of the most loved data pipeline products in the modern data stack, and we are now scaling our go\-to\-market function. This role sits at the center of that next phase.
