description:
**About Handshake**
 Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
   

  

 In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
   

  

**Why Join Handshake Now**
* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue


**About Handshake AI**
 Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Software Engineer I, on this team, you'll own the full stack of impact — from the experiences our fellows rely on every day to the internal tools and platform capabilities that let our operators run the business with speed and quality. This role sits at the intersection of product engineering, platform infrastructure, and operations, functioning much like an embedded engineering group: you'll partner directly with Growth, Product, Operations, and ML to deeply understand both fellow\-facing and operator workflows, and translate them into reliable, scalable systems.
   

  

 As AI continues to reshape how people learn, work, and build careers, you'll help define the consumer experience that sets our fellows up for success, while also building the internal tooling and technical foundations that let operators — and the business as a whole — move just as fast. Whether you're shipping customer\-facing features, architecting internal automation, or modernizing core infrastructure, your work will have a direct and lasting impact on our users, our operators, and our ability to innovate at scale.
   

  

 This is a highly collaborative, communication\-heavy role. Success requires strong technical fundamentals, systems thinking, and high EQ \- the ability to translate ambiguous or urgent needs (from fellows, operators, or the business) into clear technical solutions, along with the judgment to balance rapid execution with thoughtful, long\-term engineering decisions. We're looking for engineers who are excited to take ownership of meaningful problems, influence technical direction, and shape not just what we build, but how we build it.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Build and own core experiences across the fellow platform, including onboarding, the fellow homepage, and project opportunities, while designing systems that power fellow allocation and evolve manual operational workflows into scalable platform capabilities.
* Embed with operators to understand their processes, pain points, and success metrics, and architect internal tools, automations, and workflows that improve operational throughput, accuracy, and visibility.
* Partner closely with Growth, Operations, Product, and ML to understand business processes and translate them into high\-quality technical solutions.
* Lead projects end\-to\-end — from discovery, scoping, and technical design through implementation, rollout, and continuous iteration.
* Drive architectural improvements that reduce technical debt and establish scalable service layers as the platform grows.
* Balance speed and quality by making thoughtful engineering tradeoffs that support both immediate business needs and long\-term maintainability.
* Collaborate across teams to build reliable, secure systems that improve both the fellow and operator experience, and to drive adoption and measurable impact.
* Mentor other engineers through technical leadership, project ownership, and strong engineering practices \- including in a "player\-coach" capacity as the team grows.


**Desired Capabilities**
* 1\-3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of owning production systems end\-to\-end, from requirements through production support.
* Experience leading technical projects involving multiple contributors, including coordinating work and driving successful execution.
* Strong proactive communication and stakeholder management skills, with high empathy/EQ and the ability to partner deeply with non\-engineering teams and translate ambiguous or urgent needs into effective technical solutions.
* Excellent engineering judgment and systems thinking \- able to design scalable architectures, pick the right level of abstraction, and make pragmatic tradeoffs without over\-building.
* Experience improving or modernizing existing systems, balancing rapid product development with long\-term platform health.
* Experience building internal tools, workflow systems, or automation for operations\-heavy teams (or analogous customer\-embedded roles like FDE/solutions engineering).
* Comfortable operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Passion for building products and tools that directly impact customer and operator experience at scale.


**Extra Credit**
* Experience building marketplace, allocation, matching, or workflow systems.
* Experience with AI workflows and agentic infrastructure.
* Experience designing service\-oriented architectures or platform infrastructure that enables future product growth.
* Experience with workflow/backlog systems, intake processes, and operational analytics (instrumentation, dashboards, QA).
* Background building tooling for knowledge\-work operations (e.g., case management, review/approval flows, data quality tooling).
* Excited to apply expertise in complex, at\-scale systems to an AI\-driven, rapidly evolving product landscape.


**You’ll Thrive Here If You**
* Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact.
* Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data.
* Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel.


**Perks**
* Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
* Housing Bonus: 1\.3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
* Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 \- 100% of base
* Medical Insurance Coverage
* Food credit for every in person day.

==========================================

**Location:** Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh

The Area Head \- Gold Loan will be responsible for driving business growth, profitability, portfolio quality, and operational excellence across the assigned territory. The role involves managing multiple Gold Loan branches, leading Branch Managers and field teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and delivering customer\-centric solutions to achieve business objectives.

------------------------

### **Business Growth \& Revenue Management**

* Develop and execute local market strategies to increase customer acquisition and market penetration.

### **Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Branch Managers and branch staff across the region.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability and productivity across branches.
* Conduct regular branch reviews and performance discussions.
* Drive employee engagement, training, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Foster a high\-performance and customer\-focused culture within the team.

### **Portfolio \& Risk Management**

* Ensure healthy portfolio growth while maintaining asset quality.
* Monitor overdue accounts, auction cases, and portfolio delinquency.
* Implement collection and recovery strategies to control NPA levels.
* Ensure proper appraisal, valuation, storage, and release of pledged gold as per policy.
* Minimize fraud risks through regular monitoring and process adherence.

### **Operations \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations, internal policies, audit requirements, and operational guidelines.
* Conduct regular branch visits to review operational controls and compliance standards.
* Drive resolution of audit observations and ensure timely closure.
* Monitor customer service standards and grievance resolution mechanisms.
* Maintain process discipline and operational efficiency across branches.

### **Relationship Management**

* Build strong relationships with customers, local influencers, and business associates.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Credit, Operations, Risk, HR, and Finance.
* Strengthen the company's brand presence within the assigned geography.
* Support marketing and promotional initiatives to drive business growth.

### **MIS \& Reporting**

* Track business performance through regular MIS reviews.
* Prepare business forecasts and action plans to achieve targets.
* Present branch performance reviews and market insights to senior management.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of business metrics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
-----------------------------

### **Education**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA or Post\-Graduation preferred.

### **Experience**

* 7 to 12 years of experience in Gold Loan, NBFC, Banking, or Financial Services.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in managing multiple branches/territories.
* Strong exposure to Gold Loan operations and business development.

### **Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Expertise in Gold Loan products and operations.
* Business development and market expansion capability.
* Portfolio and risk management experience.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in MIS reporting and performance management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Gold Loan portfolio growth.
* Revenue and profitability achievement.
* Customer acquisition and retention.
* Branch productivity and business performance.
* Portfolio quality and NPA control.
* Audit and compliance score.
* Employee productivity and attrition management.
* Customer satisfaction and service standards.

### **Span of Control**

* Branch Managers, Assistant Branch Managers, Relationship Officers, and Branch Operations Teams across the assigned territory.

**Preferred Location:** Candidates with strong market knowledge of Tirupati and Andhra Pradesh Gold Loan business ecosystem will be preferred.

\#\# About CureAble

CureAble is a child development and therapy ecosystem focused on helping neurodivergent children, children with developmental challenges, and slow learners access structured, measurable, and parent\-centric support.

We combine \*centre\-based therapy, home therapy, parent guidance, technology, school partnerships, and a growing digital ecosystem\* to make quality developmental support more accessible and outcome\-driven.

We are looking for a highly driven \*Founder’s Intern\* who wants to work directly with the leadership team and experience what it takes to build and scale a high\-growth company.

\#\# About the Role

As a Founder’s Intern, you will work directly with the Founder and leadership team on \*high\-priority business and operational problems\*.

This is not a role where you will simply be assigned routine tasks.

You will be expected to:

\* Understand a problem

\* Research and analyse it

\* Build a solution

\* Coordinate with the relevant team

\* Execute it

\* Track outcomes

\* Improve the process

You will get exposure to \*business strategy, operations, growth, sales, partnerships, hiring, technology, and management\*.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# 1\. Founder’s Office \& Strategic Projects

\* Work directly with the Founder on critical business initiatives.

\* Conduct market, competitor, customer, and industry research.

\* Convert broad ideas into structured action plans.

\* Prepare presentations, business analyses, reports, and decision documents.

\* Track strategic projects from planning to execution.

\* Identify bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions.

\#\#\# 2\. Business \& Operations

\* Help build and improve SOPs and operational systems.

\* Identify inefficiencies across teams and suggest improvements.

\* Create dashboards, trackers, and performance reports.

\* Follow up with teams on critical deliverables.

\* Monitor KPIs and highlight gaps to leadership.

\* Support cross\-functional execution between Operations, Sales, Marketing, HR, and Clinical teams.

\#\#\# 3\. Growth \& Business Development

\* Research potential growth opportunities for CureAble.

\* Support school, hospital, doctor, corporate, and institutional partnerships.

\* Build lead and partnership databases.

\* Assist in outreach strategy and campaign execution.

\* Analyse lead\-generation and conversion data.

\* Support experiments to improve customer acquisition and retention.

\#\#\# 4\. Research \& Analytics

\* Conduct structured market research.

\* Analyse competitors and emerging business models.

\* Work with spreadsheets and basic data analysis.

\* Convert data into actionable insights.

\* Prepare weekly/monthly business reports for leadership.

\#\#\# 5\. Project Management

\* Own selected projects independently.

\* Define timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

\* Coordinate with internal stakeholders.

\* Track execution and ensure deadlines are met.

\* Escalate risks and delays proactively.

\* Maintain clear documentation of project progress.

\#\#\# 6\. Technology \& Automation

\* Identify repetitive processes that can be automated.

\* Research and evaluate tools for improving productivity.

\* Assist with implementation of technology and automation projects.

\* Work with platforms such as Notion, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, CRM/project\-management tools, and AI tools.

\#\# What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is \*exceptionally curious, proactive, analytical, and execution\-oriented\*.

\#\#\# Must Have

\* Strong communication and writing skills.

\* Excellent problem\-solving ability.

\* Strong ownership and accountability.

\* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

\* Strong research and analytical skills.

\* Good command of Excel/Google Sheets and presentations.

\* Ability to manage multiple priorities.

\* Willingness to work in a fast\-paced startup environment.

\* High attention to detail.

\* Ability to learn quickly and adapt.

\#\#\# Strongly Preferred

Candidates with experience in:

\* Startups

\* Founder’s Office

\* Consulting

\* Business Strategy

\* Operations

\* Growth/Marketing

\* Business Development

\* Project Management

\* Research \& Analytics

will be preferred.

\#\# Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You are likely to succeed if:

\* You don't wait for someone to tell you every next step.

\* You naturally ask \*“Why?” and “How can this be improved?”\*

\* You can take an ambiguous problem and structure it.

\* You enjoy working across different functions.

\* You are comfortable with numbers and data.

\* You can communicate with senior leadership confidently.

\* You take ownership of outcomes rather than just completing tasks.

\* You are comfortable being challenged and receiving feedback.

\* You want to understand \*how a company is actually built\*, not just how a job is performed.

\#\# Who Should NOT Apply?

This role may not be suitable for you if:

\* You need constant supervision.

\* You are looking for a routine internship.

\* You are uncomfortable with ambiguity.

\* You only want work within one specific function.

\* You are not comfortable taking ownership.

\* You focus on completing tasks rather than achieving outcomes.

description:
About Infiheal:

Infiheal HealthTech Pvt Ltd, incubated at IIT Bombay, is a pioneering AI\-driven mental healthcare startup transforming emotional wellness at scale. With 1M\+ active users globally, partnerships with Cornell University, NASSCOM, IBM, and the Indian Navy, and recognition by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Mann Ki Baat (2023\), Infiheal is redefining how mental health support is delivered.

Our flagship AI co\-therapist Healo and the world’s first AI relationship coach DuoChat provide 24/7 clinically validated, anonymous support, bridging the global therapist shortage and reducing wait times from 2–8 weeks to instant access. We aim to reach 100 million people in India and 500 million globally, making mental healthcare affordable, accessible, and stigma\-free.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Business Development Intern to sit at the front lines of our business development engine — helping us organise, write, and submit high\-quality proposals, RFP responses, compliance forms, and security questionnaires for international clients and institutional partners (corporates, educational institutions, hospitals, and government bodies).

This is hands\-on exposure to how enterprise and institutional deals actually get won — from the moment an RFP lands in our inbox to the moment a contract is signed. You'll work closely with product, engineering, legal, and sales, and you'll also get pulled into live client calls where presales and sales overlap — so you're not just filling forms in isolation, you're seeing the full deal come together.

If you're precise, proactive, and curious about how global B2B and B2G deals are structured, this is a strong way to break into presales and business development.

Roles \& Responsibilities:

RFP \& Compliance Form Management

* Review incoming Requests for Proposals (RFPs), RFIs, and tenders, and complete detailed client questionnaires, compliance documents, and data\-security forms (including items related to HIPAA, ISO 27001, and other regulatory standards relevant to our institutional partners)
* Track submission requirements closely to ensure nothing — a form field, an annexure, a signature — gets missed

Content Writing \& Editing

* Draft, proofread, and format persuasive, client\-ready proposal responses using our existing content library and product documentation
* Adapt tone and content for different audiences — corporate HR teams, hospital administrators, educational institutions, and government stakeholders each need a different pitch

Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Sales to gather accurate answers to technical, clinical, and operational questions from prospective clients
* Join client calls alongside the sales team when needed, to understand requirements directly and follow up on outstanding questions

Bid Tracking

* Maintain and update our proposal tracking database (Excel/CRM) so every submission deadline and action item is accounted for
* Flag at\-risk deadlines proactively before they become a problem

Knowledge Base Upkeep

* Help organise, update, and maintain our central repository of standard answers, FAQs, and case studies to speed up future proposal responses
* Identify recurring questions or gaps in our existing content and suggest what should be added

* Proficiency in Microsoft Word/Google Docs (using styles and templates) and Excel/Google Sheets
* A genuinely high level of precision — you catch the small details in complex forms that others miss
* Comfortable being proactive: asking questions, chasing busy internal stakeholders, and following up until you get what you need
* Comfortable joining client calls and taking notes/action items in real time

Nice to Have:

* Prior exposure to B2B sales, business development, or account management (internship or coursework)
* Interest in healthcare, HealthTech, or mental health/wellness
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, etc.)

Benefits:

* Direct mentorship from senior business development and presales leadership
* Exposure to live client calls and real enterprise deal\-making — not just backend form\-filling
* Certificate of completion, and potential for full\-time conversion based on performance

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.


As an organization, we are committed as one firm to our purpose, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

  



**INFORMATION ABOUT THE BUSINESS**


Aon is a leading global professional services firm providing a broad range of risk, retirement, and health solutions. Our colleagues provide clients in over 120 countries and sovereignties with advice and solutions that give them the clarity and confidence to make better decisions to protect and grow their business. **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**


The Talent Development Operations team is part of Global People Operations and supports the operational delivery of Talent Development services across learning deployment, onboarding, early careers, CPD administration, Workday Learning operations, reporting, process support and stakeholder coordination. The team enables Talent Development programmes and processes to run consistently, efficiently and at scale. It partners with Learning Development and Deployment COE teams, People Strategy, business learning teams, People Operations, HR IT, HR Service Center, Strada and internal and external partners. The Learning Deployment Specialist is responsible for the operational execution of global learning programmes, providing scalable, high\-quality deployment support from the Global Capability Centre. The role supports the coordination, administration and delivery enablement of virtual and in\-person learning programmes in partnership with regional Learning Deployment teams. This role operates as a back\-office delivery function and supports Workday Learning administration, programme coordination, virtual session production, learner communications, mailbox management, reporting, survey administration, content maintenance and stakeholder support. The role helps ensure that deployment activities are delivered accurately, consistently and in line with agreed timelines and service expectations. The Learning Deployment Specialist partners with Senior Learning Deployment Specialists, regional Learning Deployment leads, Learning Design teams, facilitators, faculty, vendors and learners to provide reliable operational support and ensure that learning programmes are set up, communicated, tracked and reported effectively.


The Learning Deployment Specialist provides back\-office delivery support from the Global Capability Centre, helping ensure global and regional learning programmes are coordinated, administered and enabled effectively across virtual and in\-person delivery formats. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**:  

The colleague is responsible for:
**Learning operations and administration**

* Manage Workday Learning administration, including course, session and campaign set\-up, enrolment monitoring, attendance management and learning data clean\-up.
* Monitor and update programme project plans, trackers, SharePoint sites and operational documentation to support accurate programme delivery.
* Maintain accurate programme records and ensure learning administration activities are completed in line with agreed process standards and timelines.

**Programme coordination and virtual delivery support*** Coordinate the deployment of learning programmes across regions, ensuring key milestones, dependencies and learner communications are tracked and progressed.
* Produce and host virtual learning sessions using Microsoft Teams, including session set\-up, technical support, attendance capture and post\-session follow\-up.
* Coordinate translation of learning materials where required and support the preparation and distribution of programme assets.

**Logistics management for in\-person programmes*** As required, support Senior Learning Deployment Specialists with logistics and in\-person programme set\-up, including venue coordination, materials preparation, learner lists, facilitator support and on\-site readiness activities.

**Communications and engagement**

* Distribute programme communications, including invitations where appropriate, pre\-work, post\-session materials, learning newsletters and learner reminders
* Ensure communications are clear, timely, aligned to programme requirements and routed through the appropriate channels.

**Mailbox and stakeholder support*** Monitor learning mailboxes, respond to learner and collaborator queries and advance issues where specialist input or decision\-making is required.
* Provide timely and accurate operational support to collaborators, ensuring service expectations, dependencies and next steps are clearly communicated.

**Reporting and data management*** Produce and administer pre\-programme, post\-programme and follow\-up surveys to support learner feedback and programme evaluation.
* Deliver standard and ad hoc reporting, including quarterly and year\-end learning hours, completions, attendance and programme status reporting.

**Digital and content management*** Set up, maintain and update Learning SharePoint and Teams sites, ensuring content is accurate, up to date, accessible and aligned to programme needs.

**Key Stakeholder Interaction*** Senior Learning Deployment Specialists
* Regional Learning Deployment Leads
* Global Head of Learning Deployment
* Learning Design teams
* Facilitators and faculty
* Vendors and external suppliers
* Colleagues and learners

* Strong experience in Learning Operations, Learning Deployment, Workday Learning, LMS Administration, Programme Coordination, Virtual Delivery Support, Learning Communications, Reporting, Data Accuracy, Collaborator Support, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Service Delivery, Operational Excellence.

* Collaborative, service\-oriented attitude and ability to work effectively with regional and global collaborators.

An SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) Manager plays a critical role in bridging the gap between an organization’s financial operations and its IT infrastructure. They are responsible for leading the design, implementation, configuration, and optimization of SAP FICO modules (often transitioning to or leveraging SAP S/4HANA) to align with business objectives and compliance requirements.


Your Role:


The SAP FICO Manager will lead a team of Functional Analyst and Architect to oversee the end\-to\-end delivery of SAP Finance and Controlling solutions. This position requires expert in people management, deep functional expertise in core accounting and managerial costing processes, strong project management capabilities, and a proven track record of handling full\-lifecycle SAP implementations (including SAP S/4HANA migrations). The manager ensures financial reporting accuracy, system integration, and compliance with local and global financial standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **People Management**: The People Manager is responsible for leading, mentoring, and developing a high\-performing team of FICO functional analyst. The ideal candidate will focus on career development, performance management, team culture, and resource allocation, ensuring that the team has the right skills and motivation to meet the company's evolving technological goals.
* **Stakeholder Management**: work with stakeholders (Business process Architect, Process owners, AMS partners) to ensure the team collaborate on all requirement scoping and deployment. Working closely with external partners on the contract management and licensing of applications
* **Bridging top down communication**: Work closely with Leaderhsip on all management communication, playing key role in Implementing the core principles of IT organization and HR policies across Globe
* **Planning and forecasting**: taking care of all the planning and forecasting including resource planning, contracts and License management to ensure the Org P\&Ls are met with leadership expectation
* **Solution Architecture \& Configuration**: Lead the SAP FICO workstream through all phases of implementation (e.g., scoping, blueprinting, realization, testing, cutover, and post\-go\-live support) utilizing methodologies like ASAP, Agile across FICO sub modules as below
* + Financial Accounting (FI): General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting.
* + Controlling (CO): Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis (CO\-PA).
* **Cross\-Module Integration**: Collaborate closely with other functional teams to ensure seamless system integration with modules such as Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Production Planning (PP), Project Systems (PS), and Human Resources (HR).
* **Quality Assurance \& Testing**: Oversee system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT), managing defect resolution, data migration validation, and compliance audits.
* **Team \& Vendor Management**: Mentor junior consultants, manage resource allocation, evaluate performance, and serve as the main point of contact for external vendors and system integrators.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Identify process inefficiencies and propose technical innovations (such as Fiori financial apps, Central Finance, or SAP BTP tools) to optimize financial reporting and data analytics.
 **Who you are:**

* Experience: 5–8\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP configuration, with at least 2–3 full\-cycle end\-to\-end SAP S/4HANA implementations. 2 to 3 years of experience in people management
* S/4HANA Innovations: Strong familiarity with modern innovations like the Universal Journal, Material Ledger, Group Reporting, and Central Finance.
* Integration Knowledge: Advanced understanding of how financial data flows through supply chain, sales, and manufacturing modules.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills to explain complex technical designs to non\-technical executive teams.
* Problem\-Solving: Proven capacity to manage risks, track project timelines, resolve architectural defects, and make strategic data\-driven decisions.
* Education: Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, BE, Information Technology, or a related field (MBA or CPA/CA equivalents are highly desired).
* Certifications: SAP S/4HANA Finance or SAP FICO Certification is the value addition
* Preferred Certifications: Project Management certifications (such as PMP, Scrum Master etc) is a value addition

We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

**About the role**
------------------

The Total Reward CoE is an integral part of our collective drive to bring customers to the centre of everything we do at BT Group.


As a CoE we design customer\-centric total reward solutions that underpin outstanding business performance and differentiated individual total reward.


As a senior specialist, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and leading our total reward priorities, and delivering total reward solutions which support both our colleagues and our strategic business aspirations.


While operating at a developed level of conceptual thinking, you will help guide the business through change and risk management, ensuring that total reward practices are future proofed, customer\-centric and underpin increased business performance.


**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* **As a primary CoE contact,** leads total reward advice, guidance and insight across the business unit(s) and Country. Within Group frameworks / policies, accountable for leading the development of customer\-centric, data\-led total reward solutions which deliver differentiated outcomes for differentiated performance across specific business unit(s) and geographies.
* As a total reward expert, accountable with business unit/Corporate Unit (CU)/Country People and Culture teams for **identifying opportunities and delivering solutions to enhance the effectiveness of total reward** to drive improved business performance. Accountable for ensuring seamless Reward CoE activities and processes to deliver customer\-centric solutions.
* Accountable for **driving increased leadership and line manager understanding** of the value and impact of total reward adoption and use. Works with People and Culture teams to leverage opportunities to enable managers to make balanced, consistent and unbiased total reward decisions.
* With CoE colleagues, **identifies** **innovative ways to simplify total reward delivery and drive performance** within and across business units through total reward insights.
* **Implements and embeds total reward programmes** (cyclical and change) across the business, as well as enhancing total reward value as part of the EVP.
* Lead for **Reward Regulatory Governance compliance in India** co\-ordinating relevant parties and ensuring key stakeholders are informed
* Co\-lead the application of BT’s **Strategic Workforce Planning** methodology with the P\&C Director, India, delivering the BT enterprise requirements and India market landscape. Connected and collaborating with the Global BT SWP team.
* Enable the P\&C BPs in India, with the knowledge of the **Global BT SWP framework, principles and tooling** and partner on the implementation of OD and Change Management initiatives in India, where applicable
* Partner with the Global BT OD Partner and OE Team on **designing and implementing large OD initiatives** including benchmarking, TOM and complex OD.
* Support local OE work **implementing job sizing, job architecture requirements** etc, working closely with the Global BT OE COE ensuring utilization of global processes, principles and support India market nuances, wherever relevant
* **Brings external perspectives and ingrains best practice** across the business to increase the impact of total reward on organizational performance.

**Working closely with the Business Unit/Country P\&CLT to contribute** to the wider people strategy


**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Essential Skills \& Experience**

  

**Total Reward expertise:** Significant experience in Total Reward, including compensation, benefits, recognition and performance. Ideally **10\+ years’ experience** leading Total Reward change in complex/global organisations.

  

  

**Advanced Business Partnering:** Proven ability to partner with and influence senior leaders, translating business goals into effective Total Reward programmes that drive business and individual performance.

  

  

**Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Expert analytical capability, including identifying root causes, interpreting data, developing solutions and making data\-driven Reward decisions.

  

  

**Change \& Project Delivery:** Expert change management and project delivery skills, with experience implementing Total Reward changes across a large organisation.

  

  

**Data Storytelling \& Business Insights:** Ability to build compelling business cases for Reward change using data, analytics and customer insights.

  

  

**Communication \& Influence:** Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate confidently and influence stakeholders at different levels, adapting style to the audience.

  

  

**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement:** Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for improvement, bring new ideas and contribute to thought leadership in Total Reward.

  

  

**Collaboration:** Strong internal and external relationship\-building skills, with the ability to collaborate across operational, technical and specialist teams.

  

  

**Governance \& Risk Management:** Significant experience managing compensation, benefits and pension programmes, with accountability for governance, risk management, compliance and reporting.

  

  

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Desired Skills \& Experience**

  

Experience within a **UK\-headquartered or similarly complex global organisation** , particularly in a disruptive/transformation environment.

  

  

Strong understanding of **people drivers of organisational performance and financial levers/KPIs** , with the ability to connect Reward strategy to wider business outcomes.

  

  

Experience using advanced analytics, insights or data visualisation to identify opportunities and optimise Reward effectiveness.

  

  

Experience delivering **large\-scale, complex or transformational Reward programmes** across multiple geographies/business units.

  

  

Experience applying **customer\-centric design** to Total Reward solutions and communicating complex insights in an engaging way.

  

  

Experience influencing **C\-suite / executive\-level stakeholders** on complex or sensitive Reward matters.

  

  

External benchmarking, professional networking and exposure to **emerging Reward trends and practices** ; recognised as a subject\-matter expert.

Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: People Business Partner
description:
**What we are looking for**
---------------------------



A strong, on the ground People Business Partner who can help stand up the India site from a people perspective while partnering closely with leaders through launch, ramp, and stabilization. Unlike the senior HR lead, this role should lean much more heavily into tactical execution, day to day leadership support, and onsite people management, while still bringing enough strategic judgment to identify future opportunities and help shape the next phase of the people model.This person should be fully embedded in the operation, highly visible to leaders and employees, and able to translate business needs into practical people solutions in real time.


**Profile**
-----------



Highly tactical and fully onsite operator who is comfortable working in a fast paced, build stage environment where processes are still being defined and the site is scaling quickly. This role should be willing to stay close to the floor, leaders, and teams, with a strong bias for execution and problem solving.



Strong leadership partner able to work directly with site and functional leaders on day to day people topics, team effectiveness, manager support, role clarity, performance concerns, and workforce needs. This role should be credible with leaders, but much more hands on than a purely strategic business partner.



Deep employee engagement and culture capability with the ability to help shape the employee experience from the ground up. This includes identifying early engagement risks, reinforcing cultural expectations, supporting manager consistency, and helping create a healthy and sustainable site environment as the organization ramps.



Solid org effectiveness and talent management judgment with the ability to support team design, manager capability, succession thinking, talent cycled, and role clarity as the site evolves. This person does not need to own long range org strategy, but should be strong enough to spot issues, recommend improvements, and help leaders make sound people decisions.



Strong employee relations and compliance foundation with the ability to handle sensitive employee matters, ensure consistent policy application, support investigations or escalations as needed, and maintain strong alignment with local labor requirements and company standards.



Experienced in change management and comfortable supporting leaders and employees through ambiguity, new processes, shifting structures, and operating model changes during the launch and ramp period.



Coordinator and people operations enabler who can direct and prioritize the work of the 2 HR Generalists, ensuring strong day to day execution across onboarding, employee support, documentation, policy administration, issue follow up, and site level people processes.



Data aware and opportunity oriented with the ability to identify trends in attrition, engagement, attendance, performance, employee concerns, and manager capability, then translate those insights into practical actions and future improvements.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Partner day to day with site leaders on people topics tied to launch, ramp, and team stabilization.
* Provide onsite support on employee engagement, culture, team health, and manager effectiveness.
* Drive tactical org effectiveness work, including role clarity, team design support, and workforce planning input.
* Manage employee relations matters and help ensure compliant, consistent execution of people policies and practices.
* Support change management as the site moves from launch mode into a more stable operating rhythm.
* Coordinate and guide the work of the 2 HR Generalists to ensure strong execution of daily HR operations and employee support.
* Identify gaps, patterns, and improvement opportunities that can inform the next phase of the India people model.
* Partner closely with the Senior Manager or Director on escalations, org decisions, talent priorities, and site level people risk.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------



Likely 6 to 10 years of progressive HRBP or PBP experience, ideally in high growth, operations heavy, site based, or multi shift environments. The strongest profile would bring a mix of business partnership, employee relations, manager coaching, engagement, and operational HR execution, with experience working very close to the business rather than from a distance.This should be someone who is comfortable balancing immediate tactical support with enough business judgment to help build stronger practices over time.

**About DoorDash**
==================



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. title: Medical Reviewer
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
If you're looking for a role that allows you to combine your passion for medical science with your attention to detail, the Medical Reviewer position offers a unique and rewarding opportunity. This position gives you the chance to make a significant impact by ensuring that medical content is accurate, clear, and compliant with industry standards.
Job responsibilities:
* Evaluate manuscripts, posters, slide decks, educational material, medical literature, etc., provided by clients for data accuracy.
* Check documents (mentioned above) developed by medical writers for scientific data errors by checking the developed material against annotated references, CSRs, other source data.
* Check for discrepancy within text, discrepancy between figures/tables, and between text and supplementary material, and make suggestions for improvements.
* Identify missing sources in documents and gaps in scientific logic.
* Check for grammar, syntax, style, and compliance with style guides, regulatory guidelines, and publishing requirements.
* Be responsible for the quality of the documents/projects fact checked/QCed.
* Ensure effective communication of QC/fact check findings with the client/medical writers.
* Deliver QC reports to the stakeholders and identify quality trends.
* Ensure timely delivery of documents.
* Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
* Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.


\#LI\-Remote
Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Minimum 2 years of experience in the medical writing industry; freshers with substantial knowledge of the publication landscape or clinical research are also eligible.
* Master’s degree in research, or equivalent industry experience.
* Ability to work efficiently and independently, multitask, and prioritize.
* Excellent attention to detail and zero tolerance to errors.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Functional with MS Office.
* Flexible and adaptable to changing project priorities and work assignments.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a **Technical Assessment**, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task, followed by a **Technical Interview** with the Hiring Managers. The final round will be the **HR Interview**. All interactions will be conducted virtually via **MS Teams**. **Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic. **AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
 AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose\-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
 We believe in Human\-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline \- science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
About Us:

Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com) is a leading medical communication company headquartered in Princeton, NJ, with nine global offices. Its expertise lies in delivering scientific content across the product lifecycle with a focus on science, innovation, and efficiency. The company specializes in providing impactful medical strategy, custom operational models, content development and dissemination, and promotion of patient inclusion for biopharmaceutical organizations. Cactus Life Sciences’ scalable solutions cater to the challenges encountered in product development, guiding brands, and organizations towards their future objectives. With a client\-centric approach, the company prioritizes understanding their evolving needs and technology trends to drive its growth. Cactus Life Sciences is a subsidiary of Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com/), a leading science communication and technology company.

description:
HR Executive**Hyderabad \| Full\-Time \| Reports to Manager – Hyderabad**  

Location: Hyderabad
Experience Required
2–3 years of experience in HR Operations / HR Coordination
Employment Type: Full\-Time Permanent **About TechBlocks:**  

At TechBlocks, we believe strong systems and disciplined HR operations are essential to building scalable and high\-performing teams. We are looking for a process\-oriented and detail\-driven HR Executive to support and strengthen HR operations for our Hyderabad office.
This role is critical to ensuring smooth HR process management, documentation governance, HRMS coordination, reporting accuracy, and operational discipline across HR activities. The ideal candidate should be proactive, organized, and capable of independently managing multiple workstreams with strong ownership and accountability.
About the Role
This role will act as the operational backbone of HR for the Hyderabad office. The selected candidate will manage HR process documentation, Keka coordination, skill gap tracking, succession planning records, and SLA management while ensuring operational accuracy and process consistency.
We are looking for someone who is highly process\-driven, detail\-oriented, and proactive — someone who can quickly understand workflows, identify gaps, and independently maintain structured HR operations with minimal supervision. **Key Responsibilities**
Process Documentation \& SOP Management* + Create and maintain SOPs for all HR processes including hiring, onboarding, exit management, PMS, and policy workflows.
	+ Define process owners, timelines (TATs), escalation paths, and process steps clearly within documentation.
	+ Maintain organized and version\-controlled SOP repositories on shared drives and Keka HRMS.
	+ Conduct quarterly SOP reviews and update outdated documentation within defined timelines.
	+ Ensure all operational HR processes are documented and regularly maintained.


Keka HRMS Coordination* + Support Keka module rollouts as per the HR operations roadmap.
	+ Coordinate training sessions for HR teams prior to new module go\-live.
	+ Maintain and track manual\-to\-automation process migration records.
	+ Identify operational blockers proactively and escalate them with proper context and resolution inputs.
	+ Ensure HR process data within Keka remains updated and organized.


Skill Gap Tracking \& Reporting* + Build and maintain skill gap tracking databases across teams and roles.
	+ Map role requirements, current capabilities, identified gaps, and closure plans.
	+ Update records after PMS cycles and ensure reporting accuracy.
	+ Publish quarterly skill gap analysis reports and highlight critical gaps to management.
	+ Escalate roles without succession or closure plans within defined timelines.


Succession Planning \& SLA Tracking* + Maintain succession planning registers for critical business roles.
	+ Track readiness levels, primary successors, and backup resources.
	+ Ensure regular updates based on role or employee status changes.
	+ Maintain HR SLA registers and track adherence across HR operations.
	+ Prepare monthly SLA tracking reports and share operational insights with management.
	+ Update SLA records whenever process changes occur.

**Who We Are Looking For:**  

Must\-Have Skills \& Experience* + 1–3 years of HR operations or HR coordination experience.
	+ Strong attention to detail and process orientation.
	+ Ability to create clear and structured process documentation in English.
	+ Good working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets including filters, reports, and pivot tables.
	+ Ability to independently manage multiple trackers, reports, and operational activities.
	+ Proactive mindset with strong ownership and follow\-through.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication skills.
	+ Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate immediately.


Preferred Experience* + Experience working with Keka HRMS.
	+ Experience maintaining operational trackers, registers, and reporting dashboards.
	+ Exposure to HR system rollouts or training coordination activities.
	+ Prior experience in IT services or technology organizations.
	+ Understanding of structured HR operations and process governance.


Working Style Expectations
We Value Professionals Who Are* + Highly process\-oriented and organized.
	+ Passionate about building structured systems and documentation.
	+ Accurate and detail\-focused in execution.
	+ Proactive in identifying process gaps and operational improvements.
	+ Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.
	+ Confident in communicating findings, updates, and operational concerns professionally.


This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You:  

* + Require constant reminders or supervision to complete tasks.
	+ View documentation and process tracking as secondary responsibilities.
	+ Prefer purely administrative or repetitive coordination work.
	+ Struggle with multitasking or maintaining operational discipline.
	+ Are unfamiliar with SLA\-driven environments or process accountability.

**Why Join TechBlocks?:**  

* + Opportunity to contribute to building scalable HR operations and systems.
	+ Exposure to structured HR process management and HRMS operations.
	+ Collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
	+ Opportunity to work closely with HR leadership and business stakeholders.
	+ Strong focus on operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* LL.B. from a reputed university;
* 3\-9 years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful experience supporting an in\-house legal department or multinational business environment.

* Sound judgment, high integrity, and ability to identify legal and business risks and propose practical solutions.

title: HR Manager
description:
HR Manager – People, Compliance \& Administration

**Company:** Nexrise India Infra Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Jaipur, Rajasthan  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site only  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Experience Required:** 5–8\+ Years

About the Role

Nexrise India Infra Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **HR Manager – People, Compliance \& Administration** to take end\-to\-end ownership of the organisation's human resource function.

The person will be responsible for building and managing strong HR systems covering **manpower planning, recruitment, employee lifecycle management, policies, statutory compliance, performance management, employee relations, discipline, documentation and HR reporting**.

The role requires a hands\-on HR professional who can work closely with management as well as employees across office, sales, warehouse, operations and manufacturing functions.

This position is based **100% on\-site at Jaipur**.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment

* Prepare department\-wise manpower plans in consultation with management and HODs.
* Manage recruitment across junior, middle and senior\-level positions.
* Source, screen, interview and coordinate selection of candidates.
* Maintain recruitment pipelines and vacancy trackers.
* Develop and maintain Job Descriptions for all key positions.
* Improve hiring quality, joining ratios and employee retention.

2\. Employee Lifecycle Management

Manage the complete employee lifecycle including:

* Offer and appointment documentation
* Joining and onboarding
* Employee induction
* Probation monitoring
* Confirmation
* Transfers
* Promotions
* Salary revisions
* Performance reviews
* Resignations
* Full \& Final settlement coordination
* Exit interviews and relieving documentation

3\. HR Policies \& Processes

* Draft and implement company HR policies.
* Prepare HR SOPs and internal guidelines.
* Establish attendance, leave, overtime and disciplinary processes.
* Maintain employee handbook and code of conduct.
* Review existing policies periodically and recommend improvements.
* Ensure HR policies are communicated and consistently implemented across departments.

4\. Statutory \& Labour Compliance

The candidate should have practical knowledge of applicable statutory requirements, including:

* Provident Fund – PF
* ESIC
* Labour law requirements
* Shops \& Establishment requirements
* Factory/workforce\-related HR compliance
* Employee registers and statutory records
* Contractor/manpower documentation where applicable
* Wage and attendance records
* Leave and overtime compliance
* Employment documentation

The HR Manager will coordinate with consultants, accounts and management wherever required while retaining internal ownership of compliance.

5\. Attendance, Leave \& Workforce Discipline

* Monitor attendance and punctuality across employees.
* Manage leave records and approvals.
* Monitor overtime and shift\-related records.
* Identify absenteeism and attendance irregularities.
* Implement disciplinary procedures.
* Prepare warning letters, show\-cause notices and other HR communications where required.
* Ensure consistent implementation of company rules.

6\. Performance Management

* Implement KRAs and KPIs across departments.
* Establish probation review systems.
* Coordinate monthly/quarterly employee performance reviews.
* Maintain performance records.
* Assist management with increment and promotion decisions.
* Develop Performance Improvement Plans where necessary.
* Build a performance\-driven culture across the organisation.

7\. Payroll \& Compensation Coordination

* Verify monthly attendance and payroll inputs.
* Coordinate employee additions, deductions, incentives, leave and overtime.
* Maintain salary confidentiality.
* Assist management with compensation benchmarking and salary structuring.
* Coordinate PF, ESIC and other employee deductions with Accounts/payroll personnel.

8\. Employee Relations

* Act as the central point for employee HR concerns.
* Handle grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Resolve interpersonal and departmental employee issues.
* Conduct employee counselling where necessary.
* Improve communication between employees, HODs and management.
* Support employee retention and engagement initiatives.

9\. HR Documentation \& MIS

Maintain accurate records relating to:

* Employee master database
* Attendance
* Leave
* Salary revisions
* Recruitment
* Manpower requirements
* Probation
* Performance
* Employee turnover
* Warning/disciplinary records
* Training
* Statutory documentation
* Employee exits

Prepare regular HR MIS and dashboards for management review.

10\. Organisation Development

* Maintain company organisation charts and reporting structures.
* Assist management with manpower budgeting.
* Identify organisational skill gaps.
* Coordinate employee training and development.
* Assist with succession planning for important roles.
* Support the company as it expands into new locations and departments.

Candidate ProfileMandatory

* Minimum **5 years of relevant HR experience**
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end HR operations
* Practical knowledge of PF, ESIC and Indian labour compliance
* Strong recruitment capabilities
* Experience handling employee grievances and disciplinary matters
* Excellent drafting and documentation skills
* Strong knowledge of MS Excel and HR reporting
* Good verbal and written communication in **English and Hindi**
* Ability to work independently and take ownership

Preferred

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Manufacturing
* Engineering
* Infrastructure
* Construction Equipment
* Industrial Products
* Warehousing
* Logistics
* Equipment Rental

Experience managing a combination of **corporate/office employees, field sales employees and factory/warehouse manpower** will be a significant advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* Process\-oriented
* Firm but fair
* Highly organised
* Confidential
* Approachable
* Strong in documentation
* Comfortable enforcing company policies
* Able to communicate with employees at every organisational level
* Capable of working directly with senior management
* Proactive rather than dependent on instructions for every HR activity

Work Location

**Jaipur, Rajasthan – On\-site**

This is **not a remote or hybrid position**.

Candidates should either currently be based in Jaipur or be willing to relocate to Jaipur.

Compensation

Salary will be competitive and will be decided based on the candidate's experience, current compensation and suitability for the role.

Joining

Candidates who can join within a reasonable notice period will be preferred.

Pay: ₹15,645\.94 \- ₹40,628\.65 per month

Application Question(s):

* Experience in handling Blue collar staff and employees ?

Location:

* Jaipur, Rajasthan (Jaipur) (Preferred)

title: Specialist, Indirect Procurement
description:
Build a career with confidence

  

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world\-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

  

About the Role

* Support strategic sourcing and procurement activities across indirect spend categories to achieve cost savings, process efficiency, compliance, and supplier performance objectives.
* Partner with business stakeholders to manage sourcing, contracting, supplier engagement, spend analysis, and purchase requisition requirements.
* Drive procurement best practices, policy compliance, and data\-driven decision\-making to deliver business value and operational excellence.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Execute sourcing and procurement activities across indirect categories such as IT, Professional Services, Marketing, Facilities, HR, Travel, Fleet, MRO, and Corporate Services.
* Conduct spend analysis and identify cost\-saving, productivity, and supplier optimization opportunities.
* Manage RFx processes including RFI, RFP, RFQ, bid analysis, supplier evaluation, and negotiation support.
* Collaborate with Category Managers, business stakeholders, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams to support sourcing initiatives.
* Support contract review processes and ensure all sourcing activities adhere to procurement policies and compliance requirements.
* Monitor supplier performance and assist in developing supplier scorecards and governance processes.
* Create and maintain procurement dashboards, savings trackers, sourcing pipelines, and management reports.
* Support purchase requisition (PR) to purchase order (PO) processes and resolve procurement\-related operational issues.
* Ensure data accuracy in procurement systems such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or equivalent platforms.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and process standardization within procurement operations.

  

Minimum Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 6\-8 years of experience in Indirect Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, or Category Management support.
* Strong understanding of sourcing methodologies, supplier management, contract management, and procurement processes.
* Experience working with procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or similar tools.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis/reporting.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Experience supporting global procurement operations across multiple regions is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, CSCP, or equivalent are an added advantage.

  

Preferred Competencies

* Strategic Sourcing
* Spend Analytics
* Supplier Relationship Management
* Contract Management
* Cost Optimization
* Stakeholder Management
* Procurement Compliance
* Data Analysis \& Reporting
* SAP Ariba / Procurement Systems
* Continuous Improvement \& Automation

**Carrier is An Equal** **Opportunity/Affirmative** **Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain compensation frameworks, salary structures, pay ranges, and job grade alignment for India.

* Prepare compensation dashboards, workforce cost analysis, benefits utilization reports, and executive\-ready insights for HR and business leadership.
* Coordinate with Finance and Payroll to ensure accurate implementation of compensation outcomes, payroll inputs, variable pay, benefits deductions, and statutory requirements.
* Ensure compensation and benefits processes are compliant with applicable India labor laws, tax requirements, social security obligations, data privacy expectations, and internal governance standards.
* Manage relationships with compensation survey providers, consultants, insurance brokers, benefit vendors, and HR technology partners.
* Drive process improvement, automation, documentation, and data integrity across compensation planning, benefits administration, and rewards reporting.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* 8 to 12 years of overall HR experience, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in Compensation \& Benefits, Total Rewards, HR Analytics, or Rewards Operations.
* Experience managing compensation cycles, salary benchmarking, benefits administration, job evaluation, and compensation governance for India.
* Working knowledge of India compensation practices, employee benefits, payroll interface processes, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong comfort with data validation, analysis, reporting, and presentation of insights.
* Experience working with HRIS, compensation planning tools, payroll inputs, and employee data with strong confidentiality and data discipline.

**Preferred / Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Experience with compensation surveys and benchmarking platforms such as Mercer, Aon, WTW, Radford, or similar market data providers.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, GCC, financial services, or a matrixed global organization.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, HR dashboards, compensation planning systems, or other analytics and reporting platforms.
* Experience supporting performance\-linked rewards, promotion cycles, talent calibration, retention analysis, and leadership compensation reviews.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate data into clear recommendations for HR and business leaders.

**Key Capabilities**
--------------------

**Rewards Expertise**


Compensation strategy, salary structures, benefits design, benchmarking, job evaluation, variable pay, and pay equity.

**Business Partnership**


Partnering with Business Leaders, HRBPs, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, and external partners.

**Governance \& Analytics**


Audit\-ready documentation, compliance controls, data integrity, dashboarding, post\-cycle analysis and process automation.

Comprised of centers of excellence and a diverse team of backgrounds and experience, the EisnerAmper Human Resources department attracts top talent, creates impactful engagement opportunities, and promotes education and growth for employees across the firm. By bringing together unique HR specializations and a deep understanding of the accounting business, we enable our colleagues to thrive personally and professionally.

  

Our award\-winning culture is based on the tenets of respect, professionalism, and extreme hospitality. EisnerAmper HR employees act as strategic partners with the service lines with which they work to create and deliver business solutions. When we have a genuine understanding of the unique teams and individuals we serve, we can make a tangible difference and deliver on our promise of being a great place to work.

title: Technical Manager, Data Products & Analytics Delivery
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Data Manager to lead the design, development, and scaling of enterprise\-grade data pipelines and analytics platforms in the cloud. This role is pivotal in driving our data strategy, ensuring robust, secure, and scalable solutions that power critical business decisions.


Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities


This role covers below responsibilities within Northern Trust :

* Strategize, Lead design, implementation, and operational management of secure, scalable cloud data products solutions on snowflake \& Azure.
* Architect and optimize data pipelines using Snowflake Azure Data Factory (ADF) for ingestion, transformation, and orchestration.
* Develop and manage enterprise data platforms leveraging Snowflake for cloud data warehousing.
* Ensure best practices in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevOps for data engineering solutions.
* Drive ARB discussions end to end and responsible for the e2e life cycle of data products
* Implement advanced data engineering pipelines and machine learning workflows using Azure Databricks (including Delta Lake and medallion architecture).
* Drive integration of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for business intelligence and self\-service analytics.
* Mentor and Lead team members on Azure data engineering, Snowflake optimization, and Databricks performance tuning.
* Communicate progress, risks, and technical decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical designs and deliverables.
* Establish and enforce data governance, security, and compliance standards using Azure Purview and related tools.


Experience/ Skills

**Minimum qualification:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or related field.
* 18\+ years of experience in data engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
* Hands\-on expertise in Snowflake, Azure cloud services, including Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks.
* Proven experience with Snowflake for data warehousing and performance optimization.
* Strong programming skills in Python, SQL, and Spark/PySpark.
* Experience integrating Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for enterprise analytics.
* Deep understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data governance.

**Required Skills**

* Expertise in Snowflake, Data architecture, Azure Data Factory (ADF) for orchestrating complex data workflows.
* Proficiency in Snowflake architecture, query optimization, and cost management.
* Advanced knowledge of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and Spark performance tuning.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for data solutions.
* Strong understanding of Power BI dashboards, DAX, and integration with Microsoft Fabric.
* Ability to manage data security, compliance, and governance using Azure Purview.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 **Nice to Have Skills**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Certified Azure Data Engineer).
* Experience with machine learning pipelines and advanced analytics.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and DevOps practices for data engineering.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team\-building skills.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
