title: Director, Human Resources
description:
#### **Who We Are Looking For**



As a Director of Human Resources, you will define and execute an employee\-focused HR strategy. You will shape a workplace where people thrive personally and professionally, driving organizational unity, high trust, and cross\-cultural synergy. With a focus on collaboration, efficiency and results, you will lead the India Employee Success team and work closely with India employees, leaders, Country Manager and Global leaders on ensuring the seamless implementation and execution of all HR processes, policies, and programs. You will report to the Senior Director, Global TA \& HR.


#### **What You’ll Be Doing as A Part of Our Team**



Leadership \& Strategy


* Develop and execute HR strategies that support business objectives, in close collaboration with the Senior Director, Global TA \& HR and the India Country Manager.
* Lead the work of the Employee Success team, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to ensure high performance and professional development.
* Demonstrate understanding and appreciation of cultural nuances, especially between India and the US, to foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace environment.
* Drive results and impact with informed decision making by analyzing data, evaluating options, and considering the potential impact on the organization and its employees
* Demonstrate adaptability to changing business needs, regulatory environments, and cultural dynamics, demonstrating flexibility in approach and problem\-solving.


HR Operations, Compliance \& Risk Management


* Responsible for the full spectrum of Global HR processes and policies, including performance reviews, salary planning, goal setting, talent reviews, employee support programs, and employee relations.
* Develop corporate plans for a variety of HR matters such as compensation, benefits, health and safety, etc.
* Responsible for accurate, timely processing of payroll for all India employees
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, POSH, PF/ESI, and safety regulations, executing policies with fairness, integrity, and dignity.
* Stay abreast of legal changes and working closely with legal and leadership to implement necessary adjustments to HR policies and practices.
* Provide ongoing guidance and support to both onsite and global leaders on best HR practices and strategies to foster a fair and positive work environment.
* Anticipate and resolve litigation risks, ensuring a safe and compliant workplace.
* Collaborate with legal, India Country Manager and global leaders to ensure global alignment


Performance Management \& Talent Development


* Partner with local and global leadership to ensure our performance management strategies are human\-centric, clear, consistent and effective
* Identify and execute companywide leadership development programs, ensuring alignment with global strategies and local needs.
* Cultivate a culture of learning at all levels
* Develop and execute a cohort training strategy for new hires and new leaders


Employee Engagement \& Organizational Culture


* Foster a culture that aligns with our global and local values
* Oversee and enhance rewards and recognition programs, promoting a culture of excellence and meaningful appreciation across the organization.
* Educate leaders on best practices and encourage recognition
* Review of programs for effectiveness, fairness and alignment with budget


Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning


* Position the India GCC as an employer of choice by highlighting a culture of care, purpose\-driven work, equity, and continuous growth.
* Ensure a performance enablement approach focused on continuous feedback, development, coaching, and meaningful recognition.
* Partner with local and global leaders as well as US Employee Success team members on career pathing for India roles and teams
* Serve as a guide on compensation and ensure alignment with our India compensation philosophy


System Integrity, Data Analysis \& Reporting


* Responsible for Employee Success data integrity across all systems and records
* Manage timely Employee Success metrics reporting
* Review and analyze HR data to inform decision\-making processes, highlight successes, and identify areas for improvement.


Team Cohesiveness, Unity \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration


* Foster One\-Team Culture: Champion a unified company culture that breaks down functional silos and creates a strong sense of belonging across geographically distributed and hybrid teams.
* Drive mutual trust, open communication, and cross\-cultural alignment.
* Proactively monitor team dynamics, resolve interpersonal or cross\-departmental friction, and facilitate team\-building interventions that enhance psychological safety and trust.

#### **What You Should Have to Qualify**


* MBA / Master’s degree in Human Resources or Personnel Management from a recognized institution.
* 14\+ years of experience in Human Resources, with at least 6\-8 years in a leadership role managing diverse HR functions.
* Cross\-Cultural Leadership: Outstanding executive presence, cross\-cultural agility, change leadership, and communication skills
* Extensive knowledge of current employment laws, regulations and statutory compliance protocols.
* A strong ethical compass, maintaining confidentiality, demonstrating fairness, and earning the trust of employees and leadership alike
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise HRIS platforms (e.g., UKG, ADP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox, etc) and HR data reporting.
* Ability to be a strong coach \& player, with the ability to inspire and manage a multidisciplinary HR team.
* Ability to operate in a matrix reporting structure, balancing global strategies with local needs.

#### **Ideally, You Would Also Have These**


* Experience of working in IT services \& US healthcare (RCM) industries.

  


#### **Culture is at our Core**


* Service: Create Raving Fans
* Accountability: Follow Up; Own Up
* Attitude: Possess True Grit
* Personality: Be Minty
* Work Ethic: Be Rock Solid
* Community Outreach: Give Back
* Health and Wellness: Live Better
* Resource Efficiency: Do Más With Menos

#### **About Us**



Here, we work hard—but we have lots of fun doing it. We believe in equal opportunity for all, autonomy, trailblazing, and always doing right by our members. Most importantly, though, we believe in empowering rehab therapy professionals to achieve greatness in practice. So, if you’re a can\-do kinda person who loves to help Members win and enjoys working from just about anywhere—then you’ll fit right in. We’ve got big plans, but we can’t achieve them without you. Join us, and let’s achieve greatness.

The role
Own hiring end to end for Dezy, and support the wider employee lifecycle alongside it. \~70% Talent Acquisition · \~30% HR Operations \& Employee Engagement  

Talent Acquisition (\~70%)
Own end\-to\-end recruitment across clinical (General Dentists, Implantologists, Orthodontists, Endodontists, Prosthodontists, Oral Surgeons), clinic support (Dental Assistants, Front Office, Clinic Coordinators) and corporate roles (Sales, Growth, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain).
Run the full cycle — intake with the hiring manager, sourcing, screening, scheduling, feedback, salary negotiation, offer and closure.
Build pipelines ahead of new clinic launches, so hiring stays proactive rather than reactive.
Source across job portals, dental colleges and associations, referrals, social platforms and consultants.
Drive bulk hiring drives for clinic launches and assistant\-level roles.
Negotiate compensation confidently and close candidates within budget bands.
Stay engaged from offer to joining to minimise drop\-offs.
Maintain hiring trackers and MIS, and publish weekly status to stakeholders.
Deliver against time to hire — this is the headline metric for the role, alongside offer\-to\-join ratio and quality of hire.
HR Operations \& Employee Engagement (\~30%)

Ensure new joiners across clinics and corporate are set up before day one.
Provide accurate, on\-time attendance and payroll inputs — LOP, working days, joiner and leaver data.
Run exits cleanly: resignation processing, clearance, asset recovery coordination and exit interviews.
Drive engagement through clinic connects, recognition, celebrations and feedback initiatives.

What we're looking for
1–3 years of experience in end\-to\-end recruitment with clear ownership of closures.
Prior HR experience in the healthcare industry, or in high\-volume hiring — this is essential for the role, as clinical hiring starts from week one.
Ability to hire at volume and at speed without dropping quality.
Strong communication skills — you'll be speaking to doctors, specialists and senior leaders.
Confident salary negotiation skills; comfortable handling counter\-offers.
Comfortable with trackers, hiring MIS and reporting numbers you can defend.
Working knowledge of HR operations — onboarding, attendance, documentation, exits.
Graduate / Postgraduate, preferably MBA\-HR or equivalent.  

Good to have: experience hiring clinical professionals; exposure to multi\-city or expansion hiring; hands\-on with an ATS or HRMS.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Staffing

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities for assigned positions.
* Understand manpower requirements from respective departments.
* Prepare and post job descriptions on appropriate job portals and recruitment platforms.
* Source and screen candidates through job portals, references, databases, and other channels.
* Conduct preliminary HR interviews and coordinate further rounds with concerned departments.
* Schedule interviews and maintain candidate records.
* Coordinate salary discussions, selection, offer release, and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and track open positions.

2\. Employee Onboarding \& Induction

* Coordinate pre\-joining and joining documentation.
* Conduct employee onboarding and HR induction.
* Explain company policies, rules, benefits, attendance procedures, and code of conduct.
* Ensure timely completion of joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Coordinate with departments for smooth integration of new employees.
* Maintain and update employee personnel files and HR records.

3\. Attendance \& Leave Management

* Monitor daily attendance, late coming, absenteeism, and leave records.
* Maintain and update employee attendance and leave data.
* Coordinate with employees and department heads regarding attendance discrepancies.
* Prepare attendance reports for payroll processing.
* Ensure adherence to company leave and attendance policies.

4\. Employee Records \& HR Documentation

* Maintain accurate and updated employee master data.
* Maintain personnel files, appointment letters, confirmation letters, appraisal records, and other HR documents.
* Prepare HR letters and documentation as required.
* Ensure proper documentation of employee movements, transfers, promotions, and other changes.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.

5\. Probation \& Confirmation

* Track employee probation periods and ensure timely review.
* Coordinate probation feedback with reporting managers.
* Maintain probation review records.
* Prepare and issue confirmation or extension letters based on management decisions.

6\. Performance Management

* Support the implementation of monthly/periodic employee performance reviews.
* Coordinate with department heads for KRA/KPI and performance feedback.
* Track completion of performance evaluation processes.
* Maintain performance records and assist in annual appraisal activities.
* Identify recurring performance or behavioural concerns and escalate them appropriately.

7\. Employee Engagement \& Relations

* Support employee engagement activities and internal events.
* Act as a point of contact for routine employee queries and concerns.
* Promote positive employee relations and a healthy workplace environment.
* Assist in resolving employee grievances in coordination with the HR Head.
* Conduct employee feedback initiatives and assist in implementing corrective actions.

8\. Learning \& Development

* Identify training requirements in coordination with department heads.
* Assist in planning and coordinating employee training programs.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance, feedback, and training records.
* Follow up on training effectiveness where required.

9\. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Ensure employees are aware of and follow company HR policies.
* Support implementation of HR policies and processes.
* Maintain statutory and HR compliance\-related documentation as applicable.
* Coordinate with relevant internal/external stakeholders for HR compliance requirements.
* Keep HR records organised and audit\-ready.

10\. Payroll Coordination

* Coordinate with the accounts/payroll team for monthly payroll inputs.
* Provide accurate attendance, leave, new joining, exit, deduction, and other employee\-related information.
* Verify payroll\-related HR data before processing.
* Address employee queries related to attendance and payroll inputs.

11\. Exit \& Full \& Final Process

* Coordinate employee resignation and exit formalities.
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews.
* Ensure clearance and handover processes are completed.
* Coordinate with Accounts and concerned departments for full \& final settlement.
* Issue relieving, experience, and other required documents as per company policy.

12\. HR MIS \& Reporting

* Prepare and maintain regular HR reports and MIS.
* Track headcount, recruitment status, attrition, absenteeism, attendance, probation, and employee movements.
* Maintain HR dashboards and records for management review.
* Provide accurate HR data whenever required by management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Recruitment turnaround time and position closure rate
* Quality and retention of new hires
* Accuracy of employee records and HR documentation
* Timely completion of onboarding and exit formalities
* Attendance and leave record accuracy
* Timely completion of probation and performance reviews
* Employee grievance resolution and response time
* Training and employee engagement coordination
* Accuracy and timeliness of payroll inputs
* HR MIS accuracy and timely reporting
* Compliance with internal HR policies and processes

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Good understanding of HR processes and employee lifecycle
* Good knowledge of recruitment and interviewing
* Strong documentation and record\-keeping skills
* Good command of MS Excel and MS Office
* Ability to prepare and maintain HR MIS
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills
* Good problem\-solving ability
* High level of confidentiality and professionalism
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Employee\-friendly and approachable attitude

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.

Overview:
**Job Description: Sales Planning \& Sales Compensation Domain Expert****Role Title:** Domain Expert – Sales Planning \& Sales Compensation (Telecom / Enterprise Segment)  

**Engagement Context:** Digital transformation of Sales Planning \& Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform for a US Tier\-1 Telecom Operator serving Enterprise/B2B segments**About the Role**
We are seeking a Sales Planning and Sales Compensation Domain Expert to support the transformation of a legacy sales planning and compensation platform for a leading US Tier\-1 telecommunications operator. The platform serves multiple enterprise customer segments (e.g., SMB, Mid\-Market, Large Enterprise, Global/Strategic Accounts) and this role will be central to defining business requirements, validating solution design, and ensuring the modernized platform aligns with complex, segment\-specific sales compensation and territory/quota planning models.
Responsibilities:
* **Key Responsibilities**
	+ Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on sales planning, territory \& quota management, and incentive compensation processes within a telecom enterprise sales context
	+ Analyze current\-state (as\-is) sales planning and compensation workflows, systems (e.g., ICM/SPM tools like Varicent, Xactly, SAP Callidus, Anaplan), and pain points across different enterprise segments
	+ Define future\-state (to\-be) business requirements and process flows for territory design, quota setting, plan administration, crediting, and payout calculation
	+ Partner with architects and engineering teams to translate compensation business rules into system logic, data models, and workflow configurations
	+ Validate that plan designs correctly handle segment\-specific nuances (e.g., differing quota structures, deal complexity, channel/overlay roles, named accounts vs. geo\-based territories)
	+ Support data mapping and migration efforts from legacy systems, ensuring compensation history, hierarchy, and crediting rules are preserved accurately
	+ Lead or contribute to UAT planning, test case design, and validation of calculated payouts against expected business outcomes
	+ Advise on compliance, audit, and SOX\-related controls typical of enterprise sales compensation platforms
	+ Collaborate with sales operations, finance, HR, and IT stakeholders on both client and delivery sides
	+ Support change management and training material development for end users (sales reps, managers, comp analysts)
	+ Document business rules, edge cases, and exception\-handling logic clearly for technical teams


Requirements:
**Required Experience \& Skills*** 8\+ years of experience in Sales Planning, Sales Compensation, or Incentive Compensation Management, ideally within telecom or a comparable B2B/enterprise sales environment
* Strong understanding of enterprise sales segmentation (SMB, Mid\-Market, Enterprise, Strategic/Global Accounts) and how compensation/territory models differ across them
* Hands\-on functional experience with one or more ICM/SPM platforms (e.g., Varicent, Xactly, SAP Callidus/CallidusCloud, Anaplan, Oracle Incentive Compensation, NICE Performance Management)
* Deep knowledge of compensation plan design elements: quota allocation, crediting rules, tiered/accelerator payouts, draws, clawbacks, SPIFs, and dispute management
* Experience with territory and quota planning methodologies, including account\-based and geo\-based models
* Familiarity with telecom sales processes — order\-to\-cash, CPQ, CRM (Salesforce preferred), billing/OSS\-BSS touchpoints — is a strong plus
* Ability to translate ambiguous business rules into clear, structured requirements for technical teams
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable working with both business and technical audiences
* Experience supporting system migrations or platform transformations (legacy to modern SaaS\-based ICM) is highly desirable

title: Staff Business Systems Analyst
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary:**
----------------


The Staff HR Technology Architect is the senior technical authority for OpenGov’s HR technology ecosystem, responsible for the architecture, integration design, and long\-term technical direction of the systems that manage employee data across the entire employee lifecycle. Based in Pune and reporting to the Director of Enterprise Applications and Engineering, this individual\-contributor role sets the technical vision for the Workday platform and the broader HR application portfolio, ensuring the ecosystem is scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned to the needs of a global workforce across the US and India.


We are looking for a seasoned architect with deep domain and technical expertise across the Workday platform and the adjacent, integrated systems that make up the HR technology ecosystem — spanning payroll, benefits, talent management, talent acquisition, onboarding and offboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and HR operations. This is a hands\-on, staff\-level individual contributor with a dotted\-line leadership mandate: no direct reports, but expected to guide and mentor HR application administrators, lead virtual teams on major initiatives, and influence the direction both technical and business teams take with HR technology. While the role is primarily architecture and design, it also carries hands\-on technical delivery — the architect personally builds and delivers the most complex or high\-risk integrations, configurations, and reports. The architect owns integration architecture and the HR data model end to end across best\-of\-breed systems, partners with the Manager, HR Technology on delivery, and serves as the design authority on data governance, security, and emerging AI and automation across the stack.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Technical Architecture \& Systems Design**

* Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the HR technology ecosystem — Workday (Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting, and Security) and the surrounding application portfolio — establishing design standards, patterns, and technical roadmaps.
* Own the architecture across a best\-of\-breed, multi\-platform landscape — the core HRIS (Workday) plus payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby), employee engagement (CultureAmp), ERP (e.g., NetSuite), SSO/identity, compliance/training platforms, data\-warehousing and BI tooling (e.g., Snowflake), and iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) — ensuring the systems interoperate as a coherent whole.
* Define target\-state architecture and multi\-year technical roadmaps that scale with a growing, globally distributed workforce, balancing configuration, extensibility, and total cost of ownership.
* Evaluate new Workday releases, features, and third\-party solutions; make build\-vs\-configure\-vs\-buy recommendations and lead architecture and design reviews.
* Provide deep, hands\-on technical expertise across the ecosystem — anchored in the Workday stack (advanced configuration, the business process framework, calculated fields, security design, and complex reporting) and extending to adjacent platforms such as ADP, Ashby, CultureAmp, and NetSuite/ERP.

**Integration Architecture \& Data Flows**

* Design and govern the integration architecture across the HR ecosystem (e.g., ADP, Ashby, engagement survey, SSO/identity, ERP, and downstream data\-warehouse/BI platforms such as Snowflake), leveraging iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato) where appropriate and establishing patterns, standards, and error handling and monitoring.
* Own the HR data model and the flow of employee data from hire to retire, ensuring integrity, lineage, and consistency across integrated systems.
* Serve as design authority for Workday integrations (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web service APIs), iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato), and downstream data platform feeds.
* Maintain a working understanding of how HRIS data ties into ERP (e.g., NetSuite) and other enterprise systems, and lead the design of those interfaces.

**Technical Strategy \& Influence**

* Set the technical direction for HR technology and influence the decisions both technical and business teams make when adopting or changing technology.
* Partner with HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, HR Business Partners, IT, and Workplace leaders to translate business strategy into a coherent systems strategy.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership, framing trade\-offs, risks, and options for major HR technology investments and platform decisions.
* Provide dotted\-line technical leadership and mentorship to HR application administrators; lead virtual and matrixed teams on large initiatives and build technical depth and backup coverage across critical domains.

**Data Governance, Security \& AI**

* Serve as the design authority for HR data governance, privacy, and security — defining data structures, access models, and controls across the US and India.
* Establish standards for HR data quality, master data, and reporting and analytics that feed data\-warehouse and BI platforms (e.g., Snowflake).
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply automation and AI within the HR technology stack, establishing responsible\-use and data\-handling guardrails.
* Ensure the architecture supports compliance requirements across geographies (audits, policy acknowledgements, and mandatory training) and evolving data\-privacy regulations.

**Delivery, Vendors \& Best Practices**

* Lead complex, cross\-functional HR technology projects end to end from an architecture and design standpoint — shaping solutions, reviewing designs, and guiding delivery teams.
* Stay hands\-on with technical delivery — personally building and delivering the most complex or high\-risk configurations, integrations, and reports rather than limiting the role to design and oversight.
* Partner with the Manager, HR Technology and the administration team to translate architecture into configuration, and maintain documentation of architecture, standards, and system specifications.
* Manage strategic third\-party vendor and implementation\-partner relationships from a technical and architecture perspective.
* Stay current on Workday releases, HR technology trends, and best practices; exhibit sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality in handling sensitive employee data.

**Requirements and Preferred Experience:**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
* 10\+ years of progressive HR technology / HRIS functional and technical experience, including significant time in an architecture, principal, or senior technical individual\-contributor capacity.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical authority who sets direction and influences both technical and business stakeholders — this is a senior individual\-contributor role, not an entry\-level or first architecture role.
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in a core HRIS — Workday strongly preferred — across the full module stack (Absence, Benefits, Compensation, Core HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Reporting, Security, Talent, Time Tracking), including advanced configuration and the business process framework.
* Hands\-on experience across a multi\-platform HR technology ecosystem — not limited to a single HRIS — including payroll (e.g., ADP), applicant tracking (Ashby preferred), employee engagement (CultureAmp preferred), SSO/identity, and compliance/training platforms.
* Strong Workday integration expertise (EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and web services/APIs) and proven experience designing enterprise integration architectures, including iPaaS/integration platforms (e.g., Workato).
* Expertise in HR data modeling, data governance, and how HRIS data flows into downstream data\-warehouse and BI systems (e.g., Snowflake).

title: Associate Director HR Operational Excellence
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Responsible for driving strategic initiatives that enhance efficiency, compliance, and scalability across global payroll and HR service delivery. This role will lead transformation programs, implement best practices, and ensure operational excellence through process optimization, automation, and stakeholder engagement.


Global Transformation \& Strategy\-Execute to a global transformation roadmap for payroll and HR services aligned with organizational goals.


Lead large\-scale change management initiatives to modernize processes and systems. Partner with technology teams to implement automation, AI, and digital solutions for payroll.


Operational Excellence\-Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, and quality standards for payroll and HR service delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies. Ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.


Stakeholder Management\-Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and regional teams to ensure seamless integration of processes. Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on payroll and HR operational strategies. Risk \& Compliance\-Oversee risk management frameworks for payroll and HR services.


Your Future at Kyndryl
  

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


**Required Skills and Experience:**

* MBA with 15 years of experience
* Agile \& Continuous Improvement Mindset: Six Sigma Black Belt Certification, Change Management Professional (CCMP), Project management (PMP) or RPA Certification
* A change agent: Adopting and implementing strategies to improve adherence to global processes including having knowledge of industry best practices. Adapt AI skills and technologies to drive automation and efficiency.
* Communication \& Training: Excellent written and verbal communication to effectively interact with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Hands On ability to design and write policies, procedures and job aid documentation. Educate teams on new payroll processes and technologies to ensure adoption.
* Payroll Compliance \& Risk Management: Stay updated on global, regional, and local payroll laws to ensure compliance. Implement internal controls and audits to mitigate compliance risks. Implement forensic payroll audits to identify fraud risks.
* Data Security \& Privacy: Ensure payroll data adheres to GDPR, SOC 1, ISO 27001, and other security roles/standards and organizational guidelines.
* Technology and Automation: Lead the adoption of cloud\-based HR solutions.
* SLAs \& KPIs and Data Analytics: Track accuracy, efficiency, cycle times, employee experience and compliance.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Excellent Communication skills

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Job Purpose

To manage and support the day\-to\-day HR operations of the hospital, including recruitment, manpower planning, employee records, attendance, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, employee relations, training, performance management, and NABH\-related HR documentation. The role requires coordination with clinical and non\-clinical departments to ensure effective workforce management and compliance with hospital policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for clinical, nursing, paramedical, administrative, and support staff.
* Coordinate with HODs regarding approved manpower requirements and vacancies.
* Source, screen, shortlist, and schedule candidates for interviews.
* Coordinate offer release, salary approvals, joining, and induction.
* Conduct document verification and background verification as applicable.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and manpower status reports.

2\. HR Operations \& Employee Records

* Maintain accurate employee personal files and HRMS records.
* Ensure completion of joining documentation and statutory forms.
* Issue and maintain HR\-related letters, including appointment, confirmation, transfer, promotion, warning, and relieving letters.
* Coordinate probation reviews and employee confirmations.
* Maintain confidentiality and proper custody of employee records.
* Handle employee separation and exit documentation.

3\. Attendance, Leave \& Payroll Coordination

* Monitor biometric attendance, duty rosters, late coming, absenteeism, permissions, overtime, and leave records.
* Coordinate with HODs to resolve attendance and roster discrepancies.
* Verify attendance and leave data before submission for monthly payroll processing.
* Coordinate payroll inputs relating to new joiners, resignations, LOP, overtime, incentives, allowances, and deductions.
* Support Full and Final Settlement processes.

4\. Statutory Compliance

* Coordinate and maintain compliance related to PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, Gratuity, and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, challans, returns, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with consultants and external agencies for statutory compliance activities.
* Support labour inspections, internal audits, and compliance reviews.

5\. Employee Relations \& Discipline

* Address employee queries, grievances, and workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
* Coordinate grievance handling and employee welfare activities.
* Support disciplinary actions and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Ensure employees follow hospital rules, policies, and code of conduct.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify key employee\-relations concerns.

6\. Training \& Development

* Coordinate employee induction and orientation programs.
* Assist in conducting Training Need Analysis (TNA).
* Coordinate departmental and mandatory training programs.
* Maintain training calendars, attendance, feedback, and training records.
* Support evaluation of training effectiveness.

7\. NABH \& Hospital Compliance

* Maintain HR\-related documents and records required for NABH and other hospital audits.
* Support documentation related to recruitment, induction, training, competency assessment, employee records, and performance evaluation.
* Coordinate with departments for closure of HR\-related audit observations.
* Ensure required employee documentation is readily available during internal and external assessments.

8\. Performance Management

* Coordinate probation and confirmation evaluations.
* Support the performance appraisal process.
* Maintain appraisal and performance\-related records.
* Coordinate with HODs regarding performance improvement and training requirements.

9\. HRMS \& MIS Reporting

* Ensure accurate and timely updation of employee data in HRMS.
* Prepare and maintain HR MIS and management reports.
* Track manpower, recruitment, absenteeism, attrition, attendance, overtime, and employee movement.
* Maintain HR dashboards and trackers as required by management.

10\. Employee Engagement \& Welfare

* Coordinate employee engagement and recognition activities.
* Support employee welfare initiatives.
* Assist in improving employee communication and workplace culture.
* Coordinate with concerned departments for employee\-related facilities and welfare requirements.

Qualifications

* **MBA – Human Resources / MSW (HR) / PGDM in HR or equivalent**
* Additional qualification in Labour Laws or Hospital Administration will be an advantage.

description:
The purpose of this role is to assist the Commercial Finance team in delivering timely and accurate information to the business through analysis of business unit performance. The role will utilise financial analysis techniques to provide insight, analysis and trends on critical business issues impacting the day\-to\-day performance of a business unit for consideration by senior stakeholders.  

  

This position will be part of the Americas Planning \& Reporting Centre of Excellence (PRCoE), based in Bangalore, India, and will report directly to the Americas Associate Director of Planning \& Reporting Centre of Excellence. The candidate will collaborate closely with other commercials, clients, controllers \& FP\&A, as well as with onshore teams. This role will lead a team who will provide comprehensive support for all commercial finance related activities across the specific practice that he or she is allocated upon.  

This role requires the candidate to be available during partial UK / US hours (3:00 PM IST to 12:00 AM IST). Flexibility to adjust work timings according to business requirements is essential.**Job Description:**


Key responsibilities:

* Collects and analyses financial information to support commercial decision making
* Identifies and monitors underlying drivers of cost and revenue variances between actual expenditure vs. forecast/budget, highlighting issues and margin impact where necessary
* Works proactively with the business to analyse and build the forecasts, improves data capture and process and helps generate useful insight to share with the business
* Supports the business in their development of short, medium and long\-term resourcing requirements
* Provides analytical support focused around obtaining the optimal balance of pricing, early payment discounts, rebates and volume commitments
* Participates on bid teams for pitches and new business driving appropriate commercial terms, pricing and profitability
* Supplies ad\-hoc financial information and analysis as and when required
* Revenue \& cost forecasting, variance analysis and tracking.
* Setting margin and profitability targets and analyzing performance, identifying and monitoring underlying drivers of cost and revenue variances between actual vs. forecast/budget, highlighting issues and margin impact where necessary
* Pricing and staff plan optimization, including time reporting and staffing reconciliations
* Working capital management – WIP/AR/Media Liability reporting
* Oversee intercompany agreements and manage cross charges
* This position is responsible for handling highly confidential information, requiring an ability to maintain and display high ethical standards including confidentiality, discretion, and exemplary judgment with respect to such information
* Supply ad\-hoc financial information and analysis as and when required
* Work with client teams to ensure revenue tracking systems are up to date
* Develop, maintain and distribute ad\-hoc reports and financial models as needed \- Assist Commercial Finance Business Partners with special projects.
* Assist with providing advice on strategic financial plans in partnership with business leaders to make key decisions and achieve targets
* Provide support identifying and driving operational improvement through analysis of financial plans
* Support analysis of client profitability and identify and support initiatives to improve profitability/margin
* Facilitate management of revenue forecast in MSFT D365 and pipeline within Salesforce
* This position is responsible for handling highly confidential information, requiring an ability to maintain and display high ethical standards including confidentiality, discretion, and exemplary judgment with respect to such information.
* Job and project management – rate card checks and updates
* Client Audit Co\-Ordination
* Support with the RFI/RFP
* Support with overall AR and write off management process

 **Candidate Qualifications**

**Academics/Work Experience:**

* Freshers Qualified CA / ACCA or CPA or with 1\+ years of progressive experience in commercial finance, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.
* CMA / CIMA / CA Inter with 4\+ years of similar experience as stated above.

**Technical Competencies:**

* Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, modeling, etc.).Familiarity with financial systems and tools such as D365, SAP BPC, Workday, Tableau, and Concur. Understanding around commercial aspects and good knowledge around forecasting, and reporting.

 **Key Attributes:**

* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage complex data.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Strategic thinker with a proactive and solutions\-oriented approach to problem\-solving.
* Adaptability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

* Strong analytical, solution\-oriented thinking with the ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions

title: ERP Sales & Business Analyst
description:
**Experience:** Freshers and experienced candidates can apply  
**Work Type:** Field Sales / Client Visits

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and business\-oriented **ERP Sales \& Business Analyst** who can identify potential customers, understand their business requirements, and present ERP solutions that address their operational needs.

This is a **field\-based role**, where the candidate will be required to visit businesses and meet clients/customers in person to understand their requirements and **conduct live ERP product demonstrations**.

Key ResponsibilitiesERP Sales \& Lead Generation

* Identify businesses that can benefit from ERP solutions for **Accounting, Trading, Payroll, Sales \& Distribution, and Inventory**.
* Generate leads through calls, meetings, online channels, and direct client visits.
* Visit prospective clients and conduct **face\-to\-face product demonstrations**.
* Explain ERP features, modules, benefits, and suitability according to the client's business.
* Follow up with prospects and convert leads into customers.
* Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.

Client Onboarding \& Support

* Guide new customers through account creation and ERP implementation/onboarding.
* Explain modules such as accounting, payroll, inventory, and sales management.
* Ensure customers understand the basic functionality and usage of the ERP.
* Maintain regular communication with clients during the onboarding process.

Business Requirement Analysis

* Understand the client's business processes, workflows, and operational challenges.
* Identify gaps and recommend suitable ERP solutions.
* Map customer requirements with the relevant ERP modules and features.
* Collect client feedback and improvement requirements.

Business \& Market Analysis

* Identify market opportunities and industries with demand for ERP solutions.
* Research competitor ERP products, features, and pricing.
* Track customer requirements and market trends.
* Suggest potential features or modules based on market demand.

Coordination with Product Team

* Communicate customer requirements and feedback to the internal product/development team.
* Share suggestions for improving ERP usability and functionality.
* Coordinate internally to ensure customer requirements are properly understood.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Accounting, Inventory, and Business Operations**.
* Understanding of ERP systems or business software.
* Strong **sales, negotiation, and convincing skills**.
* Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to confidently present and demonstrate software **in front of clients/customers**.
* Ability to understand business processes and identify customer requirements.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and reporting**.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and demonstrations.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working in a target\-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualification

* BCA / MCA
* MBA
* Finance / Business Management or related qualification

Candidates with experience in **ERP sales, accounting software, software sales, business consulting, or B2B sales** will be preferred.

**Freshers with strong communication, presentation, and sales skills are also encouraged to apply.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new ERP clients acquired.
* Product demo\-to\-conversion ratio.
* Client onboarding success rate.
* Monthly ERP subscription revenue.
* Number and quality of client feedback/product improvement suggestions.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **confident, presentable, persuasive, and comfortable meeting clients face\-to\-face**. If you enjoy interacting with businesses, understanding their requirements, presenting software solutions, and converting prospects into customers, this role is a good fit for you.

**Apply now with your updated resume.**

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

title: Computer Vision Engineer II (Microscopy Imaging)
description:
#### **Join us and contribute to the discovery of medicines that will impact lives!**


### **Location: Hyderabad, India**

### **Experience: Freshers to 5 Years**

### **About Aganitha**


**Accelerate drug discovery and development for Biopharma and Biotech R\&D with** ***in silico*** **solutions leveraging Computational Biology \& Chemistry, High throughput Sciences, AI, ML, HPC, Cloud, Data, and DevOps.**

*In silico* solutions are transforming the biopharma and biotech industries. Our cross\-domain science and technology team of experts embark upon and industrialize this transformation. We continually expand our world\-class multi\-disciplinary team in Genomics, AI, and Cloud computing, accelerating drug discovery and development. What drives us is the joy of working in an innovation\-rich, research\-powered startup bridging multiple disciplines to bring medicines faster for human use. We are working with several innovative Biopharma companies and expanding our client base globally. Read about how and what solutions we build.

*Aganitha (अगणित): “countless” or “limitless” in Sanskrit serves as a reminder and inspiration about the limitless potential in each one of us. Come join us to bring out your best and be limitless!*

  


### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to design and develop custom algorithms for microscopy and biomedical image analysis. You will build end\-to\-end image analysis pipelines, work with cutting\-edge deep learning and vision foundation models, and collaborate closely with biologists, scientists, and AI researchers to solve real\-world imaging challenges.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design and develop custom computer vision algorithms using Python, OpenCV, and deep learning frameworks for microscopy image analysis.
* Build end\-to\-end image analysis pipelines tailored to microscopy workflows, from raw acquisition to quantitative output.
* Work with diverse microscopy modalities, including Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Fluorescence, Confocal, and other light/electron microscopy datasets.
* Develop solutions for cell and tissue segmentation (including instance and semantic segmentation), cell/organelle detection, tracking, and morphological feature extraction.
* Design algorithms for image enhancement, denoising, deconvolution, and artifact correction specific to microscopy data (e.g., uneven illumination, photobleaching, low\-light noise).
* Build quantitative image analysis tools for measuring cell counts, morphology, intensity, colocalization, and other biologically relevant metrics.
* Design and implement custom algorithms rather than relying solely on off\-the\-shelf microscopy software tools (e.g., ImageJ/Fiji, CellProfiler), where custom solutions offer greater accuracy or flexibility.
* Leverage, adapt, and fine\-tune modern deep learning and vision foundation models (e.g., segmentation foundation models, self\-supervised models) for microscopy\-specific applications.
* Handle large\-scale, high\-dimensional microscopy data (multi\-channel, z\-stacks, time\-lapse) efficiently, including preprocessing and pipeline optimization.
* Collaborate with biologists, microscopists, and AI researchers to translate experimental imaging needs into robust computational solutions.
* Evaluate, validate, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for accuracy, robustness, and computational performance on microscopy datasets.


### **Qualifications, Skills \& Candidate Profile**

* B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* **Experienced candidates (2\-5 years) are welcome to apply.**
* Strong programming skills in Python and hands\-on experience with OpenCV.
* Good understanding of Computer Vision, Image Processing, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning, with a focus on microscopy image analysis.
* Experience implementing, training, and evaluating deep learning models using PyTorch or similar frameworks, ideally applied to cell/tissue imaging tasks.
* Familiarity with modern vision architectures such as CNNs, Vision Transformers (ViTs), segmentation models (e.g., U\-Net, Mask R\-CNN, Cellpose, StarDist), and vision foundation models (e.g., SAM) as applied to microscopy.
* Knowledge of cell/tissue/organelle segmentation, feature extraction, image enhancement, denoising, and custom image processing pipeline development for microscopy data.
* Hands\-on exposure to microscopy imaging modalities such as Brightfield, Phase Contrast, Fluorescence, or Confocal microscopy is preferred.
* Familiarity with tissue staining image data coming from sectioning
* Experience through industry projects, academic research, internships, thesis work, or personal projects involving microscopy or cell imaging data.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and research skills, particularly in interpreting biological/imaging data.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
We are looking for a
 **Software Test Engineer with 1–2 years of experience** 
 in functional testing, defect management, regression testing, integration validation, and quality reporting. The candidate will be responsible for reproducing and analyzing defects, validating fixes, supporting regression and integration testing, maintaining release evidence, and contributing to overall product quality.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Perform functional, regression, and integration testing of applications.
* Reproduce reported defects and analyze steps, conditions, and environments required to recreate issues.
* Log, track, prioritize, and follow up on defects using tools such as JIRA or Azure DevOps.
* Retest defect fixes and verify that issues are completely resolved.
* Execute regression testing to ensure new changes do not impact existing functionality.
* Perform integration validation across applications, services, APIs, or connected components.
* Prepare and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test data, and test execution reports.
* Collect and maintain release evidence including test results, defect status, screenshots/logs, and validation records.
* Support release readiness activities by providing quality status and test execution reports.
* Identify quality risks, recurring defects, and gaps in test coverage.
* Collaborate with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve defects.
* Participate in defect triage, release discussions, and Agile ceremonies.
* Ensure testing activities are completed within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.

title: Intermediate Software Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As an Intermediate Software Engineer in GitLab's Security section, you'll contribute to the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities. You'll design and develop well\-scoped features within the systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third\-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.
   

  

 You'll work with clear context and strong support from the Senior Software Engineers and Staff Software Engineers around you. You'll stay hands\-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services while building depth in PostgreSQL and a specialized security domain. Over time, you'll grow toward owning larger and more ambiguous pieces of work.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop, and ship well\-scoped features within the systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, improving data\-ingestion reliability and query performance as measured by defined reliability and query\-performance metrics.
* Work on the PostgreSQL data layer that supports vulnerability and dependency management, developing your database skills alongside engineers with deep expertise.
* Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust as the team expands beyond the monolith.
* Contribute to integrations with key third\-party security systems.
* Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, asking questions early and raising constraints as you find them.
* Collaborate with product and engineering partners on the details of your deliverables.
* Deliver iteratively within GitLab's monthly release cycle and communicate progress clearly.
* Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Professional backend engineering experience shipping features to production as part of a collaborative team.
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, including indexes, query plans, and schema design, and an interest in developing this into a specialization.
* Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, or Python, plus comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day and an interest in working across languages and services.
* Experience taking a feature from description through production and asking clear questions early when requirements are ambiguous.
* Clear written communication and comfort working remotely and asynchronously across time zones.
* An interest in the security domain. Experience with vulnerability management, dependency management, or security tooling is helpful, and we welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.
* Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery and accelerate your learning while applying sound engineering judgment.


**About The Team**
 The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab. We work with clear goals and shared priorities: you'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

description:

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

description:
**Marketing \& Social Media Intern \- Nufyt**  
**Kolhapur \| On\-site \|** 

**About Nufyt**

Nufyt is a clean\-label, plant\-based protein brand. Our products are live on Amazon, Blinkit, and our own site, shipping to customers across India.

We're built out of Kolhapur \- not Mumbai, not Bengaluru. That's unusual, and it's the point. You get to work on a national consumer brand without leaving home, and you get to see how one actually gets built, from formulation to packaging to the ad someone sees at 11pm.

**The role**

We're hiring **Marketing \& Social Media Interns** to join the core team. This is not a fetch\-coffee internship and it's not a "post on Instagram twice a week" internship. You'll work directly with the founder on what Nufyt says, shows, and sounds like every single day.

**What you'll do**

* Plan and produce content for Instagram \- reels, carousels, stories
* Spot trends and turn them into Nufyt content fast, without it feeling forced
* Write captions, hooks, and copy that sound like a person, not a brand deck
* Build simple content systems \- a calendar, a shot list, a reusable format \- so output stays consistent
* Track what worked: saves, shares, watch time, and feed that back into what we make next
* Help with community \- replying to DMs and comments, talking to customers
* Support product launches, campaigns, and offline events
* Take real 0→1 creative decisions alongside the founder

**Who we're looking for**

* You have taste. You notice when something is well\-made and can say why.
* You execute fast. A rough reel out today beats a perfect one next week.
* You understand content beyond aesthetics \- storytelling, recall, community, brand.
* You're comfortable being on camera, or comfortable directing someone who is.
* You follow good consumer brands and can name a few you love, and why.
* Curious, proactive, and not waiting to be told what to do next.

**Not required:** a marketing degree, prior internships, or an existing following. Students and freshers are welcome. If you run a meme page, a food page, or edit reels for a friend's business \- that counts, and we want to see it.

**What you get**

* Work that goes live publicly within days, not quarters
* Real exposure to the full stack: paid ads, packaging, marketplaces, retail, events
* A certificate and a genuine recommendation if you do good work
* Strong performance converts to a full\-time role

**Details**

* **Location:** Kolhapur. On\-site. Not remote, not work\-from\-home.
* **Duration:** 6 months, full\-time or a serious part\-time commitment if you're a student
* **Start:** Immediate

**How to apply**

Email **hello@nufyt.com** with subject line **"Marketing Intern \- Kolhapur"** and include:

* A one\-line intro \- who you are, what you're doing right now
* Any content you've made \- reels, a page you run, edits, writing. Anything.
* One brand whose content you love, and why, in 2–3 lines

No CV needed. We'd rather see what you've made.

* Coordinate meetings and internal discussions.

6\. Events \& External Meetings

* Accompany founders to selected client meetings, networking events and business events.
* Assist with registrations and event coordination.
* Help collect business cards/contact information and potential leads.
* Maintain event follow\-up information.

7\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Prepare basic Excel/Google Sheets trackers.

Prepare meeting summaries and follow\-up lists.​

* Assist with presentations, reports and business documents.
* Maintain organized digital records.
* Prepare daily/weekly status updates when required.

Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong verbal and written English.
* Confidence in making professional calls.
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Good organizational ability.
* Proactive and energetic personality.
* Ability to multitask.
* Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, Word/Google Docs and email.
* Professional appearance and behaviour.
* Willingness to attend business events and external meetings.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

Freshers

Freshers are welcome to apply.

For freshers, we will focus more on:

* Communication
* Confidence
* Energy
* Ownership
* Learning ability
* Common sense
* Professionalism
* Follow\-up ability

Prior EA experience is not mandatory.

What You Will Learn

The role provides direct exposure to:

* Entrepreneurship
* Business development
* Client management
* Sales
* Operations
* Corporate meetings
* Networking
* Business events
* Founder\-level decision\-making

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate should gradually become someone the founders can depend on to say:

**“I’ll take care of it.”**

The objective is to reduce the founders’ time spent on coordination, reminders, scheduling and routine follow\-ups so they can focus more on business growth, clients, strategy and revenue.
