Money Pocket is looking for a **highly motivated Marketing \& Asset Management Intern** who wants to build real\-world experience in a growing startup environment.

We are **not looking for someone who only knows textbook marketing**. We are looking for someone who can think creatively, understand customers, experiment with ideas, analyse what works, and take ownership of tasks.

The ideal candidate should have **exceptional marketing ability, patience, maturity and a strong willingness to learn**. Since you will be working in a startup, you should be comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities and taking on responsibilities beyond a traditional job description.

What You'll Do

* Develop and execute **creative marketing strategies and campaigns**
* Identify new customer segments and growth opportunities
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research
* Create engaging content for **social media, websites and marketing campaigns**
* Support lead generation and customer acquisition
* Assist with branding and positioning of Money Pocket
* Analyse campaign performance and suggest improvements
* Assist with presentations, marketing reports and business proposals
* Support financial\-market and asset\-management related research
* Work directly with the founding/management team on **real business problems**
* Take ownership of projects from idea → execution → analysis

Who We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate:

**Exceptional Marketing Skills**  
You should understand how to attract attention, communicate value and turn ideas into marketing campaigns.

**Startup Mindset**  
You don't need extensive startup experience. However, you should be genuinely interested in learning how a company is built from the ground up.

**Patience \& Professional Maturity**  
We are looking for someone who **thinks before acting**, handles feedback professionally and doesn't make impulsive decisions.

**Curiosity \& Learning Ability**  
You don't need to know everything. We value someone who can say *"I don't know yet, but I'll learn it."*

**Ownership**  
If you're given a problem, we want you to think about possible solutions rather than simply waiting for instructions.

**Adaptability**  
Startup environments change quickly. You should be comfortable learning new tools, taking on new responsibilities and working across different areas.

Skills That Would Be an Advantage

* Digital Marketing
* Social Media Marketing
* Content Marketing
* SEO / SEM
* Lead Generation
* Market Research
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Canva / Figma
* CRM tools
* Analytics / Power BI

What You Will Get

This isn't an internship where you simply observe other people working.

You will have the opportunity to:

* Work on **real marketing projects**
* Learn how a startup operates
* Work directly with the management team
* Develop practical marketing and business skills
* Gain exposure to **financial markets and asset management**
* Build campaigns and see their actual results
* Develop your strategic thinking and decision\-making skills
* Potentially take on greater responsibility as the company grows

The Person We're Looking For

**If you are someone who is ambitious but patient, creative but analytical, confident but willing to learn, and excited by the idea of building something rather than simply working for something — we would like to hear from you.**

**This role is particularly suitable for someone who wants to understand what it takes to build a startup from the ground up.**

title: Agent Engineer
description:
The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do.
   

  

 The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest\-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive.
   

  

 The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation.
   

  

 We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.
   

  

 And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable.
   

  

**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is India's leading full\-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose\-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice\-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top\-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.
   

  

****What this role promises you****
**Production, at real scale**
 Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days.
   

  

**You work at the source**
 Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. When a deployment needs something that does not exist yet, whether that is model behaviour, an infrastructure capability or a product change, you are not filing a ticket with a vendor and waiting on a roadmap. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes.
   

  

**A genuinely broad surface**
 Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship.
   

  

****What you'll do****
* Build production agents on the Sarvam stack: prompts, system design, workflows, tool integrations, and evals.
* Map the space the agent has to cover. Work out the scenarios that matter, how each should be handled, and where the edges are, so coverage is designed rather than discovered later.
* Build the proof of concept when a customer wants to see it work before committing at scale, and get to a convincing result fast.
* Integrate into systems that were never designed for this: core banking, CRM, ticketing, telephony, and whatever else the customer runs.
* Own quality end to end. Define what good means for the use case, build the evals that measure it, and close the gap until the numbers hold.
* Engineer agents like software. Version them, review them, and hold them to a regression suite, so quality does not depend on who last edited a prompt.
* Tune for the constraints that decide whether a system survives production: accuracy, cost, reliability, and performance under real load.
* Design for scale and consistency from the outset. Systems that behave the same on the hundred\-thousandth interaction as the first, and that are instrumented well enough for anyone to see when they are not.
* Take a proven pattern into a new customer and make it fit their environment, at pace and at quality.
* At senior levels, own the technical build playbooks and the technical quality bar for a motion, and bring partner engineers up to it.


****Who you are****
 We are hiring across levels, from 3\+ years of experience. What matters more than years is whether you have built something real users depended on and kept it working.
   

  

* You have shipped to production and owned it afterwards. Not just built it. Kept it running, fixed it at 11pm, and let real usage change your assumptions.
* You have worked with LLMs and agents seriously. Context engineering, tool use, structured outputs, memory, and the failure modes that only show up at scale. You have used agentic frameworks and both open and closed source models.
* You bring engineering discipline to AI. You think in versions, tests, regressions and reproducibility. You are uncomfortable when a system's behaviour depends on a prompt nobody can account for.
* You take evals seriously. You can define metrics that matter for a use case, build the pipeline, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise.
* Strong Python and range across the stack. Backend services, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure. When you meet an unfamiliar stack you pick it up in hours.
* You design for the long run. You build systems that hold their behaviour over months, not just on launch day: predictable under real load, instrumented so problems are visible, and structured so someone else can reason about them.
* You can sit with a customer's engineering team. Understand their constraints, explain yours, and get to a workable answer without either side losing patience.


*Sarvam is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of background, identity, or personal characteristics. We believe the best AI for India can only be built by a team that reflects India.*

title: Project Engineer-Chitkara University
description:
**Position:** Project Engineer – Student Projects  
**Location:** Chitkara University, Punjab  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Applied Engineering

**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically strong and enthusiastic **Project Engineer** to support students in developing academic and practical engineering projects. The role involves understanding student requirements, designing project solutions, guiding hardware and software development, troubleshooting, testing, and helping students successfully demonstrate their projects.

The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in **Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), or Mechanical Engineering**, along with an interest in embedded systems, automation, robotics, and emerging technologies.

**Educational Qualification**

* **B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), or Mechanical Engineering (ME)**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Project Support**

* Understand student project requirements and convert them into practical project concepts.
* Guide students in selecting suitable components, technologies, and project architectures.
* Provide technical mentoring while ensuring students understand the project rather than simply completing it for them.
* Help students with project planning, prototyping, testing, debugging, and final demonstration.
* Assist students in preparing project documentation, circuit diagrams, presentations, and technical reports.

**Electronics**

* Work with development platforms such as **Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and similar microcontroller/development boards**.
* Assist with sensors, motors, relays, displays, communication modules, power supplies, and other electronic components.
* Develop and troubleshoot basic embedded applications.
* Interface hardware components with microcontrollers and development boards.
* Work on technologies such as **IoT, automation, robotics, wireless communication, and sensor\-based systems**.

**Programming \& Software**

* Basic\-to\-intermediate programming knowledge in **C/C\+\+, Arduino IDE, Python**, or similar languages.
* Debug and modify existing code based on project requirements.
* Help students understand program logic, sensor interfacing, communication protocols, and hardware\-software integration.

**Project Development**

* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concept models.
* Perform testing, troubleshooting, and validation of projects.
* Identify technical problems and provide practical solutions.
* Maintain project components, tools, development boards, and laboratory equipment.
* Stay updated with new technologies and project ideas relevant to engineering students.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Arduino / ESP32 / Raspberry Pi
* Microcontrollers and embedded systems
* Basic electronics and circuit design
* Sensors and actuators
* Motors and motor drivers
* IoT and wireless communication
* Bluetooth / Wi\-Fi / GSM / GPS modules
* Robotics and automation
* PCB basics
* C / C\+\+ / Arduino programming
* Basic Python
* Electrical wiring and troubleshooting
* Basic CAD/mechanical design knowledge for Mechanical Engineering candidates

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Strong practical and problem\-solving ability.
* Good understanding of engineering fundamentals.
* Comfortable working with hardware and electronic components.
* Patient and capable of explaining technical concepts to students in simple language.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to work on multiple student projects simultaneously.
* Creative approach to developing innovative project solutions.
* Freshers with strong academic projects and hands\-on skills are welcome.

**Experience**

**0–3 years** of experience in project development, embedded systems, robotics, automation, electronics, or engineering project support.

Fresh graduates with good hands\-on knowledge of **Arduino/ESP32, electronics, programming, and engineering projects** may also apply.

**Key Performance Areas**

* Successful completion of student projects.
* Quality and reliability of prototypes.
* Effective technical guidance to students.
* Troubleshooting and turnaround time.
* Development of innovative project concepts.
* Proper documentation and testing of projects.

**Salary:** Competitive and based on qualification, technical skills, and experience.

**Department:** Business Development / Student Success  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Hyderabad – Work from Office

About Corizo

Corizo is an EdTech company focused on helping students bridge the gap between academics and industry through practical training, internships, and career development programs.

We work with students to understand their career interests, introduce them to relevant opportunities, and support them in making informed decisions about their professional journey.

About the Role

We are looking for a **friendly, confident, and enthusiastic Inside Sales Representative** who enjoys talking to people and helping students explore career opportunities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **communication, interacting with students, understanding their needs, and guiding them toward the right learning opportunities**.

You don't need to be an expert salesperson when you join us. We provide the necessary training, product knowledge, and support to help you become confident in your role.

What You Will Do

* Connect with students and young professionals through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and online meetings.
* Have meaningful conversations with students about their education, interests, and career goals.
* Understand their requirements and suggest relevant Corizo programs.
* Explain our training, internship, and career development programs in a simple and clear way.
* Answer student questions and help them understand the benefits of different programs.
* Follow up with students who are interested and continue the conversation.
* Build a good relationship with prospective students and provide a positive experience.
* Maintain basic information about conversations and follow\-ups in our CRM.
* Work closely with the team to ensure students receive the right information and support.
* Learn about new programs, industry trends, and career opportunities.
* Participate in regular training and team activities to improve your communication and professional skills.

Who Can Apply?

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Candidates with **0–2 years of experience** in sales, customer support, counselling, business development, or similar roles can apply.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to speak with people.
* Comfortable communicating in English.
* Knowledge of Telugu/Hindi or other regional languages is an added advantage.
* Basic knowledge of computers and Google Workspace/MS Office.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work from our **Hyderabad office**.

What We Look For

You will be a good fit if you are:

* Comfortable talking to new people.
* A good listener who understands what others need.
* Confident and positive in your communication.
* Curious to learn about careers, technology, and education.
* Good at building relationships.
* Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Someone who enjoys working with a supportive team.
* Interested in developing a career in **Business Development, Inside Sales, Student Counselling, or Customer Success**.

What You Get at Corizo

* **Structured training** to help you understand the role and products.
* **Sales and communication training** to build your professional confidence.
* Support from experienced team members.
* Opportunity to interact with students and young professionals.
* Learning environment with regular feedback and guidance.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Recognition for good work and contributions.
* Career growth opportunities based on your skills and performance.
* Opportunity to develop strong communication, negotiation, counselling, and relationship\-management skills.
* A collaborative and energetic work environment.

Career Growth

**Inside Sales Representative → Senior ISR → Coordinator → Associate Team Lead (ATL) → Team Lead (TL) → Senior Team Lead (STL) → Manager → Senior Manager → Vertical Head**

Why Join Us?

**About The Delivery Engineering Team**
 At our core, the Delivery Engineering team sits at the high\-velocity intersection of core product expansion, client go\-lives, and production resilience. We don't believe in traditional silos where backend engineers, frontend developers, and post\-production support live on isolated islands. Instead, we operate as an agile, high\-leverage SWAT team. We own features end\-to\-endfrom drafting initial code across the stack to deploying in staging/UAT and solving production issues at their root.
   

  

**What "AI as a First Principle" Means at the SDE 2 Level :**
 For an SDE 2, AI\-first engineering goes beyond individual speedit is about architectural leverage and team amplification. You use AI assistants (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, custom LLM workflows) not just to write features faster, but to audit system architectures, refactor complex legacy codebases, automate testing strategies, and review AI\-generated pull requests across your pod.

**Leadership \& Behavioral Traits**
* Mentorship Mindset : Passion for coaching junior engineers and conducting growth\-oriented code reviews.
* Extreme Ownership \& First\-Principles Thinking : Ability to step into ambiguous production scenarios and deliver clean, long\-term solutions.

description:
**Job Description**
 SwissIQ is a new premium watch strap and band brand — Swiss\-sourced material, built for owners of Rolex, Omega, Cartier, Tudor, Grand Seiko and Seiko. The category is dominated by a handful of global players; almost none of them are producing modern, fast, AI\-assisted creative, and several run no paid advertising at all. That is the gap we intend to walk into.
   

  

 This is a founding\-team creative hire. The person in this seat will produce a very large share of everything the public ever sees of this brand — the website, the product films, the ads, the Instagram grid, the reels. There is no existing creative team to inherit work from and no legacy style guide to follow. You will help build both.
   

  

 We are looking for a creative generalist who is genuinely AI\-native — someone who uses Runway, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Flux and Nano Banana as a daily production stack, not as a novelty.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Video \& motion —**
* 4–8 short\-form videos per week for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Meta ads, 8 to 30 seconds
* AI\-generated product films: strap in motion, water, light play, texture close\-ups, wrist\-shot sequences
* Paid ad creative: hook variations, static\-to\-motion, UGC\-style edits, comparison formats
* Voiceover and sound design using ElevenLabs and licensed audio


**Image \& rendering —**
* Product photography retouching and AI enhancement — colour, texture, edge and reflection cleanup
* AI\-generated lifestyle imagery where physical shoots are not economical
* Watch\-and\-strap composites across dozens of watch references
* Product page imagery, size and fitment diagrams, packaging mockups


**UX/UI \& web —**
* Design and iterate the Shopify storefront: home, collection, product and per\-watch\-reference landing pages
* Landing pages for paid campaigns, built to convert
* Mobile\-first every time
* Email and lifecycle design (Klaviyo templates)


**Brand \& graphic design —**
* Apply and extend the brand identity: typography, colour, layout systems, iconography
* Packaging, inserts, warranty cards, care instructions
* Marketplace and trade assets, occasional print


**Required Skills**
* AI video: demonstrable command of at least two of Runway, Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, Sora, Luma. You must be able to explain your prompting approach and show iterations, not just finished clips.
* AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana / Gemini image or equivalent, plus the retouching skill to fix what AI gets wrong
* AI audio: ElevenLabs for voiceover and sound; basic music selection and sync
* Adobe: Photoshop and Premiere Pro at a production standard
* Design: Figma — component\-based UI design, prototypes, developer handoff
* Editing craft: pacing, cuts on beat, hook construction in the first 1\.5 seconds, caption and text animation, correct export specs per platform
* Formats: confident switching between 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 without redoing the work each time


**Strongly Preferred**
 After Effects
   

  

* Canva, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve
* Shopify design experience
* basic 3D (Blender, Spline)
* colour grading and LUT work
* having shot and lit product yourself, even on a phone


**What Matters More Than Software**
 An eye for luxury — you can tell why one watch image reads as ₹8,000 and another reads as ₹80,000\. Volume without decay — you can ship six pieces a week that all hold the standard. You take direction on brand, and argue back on craft.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 1–3 years in a D2C brand, agency, content studio, or as a serious freelancer
* A portfolio is mandatory. No portfolio, no interview. Behance, personal site, Drive folder or Instagram are all acceptable.
* Formal design education welcome but not required — self\-taught candidates with a strong portfolio are treated identically

 You'll go beyond software development to include reliability engineering, where you'll design robust frameworks to fortify system resilience. By preemptively tackling potential failures, you'll keep our critical infrastructure stable, performant, and scalable, even amid evolving business needs. As a crucial part of our engineering team, you'll drive innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Mentor junior team members, share best practices, and lead the adoption of emerging technologies. Your dedication to automation, reliability, and operational excellence will shape our organization's future and fuel sustainable growth.
   

  

 This role blends technical challenge, creative problem\-solving, and strategic impact. If you're passionate about leveraging automation for business transformation, join us on this journey towards operational excellence.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As SDE\-2 you will lead projects involving multiple teams in all aspects of the SDLC using an agile process. As the systems need to be built from the ground up, you will have an opportunity to make a long\-lasting impact! To be successful in this position you will have a strong background in Algorithms, Data Structures, Java, and NoSQL. The ability to communicate clearly and concisely (both written and orally) and work well in a team are key competencies. You should be able to quickly adapt to new development environments, learn new systems, create reliable and maintainable code, and find creative and scalable solutions to difficult problems. Experience working with high\-traffic, scalable services is a plus.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Digital Acceleration powers ordering, subscriptions, and device management for Prime, Amazon Video, Music, Audible, Alexa, and Kindle, amongst other digital businesses. We process billions of digital purchases every year and enable our digital businesses to grow their businesses worldwide. We are on a mission to be earth's best provider of one\-time and recurring digital commerce, delivering a seamless and enjoyable post\-purchase customer experience.

**Job Description**
 Manager \- Employee RelationsTo serve as a trusted advisor, facilitator, and guide to employees \& people managers on all aspects of Employee Relations, including statutory compliance, employment\-related risk management, policy interpretation, and governance. The role is responsible for managing the central compliance framework across manufacturing plants and office locations in India, overseeing labour and employment litigation, ensuring third\-party compliance aligned with evolving labour codes, and driving capability building for business and line leaders on Employee Relations processes. The position also focuses on fostering a culture of high engagement and ethical conduct, ensuring 100% statutory compliance across all locations, and maintaining constructive engagement with trade unions and employee representatives.
   

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS: INTERNAL** 
 \- Plant HR Leads, HR Operation Lead, Legal Team Leads, Functional Team Leads, Admin Team Lead.
   

  

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS: EXTERNAL \-** 
 External Legal Counsel \& Advocates, Trade Unions, Statutory Authorities, local authorities.
   

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE: (Reports To/ Direct Reports Y/N)**
 Reports to Head Employee Relations India PPL, Direct Reports \- No
   

  

**ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION:** 
 MBA in Human Resources / MSW.
   

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATION – LLB / Certification In Employee Relations.**
**RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:** 
 5–8 years in HR/ER, with at least 2–3 years in employee relations role within manufacturing environment.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities \-**
* Compliance Framework: Ensure compliance of company compliance framework by collaborating and coordinating with key stakeholders like legal team leads, Plant HR leads, Admin leads and business HR partners.
* Grievance / Discipline Management: Handle employee grievances, assist in HR related investigations, drafting of report, and helping line managers to close the disciplinary action plan.
* Statutory Audits: Plan and conduct internal audits at manufacturing / non\-manufacturing sites / offices across India for action planning and compliance.
* Third Party Compliance: To work with plants HR leads, and HR business partners related to compliance of third\-party associates / contractors in line with new labour codes.
* Online Contractor Management System: End to end management \& governance of online contractor’s management system across all sites / offices across India.
* Standardization of employment documents: Collaborate and work very closely with HR operations to standardize the employment life cycle documents for all employees at factories / offices across India.

* Effective communicator: Proficient in communication and should be able to present / explain / articulate ER/HR related matters to key stakeholders.
* Expertise in Labour legislations / Statutory Compliance: Should be able to understand, interpret, explain \& resolve complex matters related to labour codes, shop and establishment act \& case laws.

title: Global People Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
**Who We Are**
 Cint is the technology foundation for continuous research and measurement. With a global footprint and programmatic access to hundreds of millions of consumers across 130\+ countries, Cint connects researchers, advertisers, and brands to reliable data from the world’s largest network of high\-quality sources. Researchers can collect human and advanced data at speed. Advertisers and their partners can measure campaign effectiveness at scale. Brands can move from insight to action with clarity. By operating the connective layer between asking questions and measuring advertising outcomes, Cint enables organizations to move faster and make confident business decisions.
   

  

 At Cint, we’re feeding the world’s curiosity.
   

  

**Job Description**
 People Operations is the operational and employee experience engine of Cint's People function. In this global leadership role, you will own the services, processes and infrastructure that support employees and managers across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 This is equal parts operational leadership and transformation. You will make sure the fundamentals \- employee support, Employee Relations, HRIS, data, policies, documentation and benefits \- work brilliantly, while building a more scalable, technology\-enabled operating model.
   

  

 Working across People Partnering, Talent, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards and People Technology, you will simplify how work gets done and decide what belongs in self\-service, automation or AI, and where human judgement and specialist expertise add the greatest value.
   

  

 Help us build a simpler, smarter and more human People Operations model \- one that delivers an excellent experience today and scales for what comes next.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Employee Support \& ER: Lead a responsive, high\-quality first line of People support, with clear service levels, effective case management and risk\-based escalation. Build the team's capability to resolve a broader range of standard Employee Relations matters confidently and consistently.
* Simple, Scalable Processes: Own and continuously improve core employee\-lifecycle processes, the People knowledge hub, policies and guidance. Create simple ownership, handoffs and escalation paths, balancing global consistency with local requirements.
* Trusted Systems \& Data: Own the operational performance of our HRIS and People data, strengthening accuracy, controls and governance. Partner with People Technology on workflows, integrations and system improvements that work for employees and the business.
* AI, Automation \& Self\-Service: Build effective ticketing, knowledge and self\-service experiences. Redesign work before automating it, introduce AI\-enabled workflows where they create genuine value, and measure the impact through experience, quality, speed, scalability and capacity created.
* People Operations Transformation: Set and deliver the People Operations roadmap, moving the function from transactional execution towards problem\-solving, employee experience and operational consulting. Use service insights to identify root causes and broader organisational opportunities.
* Global Benefits Operations: Lead the operational management of Cint’s global benefits portfolio, partnering with Total Rewards to deliver strong implementation, governance, vendor management and employee experience.


**How You'll Lead**
* Coach and develop a high\-performing global People Operations and Employee Relations team, building capability across support, ER, process design, systems, AI, automation, data and employee experience.
* Lead a blended workforce of people and AI agents, designing clear roles, workflows and accountability so human judgement and AI capability combine to deliver better, faster and more scalable outcomes.
* Create a culture that owns outcomes, solves problems at their root and moves comfortably between strategy and hands\-on execution.


**Qualifications**
**What you'll bring**
* Significant experience leading a global People Operations, HR Operations, Shared Services, Employee Experience or related function \- including developing global teams.
* Strong operational knowledge across employee support, Employee Relations, HRIS, People data, policies and the employee lifecycle.
* A track record of transforming operations: simplifying processes, improving service delivery and implementing workflow, self\-service, automation or AI\-enabled solutions.
* Experience establishing effective case management, ticketing or tiered support models, with sound judgement about what can be standardised and what needs deeper expertise or context.
* Strong systems thinking, analytical capability and stakeholder management, with the ability to connect technology, process, policy, roles and employee experience.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging technology, balanced with pragmatism about where it genuinely creates value.


**It would be a bonus if you have**
 Experience with AI\-enabled HR workflows; HiBob or similar platforms; global Shared Services transformation; employee self\-service or knowledge management; and/or a fast\-moving international technology business.
   

  

 If you are known for turning complexity into simple, scalable ways of working \- and want to shape the future of People Operations at Cint \- we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Our Values**
**Collaboration is our superpower**
* We uncover rich perspectives across the world
* Success happens together
* We deliver across borders.


**Innovation is in our blood**
* We’re pioneers in our industry
* Our curiosity is insatiable
* We bring the best ideas to life.


**We Do What We Say**
* We’re accountable for our work and actions
* Excellence comes as standard
* We’re open, honest and kind, always.


**We are caring**
* We learn from each other’s experiences
* Stop and listen; every opinion matters
* We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


**More About Cint**
 We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
   

  

 In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin\-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US\-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first\-party survey data in over 110 countries.
   

  

 Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)
   

  

 Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

**Job Purpose**
 Lead the Performance Management system, Compensation benchmarking, Job Evaluation \& Analysis and the design and roll\-out of Sales compensation interventions to support the business goals for all business units viz ABML \& ABARC. Adhere to statutory compliance and ensure that the C\&B initiatives implemented are aligned to the Group policies. Drive continuous improvement to enhance and improve effectiveness in the compensation and benefits function within the organization.
   

  

 Also responsible for HR Operations, Compliance \& Payroll for all business units viz ABML \& ABARC thus driving the entire employee life cycle.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
 Job ContextLead the Performance Management system, Compensation benchmarking, Job Evaluation \& Analysis and the design and roll\-out of Sales compensation interventions to support the business goals for all business units viz ABML, ABIF, ABARC. Adhere to statutory compliance and ensure that the C\&B initiatives implemented are aligned to the Group policies. Drive continuous improvement to enhance and improve effectiveness in the compensation and benefits function within the organization.
   

  

 Also responsible for HR Operations, Compliance \& Payroll for all business units viz ABML, ABIF, ABARC thus driving the entire employee life cycle.
   

  

 Job Challenges:
   

  

* Managing the pace of HR processes such as payroll, compensation, HRIS and operations with the growth of the business
* Defining \& Managing (for all 3 entities) Compensation \& benefits programs in alignment with the ABCap Compensation architecture.
* Define process for performance evaluation criteria and measurement across levels and completion of performance calendar
* Drive pay to performance compensation philosophy by defining level based compensation banding \& structure.
* Enhance market intelligence on Compensation through benchmarking by participation in Compensation Surveys and internal database of new employees.
* Managing wage costs in a high growth industry to ensure compensation to OPEX ratio as per budgets.
* Responsible for HR process and payroll audit \& compliance.
* Ensuring effective management of multiple vendors.
* Drive Performance Management System completion across the organisation.
* Facilitating and creating HR structures and systems to build synergy across businesses and functions is challenging as all business operate under different regulator guidelines and processes.
* Volatile, competitive and disruptive environment requiring nimble planning and constant touch with internal as well as outside world. Ensuring seamless and uniform implementation of HR strategies in widely distributed offices and employees across the geography is challenging.
* All 3 business units – ABML, ABIF \& ABARC have different process and policies wrt various human resource functional aspects. It’s imperative to ensure the right yard stick is used to manage each policy. This needs to be micromanaged at each stages of process execution and is a big challenge.


**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 Plan, initiate, and monitor the salary \& benefits budgeting process 1\.Conduct market benchmark surveys on compensation \& Benefits.
   

  

* Perform budgeting analysis to determine salary increases and costs impacts on payroll.
* Create robust compensation structures aligned to prevalent Tax norms
* Creation of an effective compensation strategy to ring fence key talents for the organization (LTIP/Deferred Compensation/ESOPS)
* Carry out the increment process in line with the guidelines keeping in mind market benchmarks
* Manage salary budgets and roll\-out the increment exercise
* Create an effective resolution framework/matrix \& ensure timely resolution for all employee queries related to compensation
* Articulate, define and adequately document HR policies and guidelines for smooth functioning of relevant HR processes.


 KRA2 Initiate and drive the performance management cycle (Mid\-Year \& Annual) 1\.Facilitate business/ managers to define performance evaluation criteria
   

  

* Collaborate for performance ratings analysis and ensure distribution curve.
* Ensure the launch and completion of the performance management plan in a timely manner.


 KRA3 Drive the job evaluation exercise as per prevalent structures and roles 1\.Ensure organization structures are updated to reflect current realities
   

  

* Drive and facilitate effective job description documentation exercise across Functions
* Basis an in\-depth understanding of the job evaluation framework, ensure that the flow of roles, responsibilities and accountabilities is accurately captured in the Job Description documents
* Ensure timely submission of complete documentation and data points for the various Job Evaluation Committees (BJEC, CJEC and APEX) where applicable
* Ensure inputs from JE exercise are effectively used during annual and mid\-year appraisals and promotion / up\-gradation activities.
* Ensure maintenance of accurate records in relation to the JE exercise


 KRA4 Design and Optimization of Compensation \& Target Setting
   

  

* Develop an in\-depth understanding and benchmarking of compensation structures for various sales channels within the organization and across the industry.
* Continually assess the effectiveness of existing compensation structures to evaluate alignment with current and future organizational needs.
* Ensure compensation structure is designed across the sales hierarchy in a manner that supports the achievement of business objectives.
* Ensure appropriate KPI and Target Setting for the entire Sales \& Non\-Sales Hierachy


 KRA5 Ensure smooth management of Poornata System for the organisation to ensure that employee records are maintained and updated in a timely manner 1\.Ensure adequate documentation and updation of JDs/KPI/KRA for all the roles in the organization and their validity against goal settings of the respective incumbents.
   

  

* Conduct and collaborate on periodic information audits
* Ensure efficient data management on Poornata System pertaining to employee records
* Be part of the new systems development team and provide inputs to ensure that data is migrated accurately from legacy to new systems, conduct test scenarios with vendors


 KRA6 Plan, initiate and drive the benefits programs for the organisation 1\.Manage and implement employee benefit programs like insurance \& health schemes, make necessary recommendations \& improvements
   

  

* Perform need gap analysis and initiate new benefit plans as well as ensure smoother operations of current schemes.
* Communicate new initiatives to the organisation and employees and address queries, clarifications as well as grievances


 KRA7 Manage the development and implementation of all aspects of HR Operations\- Drive HR operations and enhance service delivery to all employees as per defined SLA’s \& TAT’s 1\.Define SOP's for all HR operations processes.
   

  

* Manage life cycle of employee on HR administration aspects as per defined TAT’s
* Initiate process and work flow improvements
* Ensure the entire HR operational activities are executed smoothly and the HR processes are reviewed and updated in line with the ABC/ABG/Industry norms
* Evaluate the existing processes for scope of improvements in building process efficiencies, reducing TATs, improving accuracy and opportunities to save costs


 KRA8 Manage Statutory compliance including the payroll function and the shared service support for the organization 1\.Ensure that the payroll processing is done smoothly and timely on a routine basis for all 3 Business Units
   

  

* Ensure all statutory compliance are 100% adhered without any deviations.
* Manage and align the HR Ops and Payroll Vendors and Business Partners in line with the HR agenda.
* Ensure Process Governance, Audit Compliance \& Controls in all HR Operations and Payroll activities


 KRA9 Team Management 1\.Optimize employee talent and expertise.
   

  

* Ensure adequate training, development opportunities and career planning is established for the team
* Motivate the team and maintain employee satisfaction of team at optimal levels

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Title:** 
 HR Manager
 



**Job Location:** 
 Baroda
 



**Shift Timings:** 
 12\-9 P.M IST
 



  




* Humans Of Collabera \| LinkedIn
* **https://collabera.com/globaltalentcenter/**
* Collabera \| Global Staffing \& Talent Solutions
* **https://www.youtube.com/@CollaberaGTC/videos**
* **https://instagram.com/collaberagtc?igshid\=ZWQyN2ExYTkwZQ\=\=**



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Manager – HR Operations to lead and strengthen key HR initiatives across the organization. The role will be responsible for driving operational excellence, employee engagement, HR process governance, employee relations, talent management, and compliance.
 



 The ideal candidate will be a strategic and people\-focused HR professional who can effectively balance business requirements, employee experience, operational efficiency, and statutory compliance. This role will work closely with business leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to implement people strategies, improve HR processes, and support organizational growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management
 


* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to separation.
* Ensure smooth execution of HR processes including onboarding, probation, confirmation, transfers, promotions, internal movements, and exits.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, HR documentation, and HRIS data.
* Ensure timely execution of HR policies, processes, and employee\-related activities.
* Identify operational gaps and implement solutions to improve efficiency and employee experience.
* Partner with relevant teams to ensure accurate and timely HR reporting and documentation.



 2\. Employee Relations \& Engagement
 


* Act as a trusted HR partner for employees, managers, and business leaders.
* Address and resolve employee concerns, grievances, workplace issues, and conflicts in a timely and professional manner.
* Provide guidance to managers on employee relations matters, people practices, and HR policies.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performance work culture.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and support programs that enhance employee experience and retention.
* Identify employee sentiment and engagement trends and recommend appropriate interventions.



 3\. Talent Management \& Workforce Planning
 


* Partner closely with Talent Acquisition teams and business leaders to support workforce planning and hiring requirements.
* Support effective onboarding and integration of new employees.
* Manage probation reviews, confirmation processes, and employee transitions.
* Drive performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback, and annual appraisal cycles.
* Support talent development, succession planning, career progression, and internal mobility initiatives.
* Identify critical talent and support retention strategies in partnership with business leadership.



 4\. HR Strategy \& Process Improvement
 


* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve HR policies, processes, and workflows.
* Lead HR transformation and process optimization initiatives to improve operational efficiency.
* Explore opportunities for HR automation, digitalization, and technology adoption.
* Develop and implement standardized HR processes across teams and business functions.
* Use HR metrics and analytics to identify trends and support data\-driven workforce decisions.
* Prepare and present HR dashboards, reports, and insights to leadership.



 5\. Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, statutory requirements, company policies, and internal HR governance standards.
* Maintain appropriate HR documentation and records to support compliance requirements.
* Support internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Assist in policy implementation, review, and communication.
* Monitor compliance\-related activities and provide timely reports to relevant stakeholders.
* Partner with internal teams to mitigate HR\-related risks and ensure adherence to organizational standards.



 6\. Stakeholder Management \& Business Partnership
 


* Build strong partnerships with business leaders and functional stakeholders.
* Understand business priorities and translate them into relevant HR initiatives and solutions.
* Provide strategic HR guidance on workforce planning, organizational structure, employee development, and people\-related decisions.
* Support leaders in managing organizational changes, team structures, and workforce requirements.
* Work collaboratively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, L\&D, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Act as a key HR point of contact for assigned business functions.



 7\. HR Analytics \& Reporting
 


* Track and analyze key HR metrics including headcount, attrition, employee engagement, performance, hiring, and workforce trends.
* Develop actionable insights from HR data to support business and people decisions.
* Maintain accuracy and integrity of HR reports and dashboards.
* Provide regular HR updates and recommendations to leadership.
* Identify trends and proactively recommend solutions to address workforce challenges.



 Key Skills \& Competencies
 


* Strong knowledge of HR Operations and employee lifecycle management
* Strong understanding of Employee Relations and HR Business Partnering
* Experience in Performance Management and Talent Management
* Good understanding of employment laws, statutory compliance, and HR governance
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Data\-driven approach with good HR analytics capability
* Process improvement and change management mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong leadership, ownership, and execution capabilities
* Proficiency in HRIS, HR reporting tools, and Microsoft Office/Excel



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a related discipline will be preferred.
* Relevant experience in HR Operations, HRBP, Employee Relations, or People Operations.
* Experience in a technology, staffing, IT services, BPO, or corporate environment will be an added advantage.
* What Success Looks Like



**The successful candidate will:** 



* Ensure seamless and compliant HR operations across the employee lifecycle.
* Build strong relationships with employees and business stakeholders.
* Improve HR processes and employee experience through automation and continuous improvement.
* Support business growth through effective workforce and talent management.
* Strengthen employee engagement, retention, and organizational effectiveness.
* Provide data\-driven HR insights to support leadership decision\-making.



**Why Join Collabera?** 




 Collabera is a global talent solutions company trusted by leading enterprises for over three decades. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful careers, backed by a culture that values growth, stability, innovation, and genuine support at every step of the journey.
 



**What We Offer** 




 Career Growth – Opportunities to build and advance your HR career.
 



 Global Opportunities – Exposure to global teams, businesses, and diverse work environments.
 



 Learning Culture – Continuous opportunities for professional development and upskilling.
 



 Innovation – Be part of an organization focused on technology, transformation, and new ways of working.
 



 Collaborative Environment – Work with talented professionals and cross\-functional teams in a supportive culture.

**About the Company** 




  





  





 City Palace Jaipur is dedicated to preserving its unique culture and heritage while providing world\-class visitor experiences.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The Manager \- HR will develop and implement the overall HR strategy aligned with the City Palace's institutional vision, business priorities, and long\-term growth plans.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Develop and implement the overall HR strategy aligned with the City Palace's institutional vision, business priorities, and long\-term growth plans.
* Build the organisation structure, manpower plan, and talent strategy across museum, heritage, hospitality, retail, events, security, works, technology, finance, and corporate functions.
* Lead the full employee lifecycle covering workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, development, engagement, retention, and separation.
* Build a strong leadership and middle\-management pipeline and support senior management in identifying, hiring, and developing high\-quality talent.
* Develop and implement robust HR policies, manuals, SOPs, and systems covering recruitment, leave, attendance, performance, compensation, conduct, grievance handling, and employee relations.
* Establish a transparent performance\-management framework with clear KPIs, KRAs, appraisal cycles, and accountability mechanisms.
* Review compensation structures, salary bands, job levels, and benefits to ensure internal equity, market competitiveness, and organisational affordability.
* Develop learning and development programmes across leadership, hospitality, visitor experience, technical skills, heritage, safety, and functional capabilities.
* Build a culture centred on professionalism, service excellence, accountability, integrity, and respect for the City's heritage and institutional values.
* Lead employee engagement, internal communication, feedback, and grievance\-resolution mechanisms.
* Oversee HR operations for outsourced and contracted workforce, including vendor governance, manpower deployment, statutory compliance, and service standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, employment regulations, statutory requirements, and organisational policies.
* Strengthen HR technology, HRMS, attendance, payroll, employee records, and management\-information systems.
* Change management.
* Stakeholder management.
* People leadership and coaching.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 8 \+ years of progressive HR experience, with substantial experience leading the HR function of a complex organisation.
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Proven experience in organisational design, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, and HR operations.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws, employee relations, statutory compliance, and outsourced workforce management.
* Experience managing both professional and large operational/frontline workforces.
* Demonstrated ability to build HR systems and processes in organisations undergoing growth or transformation.
* Strong business understanding with the ability to connect people strategy to organisational and commercial outcomes.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* High integrity, discretion, and maturity in handling sensitive employee and institutional matters.
* Experience in hospitality, museums, heritage, cultural institutions, luxury, tourism, or other service\-led organisations would be an advantage.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* Strategic HR leadership.
* Organisation design and workforce planning.
* Talent acquisition and leadership hiring.
* Performance and rewards management.
* Learning and organisational development.
* Employee relations and labour compliance.
* HR analytics and technology.



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





  





 City Palace is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.
 



  





  





**To Apply** 




  





  





 Please send your resume to careers@citypalace.org, with “HR Manager – City Palace” in the subject line.

title: HR Manager - Office Operations [T500-28873]
description:
**About Suffolk:** 




 Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. Suffolk is an end\-to\-end business that provides value throughout the entire project lifecycle by leveraging its core construction management services with vertical service lines that include real estate capital investment, design, self\-perform construction services, material procurement services, technology start\-up investment (Suffolk Technologies), and innovative research/development.
 



 Suffolk is a national company with more than $8\.0 billion in annual revenue, 3,100 employees, and main offices in Boston (headquarters), New York City, Miami, West Palm Beach, Tampa, Estero, Dallas, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, and the US Virgin Islands. Suffolk manages many of the most complex, sophisticated projects in the United States, serving clients in every major industry sector, including healthcare, life sciences, education, gaming, transportation/aviation, government, mission critical and commercial. Suffolk is privately held and is led by Founder, Chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked \#10 on ENR’s list of “Top CM\-at\-Risk Contractors.”
 



  





**About Suffolk Global:** 




 Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world\-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.
 



 As a critical part of Suffolk’s long\-term growth strategy, Suffolk Global enables greater speed, scalability, and technical rigor across the business. At the intersection of process standardization, AI\-enabled innovation, and global talent, Suffolk Global is redefining how work is executed, embedding consistent workflows, leveraging technology to drive efficiency, and building high\-performing teams aligned to Suffolk’s evolving needs.
 



 By embedding deeply with U.S.\-based teams, the platform supports high\-impact work across design, digital delivery, and corporate functions. Powered by India’s exceptional talent pool, Suffolk Global is building a next\-generation capability that combines deep technical expertise with a relentless focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous innovation, helping redefine what’s possible in the built environment.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 Suffolk Global is seeking a Human Resources Business Partner to help establish and scale people operations across multiple functions and business units in Bengaluru, India. As the primary HR partner for the India office, this individual will support the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to employee experience, HR operations, and ongoing people programs.
 



 In the near term, the HR Business Partner will work closely with Suffolk's U.S. HR organization and external partners to implement HR policies, talent acquisition activities, employee programs, and operational processes. As Suffolk Global grows, this role will help shape the long\-term HR strategy, identifying opportunities to build internal capabilities and transition key HR functions in\-house.
 



 Success in this role requires a collaborative, hands\-on leader who is comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment and partnering across global teams. This position offers a unique opportunity to build the HR foundation for a rapidly expanding organization while growing into a broader HR leadership role as Suffolk Global scales.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**HR Operations \& Employee Experience:** 



* Serve as the primary HR Business Partner for the Suffolk Global India office.
* Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, orientation, employee records, benefits administration, and leave management.
* Serve as a trusted resource for employees, responding to HR inquiries and supporting a positive employee experience.
* Support performance management, employee development, talent review, and engagement initiatives.
* Maintain accurate HR data and documentation across HR systems.



  





**HR Strategy \& Business Partnership:** 



* Partner closely with U.S.\-based HR Business Partners, business leaders, and external partners to execute HR programs and organizational initiatives.
* Support implementation of HR policies, processes, and best practices across the India organization.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, improve, and gradually transition HR capabilities in\-house as Suffolk Global scales.
* Support organizational growth, workforce planning, and other strategic people initiatives.



  





**Compliance \& Governance:** 



* Help ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, employment regulations, and company policies.
* Coordinate with legal, finance, payroll, and external partners on HR compliance and employee administration.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of sensitive employee information.



  





**Office Operations \& Workplace Experience:** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations to ensure a safe, productive, and engaging workplace.
* Coordinate with facilities, IT, security, and third\-party vendors to support office operations.
* Manage workspace readiness, office access, visitor coordination, and administrative services.
* Plan and coordinate employee events, town halls, executive visits, and team activities that foster a strong office culture.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive Human Resources experience.
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, employee relations, HR operations, and talent acquisition.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment laws and HR best practices.
* Experience partnering with business leaders and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and HRIS platforms.
* Experience supporting a Global Capability Center (GCC), multinational organization, or high\-growth company.
* Experience working with outsourced HR service providers or HR consulting partners.
* Familiarity with HR systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms.
* Experience helping build or scale HR operations in a growing organization.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive process improvements across global teams.

title: People Business Partner
description:
**What we are looking for**
 A strong, on the ground People Business Partner who can help stand up the India site from a people perspective while partnering closely with leaders through launch, ramp, and stabilization. Unlike the senior HR lead, this role should lean much more heavily into tactical execution, day to day leadership support, and onsite people management, while still bringing enough strategic judgment to identify future opportunities and help shape the next phase of the people model.This person should be fully embedded in the operation, highly visible to leaders and employees, and able to translate business needs into practical people solutions in real time.
   

  

**Profile**
 Highly tactical and fully onsite operator who is comfortable working in a fast paced, build stage environment where processes are still being defined and the site is scaling quickly. This role should be willing to stay close to the floor, leaders, and teams, with a strong bias for execution and problem solving.
   

  

 Strong leadership partner able to work directly with site and functional leaders on day to day people topics, team effectiveness, manager support, role clarity, performance concerns, and workforce needs. This role should be credible with leaders, but much more hands on than a purely strategic business partner.
   

  

 Deep employee engagement and culture capability with the ability to help shape the employee experience from the ground up. This includes identifying early engagement risks, reinforcing cultural expectations, supporting manager consistency, and helping create a healthy and sustainable site environment as the organization ramps.
   

  

 Solid org effectiveness and talent management judgment with the ability to support team design, manager capability, succession thinking, talent cycled, and role clarity as the site evolves. This person does not need to own long range org strategy, but should be strong enough to spot issues, recommend improvements, and help leaders make sound people decisions.
   

  

 Strong employee relations and compliance foundation with the ability to handle sensitive employee matters, ensure consistent policy application, support investigations or escalations as needed, and maintain strong alignment with local labor requirements and company standards.
   

  

 Experienced in change management and comfortable supporting leaders and employees through ambiguity, new processes, shifting structures, and operating model changes during the launch and ramp period.
   

  

 Coordinator and people operations enabler who can direct and prioritize the work of the 2 HR Generalists, ensuring strong day to day execution across onboarding, employee support, documentation, policy administration, issue follow up, and site level people processes.
   

  

 Data aware and opportunity oriented with the ability to identify trends in attrition, engagement, attendance, performance, employee concerns, and manager capability, then translate those insights into practical actions and future improvements.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Partner day to day with site leaders on people topics tied to launch, ramp, and team stabilization.
* Provide onsite support on employee engagement, culture, team health, and manager effectiveness.
* Drive tactical org effectiveness work, including role clarity, team design support, and workforce planning input.
* Manage employee relations matters and help ensure compliant, consistent execution of people policies and practices.
* Support change management as the site moves from launch mode into a more stable operating rhythm.
* Coordinate and guide the work of the 2 HR Generalists to ensure strong execution of daily HR operations and employee support.
* Identify gaps, patterns, and improvement opportunities that can inform the next phase of the India people model.
* Partner closely with the Senior Manager or Director on escalations, org decisions, talent priorities, and site level people risk.


**We're excited about you because…**
 Likely 6 to 10 years of progressive HRBP or PBP experience, ideally in high growth, operations heavy, site based, or multi shift environments. title: Factory HR Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore \- Indraprastha, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Description :**
 The Plant HR Head is responsible for leading Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Labour Relations, statutory compliance, workforce planning, talent management, employee engagement, and HR operations for the manufacturing plant. The role partners with Plant Leadership to align people strategies with business objectives while ensuring industrial harmony, workforce productivity, legal compliance, operational excellence, and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Missions and responsibilities :**
**The job holder is responsible for the following activities**
* Strategic HR Leadership
* Partner with Plant Leadership to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business and manufacturing objectives.
* Drive workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, succession planning, capability development, employee engagement, and change management initiatives.
* Lead HR transformation, automation, digitalization, and Industry 4\.0 readiness initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor on organization design, culture, workforce capability, and people strategy.
* Manage HR budgets, workforce plans, and people metrics to support business decisions.
* Industrial Relations \& Labour Relations
* Develop and implement Industrial Relations strategies to maintain a stable, productive, and disruption\-free manufacturing environment.
* Build and sustain effective relationships with trade unions, employee representatives, and workmen.
* Lead collective bargaining, wage negotiations, productivity\-linked settlements, and long\-term agreements.
* Ensure compliance with Certified Standing Orders/Model Standing Orders, settlements, awards, and employment conditions.
* Represent management before Labour Authorities, Conciliation Officers, Labour Courts, Industrial Tribunals, and statutory forums.
* Manage grievances, disciplinary matters, misconduct investigations, domestic enquiries, and conflict resolution in accordance with principles of natural justice.
* Coach managers on employee relations and disciplinary processes.
* Monitor industrial relations climate and implement proactive interventions to prevent industrial unrest and ensure business continuity.
* Labour Law, Statutory Compliance \& Government Liaison


 Ensure compliance with all applicable labour legislation, including:
   

  

* Code on Wages, 2019
* Industrial Relations Code, 2020
* Code on Social Security, 2020
* Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (OSH) Code, 2020
* POSH Act, 2013
* Apprentices Act, 1961
* Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act
* Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act
* Applicable Central and State Rules, notifications, amendments, and employment laws.
* Responsibilities include:
* Ensuring compliance relating to wages, overtime, working hours, leave, welfare provisions, statutory benefits, and employment conditions.
* Maintaining statutory registers, licences, records, notices, and returns.
* Coordinating inspections, audits, and regulatory submissions with Labour Department, Directorate of Factories, EPFO, ESIC, and other authorities.
* Monitoring legislative developments, conducting compliance audits, and implementing corrective actions and risk mitigation measures.
* Maintaining effective relationships with labour authorities, statutory bodies, and government agencies.
* Factory HR Operations \& Contract Labour Management
* Lead workforce planning and manpower deployment across shifts and operations.
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and separations.
* Oversee permanent, fixed\-term, apprentice, trainee, and contract workforce administration.
* Ensure effective management of payroll coordination, attendance, leave administration, HRIS, employee records, wages, overtime, incentives, shift allowances, statutory deductions, and employee benefits.
* Fulfil Principal Employer obligations and ensure contractor compliance with labour laws.
* Conduct contract labour audits covering wages, statutory contributions, bonus, leave, welfare provisions, licences, and statutory documentation.
* Monitor contractor performance, workforce deployment, productivity, and labour costs.
* Talent Management, Performance \& Employee Engagement
* Lead talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development, learning initiatives, and workforce capability building.
* Build talent pipelines for critical manufacturing, engineering, technical, and leadership positions.
* Drive performance management, goal setting, development planning, promotions, merit increases, incentive schemes, and bonus administration.
* Monitor labour costs and compensation competitiveness.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, recognition, welfare, diversity, and inclusion initiatives.
* Lead shop\-floor engagement programs including suggestion schemes, quality circles, communication forums, and cultural initiatives.
* Foster an ethical, inclusive, and high\-performance culture supported by grievance redressal and whistleblower mechanisms.
* Health, Safety, Analytics \& Team Leadership
* Partner with HSE teams to strengthen workplace safety culture and statutory compliance.
* Support occupational health, employee wellbeing, welfare programs, safety committees, and incident investigations.
* Ensure compliance relating to welfare facilities, occupational health requirements, medical examinations, and statutory safety provisions.
* Develop HR dashboards and provide insights on attrition, absenteeism, labour productivity, overtime utilization, labour costs, recruitment effectiveness, training outcomes, employee engagement, diversity, contract labour utilization, compliance status, and workforce planning.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Plant HR team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement


**Skills and competences requirements:**
* Skill Requirements
* Working in a Matrix
* Employee \& industrial relations management
* Labor law and statutory compliance
* Talent acquisition and workforce planning
* Conflict resolution and negotiation
* Team leadership and mentoring
* Data\-driven decision making and HR analytics
* Technical Competencies
* SAP, Oracle, Workday, or equivalent HRIS platforms.( Desirable)
* HR Analytics and Dashboard Reporting.
* Microsoft Office Suite.


**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Law, Labour Welfare, or related discipline.
* MBA/master’s degree in human resources, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare, Personnel Management, or related field preferred.
* Professional HR or Industrial Relations certifications will be an advantage.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant manufacturing or industrial experience.
* Minimum 10 years in Plant HR leadership roles.
* Strong expertise in Industrial Relations, Labour Relations, collective bargaining, labour law compliance, statutory compliance, workforce management, and employee relations.
* Proven experience managing unionized workforces, government inspections, wage settlements, disciplinary processes, and organizational change initiatives.


 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
