title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**About PMTF:** 




 PMTF is building a new generation of talent and institutions at the intersection of media, technology, storytelling and social impact.
 



  





 We are working to empower Bharat’s youth with the knowledge, tools and values to participate meaningfully in an increasingly digital and democratised media landscape — enabling the creation and dissemination of independent, impactful, fact\-based and culturally rooted stories.
 



  





 As PMTF grows, we are looking for a hands\-on Human Resources Executive who can help us build the people systems, culture and processes that will support this growth.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 We are looking for an HR Executive / HR Generalist with prior hands\-on HR experience to manage recruitment, onboarding, employee operations and day\-to\-day people management at PMTF.
 



  





 This is not a recruitment\-only position. You will work closely with the leadership team and take ownership of the employee lifecycle while helping build PMTF's HR processes, policies and workplace culture from the ground up.
 



  





 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 



 Work Type: Full\-time, On\-site
 



 Experience: 1–2 years of relevant HR experience
 



 Work From Home: Not available for this role
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Manage the end\-to\-end hiring process across different roles and functions.
* Develop and publish job descriptions across LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Source, screen and shortlist candidates based on role requirements and organisational fit.
* Conduct initial HR interviews and coordinate subsequent interview rounds with hiring managers and leadership.
* Build and maintain candidate pipelines and ensure timely follow\-up throughout the hiring process.
* Coordinate offer letters, documentation, background checks where applicable, and joining formalities.
* Own employee onboarding, induction and integration into the organisation.
* Maintain accurate employee records, attendance, leave and other HR documentation.
* Handle day\-to\-day employee queries and support effective internal communication.
* Help develop and maintain HR policies, processes, SOPs and employee documentation.
* Coordinate performance reviews, feedback processes and employee development initiatives.
* Manage employee offboarding, exit formalities, documentation and handovers.
* Support leadership with manpower planning and evolving organisational requirements.
* Help establish a professional, accountable, collaborative and values\-driven workplace culture.
* Identify gaps in existing people processes and proactively build practical systems to address them.
* Maintain confidentiality and professionalism while handling employee and organisational information.



  





**Who We're Looking For:** 



* Minimum 1–2 years of prior hands\-on HR experience is mandatory.
* Practical experience in recruitment, candidate screening and interviewing.
* Understanding of onboarding, offboarding and general HR operations.
* Working knowledge of basic HR policies, employee documentation and workplace processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in dealing with candidates, employees and leadership.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented and strong on follow\-up.
* Demonstrated ownership — someone who takes responsibility for getting things done rather than waiting for instructions.
* Comfortable working independently and creating processes where none currently exist.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, entrepreneurial and evolving environment.
* Ability to balance empathy for people with organisational discipline and accountability.
* Must be available to work full\-time from our Noida office.
* Experience in a startup, media, technology, entertainment, education, nonprofit or other mission\-driven organisation will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.



  





**What Makes This Role Different:** 




 You will be joining PMTF at an important stage of its growth and will have the opportunity to help build its people function from the ground up.
 



  





 Rather than simply managing an established HR system, you will work directly with the leadership team to shape how PMTF hires, onboards, communicates with, develops and retains its people.
 



 The role offers the opportunity to build practical HR systems while working in an organisation focused on media, technology, storytelling, youth and social impact.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who sees HR as more than administration — someone who understands that the right people, culture and systems are fundamental to building a strong organisation.
 



 If you enjoy taking ownership, working with people, building processes and helping organisations grow, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Apply:** 




 If this sounds like you, send us your CV along with a brief note explaining why you would like to work with PMTF and what you would bring to the role.

**About AQR Capital Management:** 




  AQR is a global investment management firm built at the intersection of financial theory and practical application. We strive to deliver superior, long\-term results for our clients by seeking to filter out market noise to identify and isolate what matters most, and by developing ideas that stand up to rigorous testing. Underpinning this philosophy is an unrelenting commitment to excellence in technology — powering our insights and analysis. This unique combination has made us leaders in alternative and traditional strategies since 1998\.
 



 AQR takes a systematic, research\-driven approach, applying quantitative tools to process fundamental information and manage risk. Our clients include institutional investors, such as pension funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations and sovereign wealth funds, as well as financial advisors.

 The U.S. Wealth team was created to engage with taxable U.S. investors and their advisors.   • Generate customized outputs for RIA and Broker\-Dealer teams

 • A Bachelor’s degree; concentrations in Economics, Finance or Business
 



 • High degree of intellectual curiosity
 



 • High proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel
 



  • Working knowledge of ThinkCell, Salesforce, and business intelligence software (e.g., Tableau, Microstrategy) is highly desired 
 



**Who You Are:** 




  • Hardworking and eager to learn in a highly intellectual, collaborative environment
 



  • Well\-organized and detail\-oriented
 



  • Self\-starter, able to work independently as well as within a team
 



  • Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



  • Strong oral and written communication skills
 



  • Knowledge of finance and the investment management industry is required

**Process Excellence Team Structure** 




 The Process Excellence function is structured across three levels, working together to strengthen process governance, controls, SOPs and continuous improvement for clients:
 


* **Manager – Process Excellence —** 
 owns end\-to\-end process governance, leads improvement engagements and mentors the team.
* **Analyst – Process Excellence —** 
 reviews processes, identifies gaps, and supports SOP formation, controls and data analysis.
* **Specialist – Process Excellence —** 
 supports process documentation, SOP maintenance, data analysis and process audits.



  





**1\.Manager\- Process Excellence** 




**Role Overview** 




 The Manager – Process Excellence will lead process governance, business operations improvement and risk \& controls initiatives across engagements. The role will drive end\-to\-end ownership of process reviews, SOP frameworks, automation and continuous improvement projects, while mentor a team of analysts/specialists and acting as a key point of contact for stakeholders and clients on process excellence deliverables.

* Lead end\-to\-end process reviews of business, finance and operational functions, and independently drive process improvement engagements from scoping to closure.
* Own the design, implementation, governance and periodic review of SOPs, process maps, RACI matrices and internal control frameworks.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, control weaknesses and risk exposures, and drive root\-cause analysis with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Partner with Finance, Operations, Risk and cross\-functional leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver process re\-engineering solutions.
* Drive process audits, compliance reviews and internal control testing, ensuring adherence to SOPs, policies and regulatory/client requirements.
* Analyse operational and financial data to identify trends, bottlenecks and exceptions; build MIS, dashboards and management reporting for leadership review.
* Lead automation, digitisation and process simplification initiatives to enhance productivity, accuracy and turnaround time.
* Manage, mentor and review the work of Process Excellence Analysts/Specialists, ensuring quality and timeliness of deliverables.
* Act as the primary liaison with client/business stakeholders for process excellence engagements, presenting findings, recommendations and improvement roadmaps.
* Track and monitor improvement initiatives, benchmark performance against KPIs/SLAs, and report progress to senior management.
* Maintain version control and governance of SOPs, process documentation, checklists and process excellence knowledge repository.
* Support new client onboarding and transitions by designing process frameworks, controls and documentation from the ground up.



**Candidate Profile** 



* MBA – Finance / CA Inter / CA (Qualified CA preferred).
* 6–9 years of progressive experience, post qualification, in Process Excellence, Business Operations, Internal Audit, Risk \& Controls, Finance \& Accounting Outsourcing or a related function.

* Prior experience in a client\-facing role, with exposure to leading process improvement or transformation projects, will be preferred.
* Open to working across industries, including domestic and international clients and MSMEs, regardless of sector.

 The Analyst – Process Excellence will support process governance, business operations and continuous improvement. title: Data Engineer 11
description:
**Job Summary**
 Supports, develops and maintains a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with the Business and IT teams to understand the requirements to best leverage the technologies to enable agile data delivery at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event\-based, unstructured). Implements methods to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.
   

  

**Competencies**
 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Data Extraction \- Performs data extract\-transform\-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.
   

  

 Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.
   

  

 Quality Assurance Metrics \- Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.

title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It.
   

  

 At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
   

  

 When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
   

  

 If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it —
   

  

 Fuller is where that happens.
   

  

**About The Role**
 For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations:
   

  

 engineering excellence and long\-standing partnerships with our customers.
   

  

 As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
   

  

 You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft\-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands\-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long\-term performance support.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities :**
* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real\-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real\-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine\-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non\-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.


**You bring**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real\-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
* Willingness to travel (50–70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.


*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
 Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews \- also on a virtual setting as required \- on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
   

  

**Build a better world**
 Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.

title: Maritime Data Analyst
description:
**Role Profile**
 Lloyds List Intelligence are the trusted experts delivering transparent and actionable maritime data empowering 60,000 professionals around the globe to make confident decisions that drive the safe, efficient, and lawful movement of trade by sea. Our advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and industry expertise transform our unparalleled data into unique insight delivered through data and analytics services, news and commentary, and publications.
   

  

 We have teams working across the globe in data and analytics, product management, editorial and market analysis, technology, marketing, sales, and customer success.
   

  

 In the role of Maritime Data Analyst, reporting to the Customer Experience Lead, you will provide first response to customer queries related to vessel data, AIS data and methodology, complex ownership structures, as well as sanctions and compliance risks, working closely with other research teams to ensure the queries are answered within agreed SLAs. The Maritime Data Analyst will primarily investigate company and vessel ownership structures, vessel characteristics \& movement patterns, as well as maritime areas \& facilities. They are expected to gain a broad understanding of Lloyd’s List Intelligence data and products, and most importantly how these benefit our customers. Within the remit of this role there is a key focus on resolving multiple daily client queries and delivering on Data Quality programmes across several data areas in a timely manner, as well as exploring ways to improve efficiency and processes to increase the timeliness, coverage and accuracy of data delivered to customers.
   

  

  

  

 If you have bags of enthusiasm and a desire to solve complex problems, are keen to gain experience of large and complex datasets and due diligence research whilst delivering timely and actionable insights to our customers then this is the team for you! Maritime knowledge would be an advantage but much more important is a passion for data, investigations and research, and someone who can work well with continual change.
   

  

  

  

 This role is permanent and offers balanced working with 2\-3 days a week in our Chennai office.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor and respond to inbound customer queries, received through the Ask\-the\-Analyst service, as well as non\-customer and internal requests, ensuring these are handled in an efficient and timely manner, capturing \& escalating actionable client feedback.
* Develop a deep understanding of the different customer groups and how they rely on our insight and services.
* Acquire full knowledge of in\-house methodology across the Maritime Data Team and be able to articulate this in written responses to internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure customer service SLAs, Data Quality KPIs and daily tasks are consistently met.
* Research and investigate complex datasets, including commercial ownership structures and ultimate beneficial ownership, sanction links and vessel data, becoming a subject matter expert.
* Review and validate AIS tracking data, responding to customer queries on vessel movements.
* Monitor, proactively escalate and follow\-up on issues related to the performance of our proprietary AIS tracking network, maintaining our relationships with the AIS station hosts.
* Review and update entries within our Geospatial database, including but not limited to Ports, Terminals \& Berths, as well as High\-Risk Areas.
* Provide quality control of research teams’ output, offer feedback and expertise when needed.
* Foster collaboration and share information with other in\-house data teams, to optimise the quality of our data.
* Proactively suggest process efficiency and methodology improvements, supporting on their delivery within the scope of our COACT data quality framework.
* Keep abreast of emerging market trends and regulatory changes in the risk and compliance landscape, as well as competitor advances in the maritime data market.
* If required, attend client meetings as a subject matter expert alongside sales and product management.


  

  

**Essential**
**What we are looking for:**
* A customer\-first approach with a flexible, can\-do attitude, and strong time management skills with an ability to respond to multiple queries and requests within set deadlines.
* At least 1\-2 years’ experience in business intelligence, consultancy, or complex data research, relying both on primary and secondary sources.
* Proven track record of proactively seeking out and validating information, both within and outside of pre\-determined source lists.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Ability to compile training methodology and feedback documents to drive output enhancements is a pre\-requisite.
* Strong stakeholder management is required in this role, across all areas of the business.


  

  

**Desirable**
* Experience of resolving complex customer queries, including objection handling.
* Innovative and dynamic approach to problem\-solving, with proven success in implementing data, research, and content improvements.
* Software skills in packages that are synonymous with Big Data management, e.g. SQL, Python, and experience using datasets in natural language processing (NLP) would be an advantage
* Comprehensive understanding of complex company ownership structures and financial and legal transactions in the maritime industry would be advantageous.
* Experience mapping legal corporate structures and proficiency using corporate registries would be highly advantageous.
* Confident presentation skills for internal and external audiences.
* An established network of contacts in the maritime industry.
* Proficiency in another language is highly desirable.

**About Us**
 We are the industry experts delivering actionable maritime insight, data, technology, and analytics trusted by 60,000 professionals across the globe to drive commercial advantage, evaluate risk, and support the efficient and lawful movement of seaborne trade.
   

  

 Our data is collected only from the most reputable partners and accurate sources, many of which are exclusive to us and our customers.
   

  

 Our advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and industry expertise transform our unparalleled data into powerful insight delivered through data and analytics platforms and services, news and commentary, and publications that help professionals in maritime operations, risk, and compliance stay well informed.
   

  

 Leading seaborne trade through change with data transparency, innovative technology, and human ingenuity.
   

  

**Our Vales and Behaviours**

 Transparency and trust needs to be at the heart, with commitment to honest communication about

 inequality and recognition/reward.
   

  

 Embrace collective brillianceCollaboration and teamwork are the foundation of our collective success. Our data highlights the importance of
   

  

 working together cross\-company and communicating with agility to solve problems. There is a strong emphasis

 celebration of cultural differences is critical. There is emphasis placed on social awareness and
   

  

 positive impact.
   

  

 Take responsibility
   

  

 The importance of being accountable to each other cannot be underestimated, recognizing each
   

  

 other's work, and maintaining a challenge culture to ensure credibility, dependability, and

 a commitment to delivering work that puts customers first and provides market\-leading

title: Backend Engineer, ML systems
description:
About GalaxEye
   





 GalaxEye is a Space\-Tech startup pioneering the world's first Multi\-Sensor Earth Observation Satellite, integrating SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) and MSI (Multi\-Spectral Imaging) on a single platform. As we move towards building a constellation of indigenous satellites, we are also developing advanced data platforms that fuse satellite data, AI analytics, and geospatial intelligence.
   





  





 About the role
   





 You'll help build the backend and ML platforms that turn multi\-sensor satellite data into geospatial intelligence — and you'll build them to run fully air\-gapped and offline, deployed inside defense and intelligence environments with no internet access.
   





 This is an early\-career role. We're not expecting you to have done all of this already. We're hiring for how fast you learn, how you debug when things are murky, and whether you have the instincts to become genuinely good at a rare intersection: production backend, applied ML, and hard\-constraint systems that have to work without the cloud crutches most engineers lean on.
   





  





 What makes this different
   





 Most backend/ML jobs let you reach for a managed service when things get hard — a hosted model API, cloud autoscaling, pip install at deploy time. Here you can't. Systems run on isolated, on\-prem hardware with no internet at runtime. That means:
   




* Models are self\-hosted and run locally — no external inference endpoints.
* Dependencies are mirrored and builds are reproducible and offline\-friendly.
* Deployment and updates happen through controlled, secure processes, not push\-to\-cloud.
* Monitoring, logging, and evals all have to be self\-contained.



 If that sounds like a fun constraint rather than an annoyance, you'll fit well here.
   





  





 What you'll actually do
   




* Build and maintain backend services and APIs that fuse satellite data (SAR \+ MSI) and serve geospatial analytics to analysts.
* Design and work with databases and data flows for large raster/imagery datasets — model the data, write queries and pipelines that hold up at scale.
* Put ML models behind reliable, self\-hosted services: take something that works in a notebook and make it a monitored, production service that runs offline.
* Work on inference and ML pipelines for imagery/geospatial analytics — batching, latency vs. throughput, GPU constraints, keeping things healthy in an air\-gapped deployment.
* Contribute to analyst\-facing and agentic tooling — components that chain steps, call local tools, and support intelligence workflows (and fail gracefully when they don't).
* Debug systems where "correct" is fuzzy, and build the evals and monitoring that tell us whether a change actually made things better.



 What you'll learn here
   





 Because this matters as much as the work:
   




* How to build production ML and data systems under real constraints — offline, on\-prem, security\-first — a skill very few engineers ever develop.
* How to reason about systems that are probabilistic\-ally correct, not just pass/fail.
* Applied geospatial/EO machine learning and multi\-sensor data fusion, mentored by \[a lead with ML engineering experience / the team].
* How to stay sharp without managed services — reading source code and papers, and self\-hosting what others just call an API for.


 Requirements
   

  


 What we're looking for
   





 Genuinely required:
   




* :1\-2 years of backend engineering / ML engineering experience.
* Strong fundamentals — you understand why, not just which framework method to call. You can reason about what happens between a request arriving and a response leaving.
* Systematic debugging. When something breaks, you form a hypothesis, reproduce it, and narrow it down — you don't just try random fixes. (This matters double when you can't google your way out live.)
* Evidence you learn fast and on your own. You've picked up something hard recently and can explain both the thing and how you learned it.
* You surface blockers early and communicate clearly when you're stuck.
* Comfort with constraints and process — security discipline, careful data handling, and working within an air\-gapped environment are part of the job, not obstacles to route around.
* Curiosity about ML/AI with some hands\-on exposure — ideally you've run a model locally/self\-hosted rather than only via a cloud API.



  




  






 Bonus (nice to have)
   





 Any of these are a plus — we don't expect all or even most:
   




* Geospatial / remote\-sensing experience: GDAL, rasterio, QGIS, working with satellite imagery, SAR, or multi\-spectral data.
* Self\-hosting or serving ML models on\-prem (e.g. Triton, ONNX Runtime, local LLMs, vLLM).
* Experience with air\-gapped, on\-prem, or high\-security deployments; reproducible builds; offline package mirroring.
* Familiarity with containerization for isolated environments (Docker/K8s), and GPU\-based inference.
* Exposure to observability, evals, or testing non\-deterministic systems.
* Comfort reading a paper's method section or an unfamiliar library's source.

description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 Through continued growth comes more demand for business insights and data used to make objective decisions. To support this need and help maintain operational efficiency, A\&M has invested in growing its Business Intelligence Unit (BIU). The BIU creates and maintains scalable data pipelines, constructs analysis, delivers process improvement initiatives and builds visualization tools and applications. The unit is also focused on embedding AI into its own ways of working to drive efficiency, and on enabling the business to apply AI to the data assets the team provides. All with the goal of supporting the firm to realize operational efficiencies identified through analysis. The BIU operates across multiple geographies and practice areas, supporting decision\-making for senior stakeholders across the firm. The Insight Optimisation team is responsible for the ongoing health, evolution, and optimization of the firm's core reporting products. The team manages report consistency, user experience, backend data model improvements, documentation, troubleshooting, and enhancement requests. The team mission is to provide a seamless user experience to the business whilst reducing long\-term operational overhead through prioritising consistency, consolidation, and a focus on action\-driven insights.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 The Business Intelligence Unit is seeking a motivated Associate to join the Insight Optimisation team based in India. Reporting to the Manager of Insight Optimisation, the Associate will play a hands\-on role in maintaining and improving the firm's existing core reporting suite, supporting business users, and contributing to the transition to a new Snowflake data environment.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused role for someone with strong technical foundations in Power BI and SQL, a curiosity for how data is used across a business, and the discipline to work through complex troubleshooting scenarios. The successful candidate will spend their time building improvements to existing reports, investigating data issues, maintaining documentation, and working directly with business users to understand and deliver on their needs. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, comfortable working across the analytics stack, curious about how AI can enhance their work, and eager to develop their skills in a global, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

* Review report usage statistics and user feedback to identify opportunities to improve formatting, usability, and consistency across the reporting suite.
* Implement improvements to existing reports and dashboards, applying user\-centred design principles to enhance the end\-user experience.
* Review dashboard refresh times and backend data models, identifying and applying efficiency improvements in how data is brought into the reporting layer.
* Maintain user guides, definition lists, and technical documentation as new tabs and data sources are added over time.
* Triage and troubleshoot queries received through the BIU inbox, systematically diagnosing whether issues sit at the reporting layer, database level, or source level.
* Escalate complex or cross\-layer issues appropriately and work collaboratively with the wider team to resolve them.
* Support the transition of existing reports to the new Snowflake environment, repointing reports and testing to ensure continuity of service for business users.
* Apply AI and generative AI tools to accelerate day\-to\-day delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Communicate clearly with business users on the status of their requests, expected timelines, and any technical constraints.
* Contribute to team\-wide initiatives to improve ways of working, share knowledge, and raise the collective technical standard of the team
* Keep up to date with the latest tools and techniques in BI, analytics, and AI, and apply them where they can add value


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a data\-focused role.
* Strong report development experience, preferably Power BI, including visualisation, data modelling, and DAX.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write, read, and optimise queries against relational databases.
* Understanding of data modelling concepts and how data flows through a modern analytics stack.
* Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms is desirable; willingness to learn is essential.
* Awareness of current AI and generative AI tools, with an interest in applying them to analytics workflows and reporting products.
* Structured troubleshooting approach, with the ability to isolate problems across the analytics stack.
* Exposure to user\-centred design principles and an appreciation for the end\-user experience of analytics products.
* Familiarity with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
* Experience working in a globally distributed team or across time zones is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a relevant field, or equivalent professional work experience


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Associate Quality Engineer
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
   

  

 As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
   

  

 What You Can Expect
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Associate Quality Engineer supports software quality assurance, software testing, verification and validation (V\&V), and compliance activities in a regulated environment. This entry\-level role assists with reviewing software requirements and deliverables, developing and executing test documentation, supporting defect management, maintaining traceability, and participating in software lifecycle quality activities.
   

  

 The position works under the guidance of senior Software Quality and Quality Assurance team members and collaborates with cross\-functional teams including Software/R\&D, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs. The ideal candidate has a foundation in software testing, application and API testing, defect tracking, and software development lifecycle processes, with an interest in developing expertise in regulated software and medical device quality systems.
   

  

**Work mode:** 
 2 WFH, 3 WHO
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

 How You'll Create Impact
   

  

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
* Support software quality assurance activities throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Assist with software verification and validation (V\&V) activities, including development, review, execution, and documentation of test plans, test cases, test protocols, and test reports.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing for software applications, including embedded, desktop, web\-based, and cloud\-based systems, as applicable.
* Support application testing to identify functional defects, UI issues, usability concerns, performance issues, and inconsistencies.
* Execute and document testing of software features and verify defect corrections and implemented fixes.
* Support the review of software requirements, design documentation, test documentation, and other software deliverables for completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability.
* Participate in requirements activities and assist with ensuring requirements are clear, complete, traceable, and verifiable.
* Assist with maintaining traceability between software requirements, risk controls, test cases, and verification evidence using Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs) or similar tools.
* Support defect tracking, investigation, documentation, retesting, and closure activities.
* Assist with testing REST APIs and software interfaces, including validation of requests, responses, error handling, and status codes using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Support software integration testing between frontend, backend, databases, and external interfaces.
* Assist with software change management activities, including impact assessments, regression testing, and updates to applicable documentation.
* Assist with maintaining configuration and release traceability and supporting software version and change documentation.
* Prepare and maintain validation and quality documentation, including test plans, protocols, test cases, execution records, RTMs, validation reports, and other objective evidence.
* Support compliance with applicable quality system procedures and regulatory requirements, including FDA regulations, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, GAMP 5, and 21 CFR Part 11, as applicable.
* Assist with audit readiness activities and provide documentation or support during internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections as needed.
* Collaborate effectively with R\&D, Software Engineering, QA, and Regulatory teams to support software quality objectives.


 This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.
   

  

 What Makes You Stand Out
   

  

**Expected Areas Of Competence (i.e., Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
* Familiarity with web and application testing, including identification of UI defects, functional errors, formatting inconsistencies, responsiveness, and overall software quality issues.
* Exposure to REST API development and testing, including API requests and responses, HTTP methods and status codes, CRUD operations, and tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Exposure to Python and backend frameworks such as Flask and/or Django, with basic understanding of frontend\-to\-backend integration, software debugging, and relational databases such as MySQL and/or MariaDB.
* Basic understanding of software quality processes, the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), software verification and validation (V\&V), configuration management, version control, and software release traceability.

 Contributes directly to a project team or application support groups in the execution of effective Quality Assurance procedures and defect prevention/detection processes for corporate and client area information systems, across multiple computing environments. description:

 Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.
   

  

**Description**
 United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting\-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.
   

  

**Job Overview And Responsibilities**
 The Quality Engineer supports the delivery of reliable software by designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests for web, API, and service\-based applications. The role works within an Agile delivery team to understand requirements, execute functional and regression testing, identify defects, and contribute to continuous integration practices. This position applies foundational programming and testing knowledge while developing practical skills in automation frameworks, quality engineering methods, and production\-focused validation.
   

  

* Test Automation Development and Maintenance: Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for functional, regression, API, and integration testing. Follow established framework standards, create reusable components, and keep test assets aligned with application changes.
* Test Analysis and Execution: Review user stories and acceptance criteria, identify test scenarios and test data needs, execute manual and automated tests, and document results with clear evidence.
* Defect Management and Quality Reporting: Log reproducible defects with appropriate severity and supporting details, retest fixes, support root cause discussions, and provide accurate progress and quality status updates.
* CI/CD and Test Environment Support: Integrate automated tests into established CI/CD pipelines, review execution results, troubleshoot script or environment failures, and support reliable test runs across environments.
* Agile Collaboration and Continuous Learning: Participate in planning, refinement, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. Collaborate with developers, product partners, and senior QEs; follow coding and test standards; and continuously build automation, domain, and quality engineering skills.


**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time\-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd \- a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**
**Qualifications**
**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 1\-3 years of experience in software testing or quality engineering, including exposure to test automation in an Agile environment.
* No license required. Foundational training in software testing or automation is acceptable.
* Foundational knowledge of software testing concepts, SDLC, STLC, and defect lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one automation tool or framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or an equivalent.
* Basic programming or scripting ability in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\#, or a comparable language.
* Ability to create and maintain clear test cases, test data, and automated scripts.
* Working knowledge of API testing and tools such as Postman or an equivalent.
* Familiarity with source control and defect/work tracking tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities, learn quickly, and deliver with guidance in a fast\-paced Agile environment.


**What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**
* Coursework or training in software testing, programming, or automation
* Experience testing web applications, APIs, or service\-based systems.
* ISTQB Foundation Level or relevant automation/cloud certification.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools and automated test execution in delivery pipelines.
* Basic SQL and database validation skills.
* Familiarity with Git, Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, accessibility testing, performance testing, mobile testing, or observability tools.
* Awareness of AI\-assisted testing tools and responsible use of generated test assets.

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Functional Tester with BA skills
   

  

**Department**
 IT \& Payments – ITG (IT Payment Services)
   

  

**Business Line / Function Description**
 The IT Payment Services line is the global hub for payments and cash‑management solutions across the BNP Paribas Group. It delivers high‑throughput, highly secure applications that process billions of transactions each year. The team works in an Agile, DevOps‑centric environment and collaborates closely with product owners, compliance, and operations to keep the platform reliable, compliant, and innovative.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 This position is for Business System analyst for IT systems on Payments and Cash Management for the BNPP Group.
   

  

 This Position Involves functional analysis \& testing covering executing the functional and regression tests using manual and automation methods.
   

  

 You will be part of a team of 3 people mainly in INDIA
   

  

 Next Step is a new Project for BNP Paris. The platform evolves with the latest technology: Jave Full stack – Kendo (Typescript)
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Functional Specification Analysis Experience
* Understanding testing principles and practices
* Ability to plan, design, and execute test cases
* Able to communicate effectively with IT teams as well as Business Teams
* Work in close co\-ordination with functional test team to Analyze test cases thoroughly to ensure adequate coverage of requirements.
* Closely work with Dev teams/PO resolve technical \& business issues and to develop a good understanding of the project and testing objectives.
* Must have good analytical skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Should be able to communicate effectively with IT teams as well as Business Teams
* Must be flexible, independent.
* Perform other testing\-related duties as required


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Team player
* Effectively communicate work and delivery status
* Adhere to timelines set for delivery
* Open to adaptation of new technology, learning and implementation within the project.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Experience of 3\-5 years in Functional analysis and testing required
* Customer oriented (required)
* Proficient in analytical skills (required)
* Excellent oral and writing communication skills (required)
* BDD/TDD approach knowledge (required)
* Test feature writing for Cucumber (required)
* Skillful in XML/XSD and SQL language (required)
* Experienced user of ALM/QC, JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint
* Experience in working in Agile environment


**Specific Qualifications**
* Minimum 3 years of experience along with Bachelor’s degree \- in management, finance, science, economics, related field or equivalent experience.
* Prior experience in similar domain.


**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**

* Basic of SQL
* AML Octane

**Behavioral Skills**
* Communication
* Analytical Ability
* Team Player


**Education Level:** 
 Bachelor Degree or equivalent
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Testing Engineer Controls
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Test Systems Engineer to support the design, development, and maintenance of automated test systems used in testing electronic and control system products, including turbine controls, distributed control systems, excitation systems, and static starter technologies.
   

  

 The engineer will either work under guidance to learn test system development fundamentals or independently lead complex test system design, programming, validation, and global deployment efforts. This position offers hands\-on exposure to electrical test systems, Automated Test Equipment (ATE), and industry\-standard tools in a manufacturing environment.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Responsibilities will be assigned based on experience level and may include:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain Automated Test Equipment (ATE) for electronic and electrical control systems.
* Assist in or lead the creation of test plans, test specifications, and validation strategies based on product and manufacturing requirements.
* Develop, modify, and maintain test applications using NI LabVIEW and TestStand, ensuring scalable, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Support or lead hardware and software upgrades to test platforms, including toolchain updates and hardware obsolescence management.
* Maintain, calibrate, and support electrical test systems, including test fixtures, tools, and spare parts.
* Troubleshoot test failures and system performance issues through hardware\- and software\-level debugging and root cause analysis.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams such as Design Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality to align test solutions with business and product needs.
* Support source code management activities, including firmware updates, configuration changes, and BOM (Bill of Materials) updates.
* Contribute to or lead global deployment and standardization of test systems across manufacturing sites.
* Document test system designs, test procedures, validation reports, and support activities in accordance with engineering and quality standards.
* Learn and apply industry best practices for testing, debugging, and maintaining electrical and electronic control systems.


**Desired Characteristics / Qualifications**
* Electrical / Electronics / Software Engineering Bachelor Degree

description:

**General Summary**
 Sensor Test Engineer – Qualcomm Sensing Hub
   

  

 Job Function
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This position involves hands on testing for sensors, sensor related features and seamless context exchange between Qualcomm products integrating Qualcomm Sensing Hub. Qualcomm Sensing Hub enables extremely low power context detection and awareness by fusing information from different sensors and radios.
   

  

 The role is an individual contributor as part of an international sensor test team. Daily tasks will include hands\-on testing, verification, and calibration of embedded HW integrating sensors, verification and testing of algorithms fusing sensor and radio data, testing features and communication across devices and development of embedded test applications, automation frameworks, test tools, and automated test cases.
   

  

**The Following Defines The Main Responsibilities**
* Testing Qualcomm Sensing Hub features for Qualcomm products. Test planning, test case development and execution. This includes hands\-on testing with various mobile/handheld products both in lab and in the field.
* Developing test automation modules for the overall sensor automation framework using C\# and Python.
* Development of embedded test applications, automation frameworks, test tools, and automated test cases.
* Verification and calibration of sensors in embedded HW.
* Testing communication and information sharing between devices embedding Qualcomm Sensing Hub.
* Test case automation and maintenance.
* Triaging issues observed during testing and isolating them into different test framework components, SW modules in embedded target SW or HW itself. Driving the resolution of the observed issues across the sensor and other QCT technology and target teams.
* Supporting test, SW development and system teams in analysis and debugging of observed issues in embedded targets.
* Interacting in a global team environment with various test architecture, power, SW, system, test, and test framework teams.
* Desire to understand in detail the Qualcomm Sensing Hub related SW and HW architectures and embedded SW designs from HLOS all the way down to sensor driver level across various target devices.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.


**Skills/Experience**
 A minimum of 1\-4 years of Work experience with testing embedded systems and developing automated test cases / automation frameworks for them.
   

  

* Proficiency in C and/or C\+\+.
* Prior experience with developing and/or debugging embedded code.
* Exposure and experience on AI tools and applications.
* Prior experience with Android application programming.
* Previous programming experience with Java, Python, etc.
* Detail oriented, thorough, and analytical approach required with excellent communication skills.
* Ability to time\-share and prioritize between multiple tasks is crucial.
* Proven team player that can drive bugs into resolutions across multiple global teams.
* Excellent understanding of debugging and isolating issues in embedded devices.
* Basic understanding of different radios (like cellular modem, WiFi, Bluetooth, location), audio and camera features in mobile phone.
* Familiar with oscilloscope and comfortable working with Qualcomm HW protolab to expose necessarily signals for testing and debugging purposes. Capable to validate and debug simple HW reworks exposing interrupt signals etc.
* Good understanding of test methodology and test processes, including requirements collection, test plan development, test execution and error tracking.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Previous experience with standard Qualcomm test automation framework and tools (Axiom, QXDM, QDSS, Crashscope, Trace32\) and Qualcomm DIAG implementation.
* Previous exposure to Sensors (inertial, pressure, magnetic, ambient light, proximity, capacitive, physiological) and associated test equipment beneficial.
